## Page 6

# Proclaiming

# One Religion for All the People

This Final Testament consolidates all the messages delivered by all of God’s messengers into one global message. Henceforth, there is only one religion that is approved by God.

Islam is not a name. It is a description: “Total submission to God—worshiping God, and devoting the worship absolutely to Him ALONE.”

Anyone who meets this criterion is a “Muslim.” Thus, you may be a Muslim Jew, A Muslim Christian, a Muslim Buddhist, a Muslim Hindu, or a Muslim Muslim.

> The only religion acceptable by God is Islam.
>
> [3:19]

> Anyone who accepts other than Islam as his religion, it will not be accepted from him; he will end up a loser in the Hereafter.
>
> [3:85]

All religions of the world—Judaism, Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, etc.—have been corrupted through idolization of their prophets and saints.

## Page 13

On the 27th night of Ramadan of the year 13 B.H. (Before Hijra) (610 A.D.), the prophet Muhammad was summoned to the highest possible point, millions of light years from the planet Earth, and this Quran was placed into his heart (2:185, 17:1, 44:3, 53:1-18, & 97:1).

Subsequently, the Quran was released into Muhammad’s memory, with Gabriel’s mediation, over a period of 23 years, 610 to 632 A.D. (see 17:106).

At the moment of release, Muhammad scrupulously wrote it down with his own hand—it has been divinely guarded since then (see Appendices 1 and 28).

## Page 14

# INTRODUCTION

This is God’s final message to humanity. All of God’s prophets have come to this world, and all the scriptures have been delivered.

The time has come to purify and consolidate all the messages delivered by God’s prophets into one message, and proclaim that henceforth, only one religion is acceptable by God, Islam (3:19). “Islam” is not the name of a religion; it is a description. “Islam” is the total submission and devotion to God ALONE. Thus, there are many Muslim Christians, Muslim Jews, and Muslim Muslims. There is only one religion—devoting one’s worship to God ALONE. This is the First Commandment in the Old Testament, the New Testament, and this Final Testament.

Now that the message is complete, we have received such crucial information as the purpose of our life, how we came into this world, and where we are going.

One may ask: “Why did God wait all this time to perfect and consolidate His message? What about all those people since Adam who did not receive the complete scripture?” To put these questions in the right perspective, let us look at the world population from Adam to the end of the world. It is a matter of simple statistics that the world’s population from the beginning until now did not exceed 6,000,000,000. From now to the end of the world, reported here as 2280 A.D. (see Appendix 25), it is estimated that the world population will exceed 75,000,000,000. In other words, the vast majority of people are yet to come to this world. God’s purified and consolidated message, therefore, is destined to reach the vast majority of humans.

![World population from now (1989) to the end of the world (2280).]

[The black box represents the world population since Adam]

It all began a few billion years ago when one of God’s high-ranking creatures, Satan, developed supercilious thoughts that he could be a god besides God.

This challenge to God’s absolute authority was not only blasphemous, it was totally erroneous. Satan was ignorant of the fact that God alone possesses the power and qualifications to be a god, and that there is much more to godhood than he could have ever imagined. It was ignorance coupled with pride that led Satan to believe that he could take care of a dominion, as a god, and run it efficiently without disease, misery, war, accidents, and chaos.

While Satan was the initiator of this horrendous blasphemy, billions of creatures agreed with Satan. They decided that Satan’s God-given powers did qualify him to be a god in his own right. Thus, a profound dispute erupted within the heavenly society (38:69). The rebels’ unjustifiable challenge to God’s absolute authority was met and resolved in the most efficient manner.

## Page 15

If you claim that you can fly a plane, the best way to test your claim is to give you a plane and ask you to fly it. This is precisely what God decided to do in response to Satan’s claim that he could be a god. As for those who agreed with Satan, they were given a chance to reconsider their decisions and accept God’s absolute authority, or go through a test where they witness Satan’s attempt to prove his abilities as a god. About 100 billion creatures chose to participate in Satan’s demonstration (33:72).

The heavenly dispute led to the classification of God’s creatures into three different categories:
(1) **Angels**: Creatures who never questioned God’s absolute authority; they *knew* that God alone possessed the power to be a god.
(2) **Jinns**: Creatures who decided that Satan was capable of being a god.
(3) **Humans**: Creatures who remained neutral; they questioned God’s absolute authority. These creatures believed that Satan might possess sufficient power to run a dominion.

It is only logical that members of God’s kingdom must uphold God’s absolute authority. The angels, therefore, expected Satan and those who agreed with him to be banished from God’s kingdom. Exile from God means Hell.

When God informed the angels that He was placing Satan as a god on earth, and granting the creatures who agreed with him another chance to be redeemed, the angels wondered: “Would you place on earth those who would commit evil therein and shed blood?” (2:30). God, the Most Gracious, Most Merciful, willed that we get another chance to denounce our blasphemy, and redeem ourselves by deciding that God ALONE possesses all power.

To carry out the projected test, God “created death” (67:1-2). The divine plan called for putting the rebellious creatures to death, then bringing them into another life, this worldly dimension, where they have no recollection of the heavenly feud. Under the circumstances of this life, the humans and the jinns are given absolute freedom to reconsider their blasphemous ideas, after studying God’s messages and Satan’s messages. Based on their freewill decision, they are either redeemed into God’s kingdom, or remain exiled with Satan.

To point out the infinitesimal size and utter insignificance of Satan’s projected dominion, God created a billion galaxies, containing a billion trillion stars, within a vast universe that spans billions of light years. Then God informed Satan that a tiny mote within that universe, the planet Earth, shall be his dominion. As if this universe were not vast enough, God created six more, even larger universes surrounding our universe (2:29, 67:3). On the insignificant speck called “Earth,” God created the means of supporting plant, animal, human, and jinn life.

God’s plan called for placing the humans and the jinns in a universe that cannot stand His physical presence (7:143). Satan was to rule his minute kingdom far from God, though with God’s full knowledge and control.

The body of the first human being was designed and shaped on the planet earth by God’s angels, in accordance with God’s instructions (7:11). God then assigned

## Page 16

the first person, Adam, to that body. When God informed the angels that they will be serving the humans throughout the test period—guarding them, driving the winds, distributing the rain, etc.—Satan was the only one who refused to “fall prostrate” (2:34, 15:31, 38:74).

Adam’s mate was produced from Adam’s body, and God assigned the second human being to her body. While the bodies of Adam and Eve remained here on earth, their souls resided in Heaven. As soon as Adam and Eve fell for Satan’s tricks, they were exiled from their heavenly dimension, down to the earthly dimension—“their bodies became visible to them” (7:20, 20:121). The rest is history.

Putting Satan, the jinns, and the humans to the test stipulated that Satan shall reproduce whenever a human being is born. Every time a human being is born, a jinn is born to be the new human’s constant companion. The human person is subjected to the incessant persuasions of Satan’s representative, who lives in the same body from birth to death. Satan’s representative tries to convince the human companion of Satan’s point of view: that God alone is not enough. On the Day of Judgment, the companion serves as a witness for or against the human (43:38; 50:23, 27).

God did not leave the human being without preparation. To help the human creatures in their final chance to reconsider their decisions, every person is born with instinctive knowledge that God ALONE, and no one else, is our Lord and Master (7:172-173). Additionally, God sent messengers to deliver messages, warnings, and abundant information to help us redeem ourselves. With all these elements in view, we can appreciate the fact that the only unforgivable offense (if maintained until death) is idol worship: believing that anyone besides God possesses any power.

The human being is given forty years to study, look around, reflect, and examine all points of view before making this most important decision—to uphold Satan’s point of view, or uphold God’s absolute authority. Anyone who dies before the age of forty is chosen by God for redemption due to circumstances known only to God (46:15). If one decides at a young age that God ALONE possesses all power, then dies before the age of 40, the most probable destiny is the High Heaven. Otherwise, the Lower Heaven is the destiny for most people who die before 40 (Appendix 5).

God’s messengers delivered God’s good news of our new chance to redeem ourselves, as well as warnings, to every corner of the globe. They were supported by formidable signs. When Moses went to Pharaoh, he was supported by such miracles as the turning of his staff into a serpent. Jesus created live birds from clay by God’s leave, healed the leprous and the blind by God’s leave, and revived the dead by God’s leave.

34. We said to the angels, “Fall prostrate before Adam.” They fell prostrate, except Satan; he refused, was too proud, and turned unappreciative.

35. We said, “O Adam, live with your wife in Paradise, and eat, generously, anything you like, but do not approach this one tree, lest you become transgressors.”

36. But the devil duped them, and caused their eviction therefrom. Consequently, we said, “Go down as enemies of one another. On Earth shall be your settlement and provisions for awhile.”

37. Then, Adam received from his Lord words* whereby He redeemed him. He is the Redeemer, Most Merciful.

49. Recall that we saved you from Pharaoh’s people who inflicted the worst persecution upon you, slaying your sons, and sparing your daughters. That was an exacting test from your Lord.

**The Heifer (Al-Baqarah) 2:58-61**

**They Refuse to Enter Jerusalem**

58. Recall that we said, “Enter this town, and eat therefrom as you please, generously. Enter the gate humbly, and speak amicably. We will then forgive your sins, and increase the reward for the pious.”

59. But the wicked among you substituted other words in place of the words given to them. Consequently, we sent down upon the transgressors condemnation from the sky, due to their wickedness.

**More Miracles**

60. Recall that Moses sought water for his people, and we said, “Strike the rock with your staff.” Whereupon, twelve springs gushed out therefrom. Thus, each tribe knew their own water: “Eat and drink from GOD’s provisions, and do not roam the earth corruptly.”

61. Recall that you said, “O Moses, we can no longer tolerate one kind of food. Call upon your Lord to produce for us such earthly crops as beans, cucumbers, garlic, lentils, and onions.” He said, “Do you wish to substitute that which is inferior for that which is good? Maybe you should go back to Egypt, where you can find what you asked for.” They were condemned to humiliation and disgrace, and they incurred GOD’s wrath. That is because they used to disbelieve in GOD’s revelations, and killed the prophets unjustly. That is because they disobeyed and transgressed.

وَقَالُوا لَا تَجِدْ فِيهِمْ مَنْ يَقْبَلُهُ وَوَقَاءٌ بِالْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
وَقَالُوا يَا مُوسَى إِنَّا لَا نَصْبِرُ عَلَىٰ طَعَامٍ وَاحِدٍ فَادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُخْرِجْ لَنَا مِمَّا تُنْبِتُ الْأَرْضُ مِنْ بَقْلِهَا وَقِثَّائِهَا وَفُومِهَا وَعَدَسِهَا وَبَصَلِهَا قَالَ أَتَسْتَبْدِلُونَ الَّذِي هُوَ أَدْنَىٰ بِالَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ ۚ اهْبِطُوا مِصْرًا فَإِنَّكُمْ لَعَلَىٰ خُطْوَةٍ مِّنَ الْحُطَمِ
وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِالسِّنِينَ وَقِلَّةِ الثَّمَرَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
وَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ طَائِفَةٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِهِمْ يُقَرِّبُونَ إِلَيْهِمُ الْتِقَاءَ قَالُوا إِنَّا لَكُمْ لَمُبْعَثُونَ
قَالَ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ كَانَ هَٰذَا بِالْحَقِّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ فَأْتُونِي بِكِتَابٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِهِ أَوْ أَسْتَقِيمَنَّ عَلَىٰ مِلَّةِ رَبِّي إِنْ أَتَيْتُمُ الْحَقَّ سَأَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ائْتُونِي بِكُلِّ سَاحِرٍ عَلِيمٍ
فَلَمَّا جَاءَ السَّاحِرُونَ قَالَ قَالُوا مُوسَى إِنْ أَنتَ سَاحِرٌ فَأْتِ بِآيَةٍ فَأَرْسِلْهُ عَلَىٰ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ
فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ قَالُوا هَٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ
وَلَقَدْ عَلِمُوا أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ فَقَالُوا أَسْتَعْثِرْنَا بِالْحَقِّ إِذْ جَاءَهُمْ ۖ بَلْ هُمُ الْمُفْسِدُونَ
فَأُغْرِقُوا فِى الْحَقِّ وَقِيلَ يَا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا لَعَدُوًّا مُّبِينًا
وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي الْقُرْآنِ مَثَلًا مِّنْهُمَا فَإِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا لِلْآيَاتِ مُعَارِضِينَ
وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِالسِّنِينَ وَقِلَّةِ الثَّمَرَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
وَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ طَائِفَةٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِهِمْ يُقَرِّبُونَ إِلَيْهِمُ الْتِقَاءَ قَالُوا إِنَّا لَكُمْ لَمُبْعَثُونَ
قَالَ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ كَانَ هَٰذَا بِالْحَقِّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ فَأْتُونِي بِكِتَابٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِهِ أَوْ أَسْتَقِيمَنَّ عَلَىٰ مِلَّةِ رَبِّي إِنْ أَتَيْتُمُ الْحَقَّ سَأَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ائْتُونِي بِكُلِّ سَاحِرٍ عَلِيمٍ

**Covenant with Israel**

63. We made a covenant with you, as we raised Mount Sinai above you: “You shall uphold what we have given you, strongly, and remember what is in it, that you may be saved.”

64. But you turned away after that! If it were not for **GOD**’s compassion towards you, and His mercy, you would have been losers.

65. You have known about those among you who desecrated the Sabbath—we said to them, “Be you despicable apes.”

66. We rendered them a lesson for their generation, as well as subsequent generations, and an enlightenment for the righteous.

**The Heifer\***

67. When Moses said to his people, “**GOD** commands you to sacrifice a heifer,” they said, “Are you mocking us?” He said, “**GOD** forbid that I should be so ignorant.”

68. They said, “Call upon your Lord to show us which one.” He said, “He says that she is a heifer that is neither too old, nor too young; of an intermediate age. Now you should carry out this command.”

69. They said, “Call upon your Lord to show us her color.” He said, “He says that she is a yellow heifer, bright colored, pleases the beholders.”

إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَالَّذِينَ هَادُوا وَالنَّصَارَى وَالصَّابِئِينَ وَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ مِّنْهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ مُؤْمِنُونَ قَدْ كَانَتْ بَيْنَهُمْ كَلِمَةُ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمْ بَعْضَ كَلِمَةِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ حَقِّهَا وَكَانُوا يَتْلُونَهَا وَيَقْرَءُونَهَا وَكَانُوا لَيَسْتَطِيعُونَهَا وَلَقَدْ أُوتِيتُمُّهَا مِنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا مِن بَعْدِ ذَلِكَ فَلَا أُمِرْتُ بِالَّذِينَ عَصَوْا وَكَانُوا لِيَكُونُوا فَاسِقِينَ

فَقُلْتُمْ لِمَنْ لَا يَكُونُ فِيكُمْ خَبِيرٌ بِهَا كَلَّمَهُ اللَّهُ أَوْ جُنُودٌ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ أَتَّبِعُونَهُمْ وَقُلْ آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَالْأَسْبَاطِ وَمَا أُوتِيَ مُوسَى وَعِيسَى وَمَا أُوتِيَ النَّبِيُّونَ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُونَ

فَإِنْ آمَنُوا بِمِثْلِ مَا آمَنتُم بِهِ فَقَدِ اهْتَدَوْا وَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّمَا هُمْ فِتْنَةٌ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ

70. They said, “Call upon your Lord to show us which one. The heifers look alike to us, and **GOD** willing, we will be guided.”

71. He said, “He says that she is a heifer that was never humiliated in plowing the land or watering the crops; free from any blemish.”
They said, “Now you have brought the truth.”
They finally sacrificed her, after this lengthy reluctance.

72. You had killed a soul, then disputed among yourselves. **GOD** was to expose what you tried to conceal.

73. Thus, we said, “Strike (the victim) with part (of the heifer).”
**GOD** then revived the dead, and showed you His signs, that you may understand.

74. Yet, your hearts hardened thereafter and became like rocks, or even harder.
For there are rocks from which rivers gush out. Other rocks crack and gently release water. Some rocks cringe out of reverence for **GOD**. **GOD** is never unaware of anything you do.
Tampering with the Word of God

75. Do you expect them to believe as you do, when some of them used to hear the word of **GOD**, then distort it after full understanding thereof, and knowingly?

76. When they meet the believers, they say, “We believe.”
Then, when they get together with each other, they say, “Do not tell (the believers) of **GOD**’s revelations to you, lest you provide them with support for their argument concerning your Lord. Do you not understand?”

Arabic text:

فَأَوَاهُمُ إِلَىٰ أَن يَقُولُوا إِنَّمَا نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ آبَاءَنَا وَإِنَّا لَفِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
قَالُوا لَئِنِ اتَّبَعْنَا الْهُدَىٰ مَعَكَ نُتَخَتَّفَنَّ مِنْ أَرْضِهِمْ أَوْلَادَهُمْ وَنَسْتَبْدِلْهُمْ بِهِمْ وَمَا يُرِيدُ ذَٰلِكَ إِلَّا قَوْمٌ ظَالِمُونَ
قَالُوا لَنْ نَتَّخِذَكَ عَلَيْهِ أُولَىٰ حَتَّىٰ تُحْيِيَ الْأَرْضَ مَيْتًا وَإِنَّا لَفِي شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَقُولُ
قَالَ الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي كَانَ يَقْتَرِبُ إِلَىٰ مَلَكَتِهِمْ إِنِّي أُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِتَأْوِيلِهِ فَأَرْسِلُونِ
قَالُوا إِنَّا إِلَىٰكَ مُسْلِمُونَ
قَالَ إِنَّهُنَّ تِسْعُ حُمُرٍ عُورَاءَ وَتِسْعٌ أَعْيَاءَ سَالِكَاتٍ وَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ لَفِي شَكٍّ مِّنْ أَمْرِهِمْ
ذَٰلِكَ وَإِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا أَنَّهُنَّ جَمَاعَاتٌ قَالُوا كَيْفَ نَقْتَلُ نَبِيًّاً وَإِنَّا لَفِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَكَلْنَاهُ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَنَصِيبٌ مَّقْرُونٌ
إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِي الزَّبُورِ مِن بَعْدِ الذِّكْرِ أَنَّ الْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِيَ الصَّالِحُونَ
إِنَّ فِي هَٰذَا لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى السَّمْعَ وَكَانَ شَهِيدًا
وَمَا جَعَلْنَا النَّومَ Death لِيَمَسَّهُ إِلَّا الْمُجْتَبَىٰ مِن رَّسُولِنَا وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِرَسُولِنَا الْمُجْتَبَىٰ مِن قَبْلِكَ شَيْئًا مِّنْ آلَةِ الْجَهَنَّمَ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِرَسُولِنَا الْمُجْتَبَىٰ مِن قَبْلِكَ طَائِرًا
ذَٰلِكَ وَإِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهُ بَشَرٌ مُّجَرَّبٌ وَلِسَانُ الَّذِي يُلْحِدُونَ إِلَيْهِ أَعْجَمِيٌّ وَإِنَّ هَٰذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِيٌّ مُبِينٌ
وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَعْتَدَىٰ فِي الْأَيَّامِ الْخَالِيَةِ وَهُوَ ظَالِمٌ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يُقَاتِلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَيَقْتُلُونَ وَيُقْتَلُونَ فَنَبْذُلُ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا كَبِيرًا
ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ فَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ إِلَّا كَافِرِينَ
وَمَا يُؤْمِنُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ بِاللَّهِ إِلَّا وَهُمْ مُشْرِكُونَ
أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ الْقُرْآنَ أَمْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَا
وَمِنْهُمْ أُمِّيُّونَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا أَمَانِيَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ يَكْتُبُونَ الْكِتَابَ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ ثُمَّ يَقُولُونَ هَٰذَا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ لِيَشْتَرُوا بِهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا فَوَيْلٌ لَهُمْ مِّمَّا كَتَبَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَوَيْلٌ لَهُمْ مِّمَّا يَكْسِبُونَ
وَقَالُوا لَنْ يَدْخُلَ الْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا مَنْ كَانَ هُودًا أَوْ نَصَارَىٰ تِلْكَ بِالْأَخِيرَةِ امْتِحَانُهُمْ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيَعْلَمُ الْمُبْطِلِينَ
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَالَّذِينَ هَادُوا وَالصَّابِئِينَ وَالنَّصَارَىٰ مَنْ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا فَأَخَذَهُمُ الطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ
فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَأَصْحَابَ السَّفِينَةِ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا آيَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا دَاوُودَ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ إِنَّكُمْ لَظَالِمُونَ
فَكَفَرَ بِهِ قَوْمُهُ فَأَحْبَطْنَا عَلَيْهِ الْعَمَلَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُ مِنْ اللَّهِ مِن وَالٍ وَمَا لَهُ مِنْ نَصِيرٍ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا سُلَيْمَانَ إِلَىٰ دَاوُودَ فَقَالَ يَا دَاوُودُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاكَ خَلِيفَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ فَاحْكُم بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ بِمَا نَسُوا يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ
وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لِدَاوُودَ سُلَيْمَانَ نَصِيرًا وَآتَيْنَاهُ الْحُكْمَ وَالْعِلْمَ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَمَنْ يَسْتَعْجِلْ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ عِقَابِهِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ حَبِيسًا مُبِينًا
وَلَقَدْ عَلِّمْنَاهُ صَنْعَةَ جِيلَانِكَ لِيُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا جَعَلْنَا لَهُ مِنَ الْجَوَارِي الْحُورُ الْعِينِ وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا رَبِّنَا أَعْلَمُ بِمَا ضَرَبْنَا بِهِ مِثْلًا وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ الْحَقَّ وَشَهِدَ رَسُولُهُ وَمَا أَنتَ بِمُعْجِزٍ لِمَنْ كَانَ فِي الْجَحِيمِ مُقِيمًا
وَلَقَدْ وَصَّيْنَا النَّبِيِّينَ وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَالْأَسْبَاطَ وَعِيسَى وَأَيُوبَ وَيُونُسَ وَهَارُونَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ وَآتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ زَبُورًا
وَرُسُلًا قَدْ قَصَصْنَاهُمْ عَلَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَرُسُلًا لَمْ نَقْصُصْهُمْ عَلَيْكَ وَكَلَّمَ اللَّهُ مُوسَىٰ تَكْلِيمًا
رُسُلًا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنْذِرِينَ لِئَلَّا يَكُونَ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَى اللَّهِ حُجَّةٌ بَعْدَ الرُّسُلِ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُ أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ وَزِيرًا
وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ يَا قَوْمِ إِنَّكُمْ ظَلَمْتُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ بِاتِّخَاذِكُمْ الْعِجْلَ فَتُوبُوا إِلَىٰ بَارِئِكُمْ فَاقْتُلُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ عِنْدَ بَارِئِكُمْ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِنَّهُ هُوَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالذُّنُوبِ وَإِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا مُجْرِمِينَ
وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي الْقُرْآنِ مَوْعِظَةً فَمَنْ شَاءَ ذَكَرَهُ
وَمَا جَعَلْنَا الْقِيَامَةَ إِلَّا وَاقِعَةً وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَجِّلِينَهَا وَقُلْ يَا قَوْمِ إِنَّمَا أَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ
فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا الْقَرْيَةَ الَّتِي ظَلَمَتْ فُوقًا سَافِلَةً وَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ أَنَّهُ كَانَ ظَالِمًا مُجْرِمًا
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا فَأَخَذَهُمُ الطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ بِالْحُجَّةِ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا مُجْرِمِينَ
فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَنْ كَانَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهِ غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مَّقْصُورٍ وَهَٰذَا لِنُثِيبَ أَشْرَفَهُمْ وَإِنَّ أَشْرَفَهُمْ لَأَفْضَلُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ لِمَنْ اتَّقَىٰ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَارُونَ بِآيَاتِنَا إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ فَقَالَا إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمَا قَالَا إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
قَالَ أَلَا تَخَافُونَ أَنَّهُ يَرْسُلَكُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ فَيُعَذِّبَكُمْ وَأَخَذَ بِيَدِ هَارُونَ وَأَلْقَاهُ فَقَالَ سَاحِرَانِ أَوْ مَجْنُونَانِ
فَأَرْسَلَ مُوسَىٰ بِآيَاتِنَا إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ فَإِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا عَادِينَ
فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ بِآيَاتِنَا قَالُوا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ
وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي النَّجْمِ لِرُسُلِنَا شِعَارًا فَمَا نَحْنُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنِّي أَنَا مَوْفِقُكَ فَاسْلُكْ بِرِجْلِكَ هَٰذَا مُغْرَقًا وَعَفَّانًا وَاقْتَلِفْ بِرِجْلِكَ يَا دَاوُودُ عَلَىٰ بَرَكَاتِنَا وَذَكِّرْ وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ وَيُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا
وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لِدَاوُودَ سُلَيْمَانَ نَصِيرًا وَآتَيْنَاهُ الْحُكْمَ وَالْعِلْمَ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَنَحْنُ نُنَزِّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةَ بِالْمُحْكَمِ وَمَا يَرَى الْمُجْرِمُونَ
وَلَقَدْ سَخَّرْنَا لَهُ الْرِّيَاحَ تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ رُخَاءَ بَيْنَ سَحَابَيْنِ وَآتَيْنَاهُ الْحُكْمَ وَالْعِلْمَ وَمِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ كُنَّا لَهُ نَصِيرًا
وَلَقَدْ عَلِّمْنَاهُ صَنْعَةَ جِيلَانِكَ لِيُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا جَعَلْنَا لَهُ مِنَ الْجَوَارِي الْحُورُ الْعِينِ وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا رَبِّنَا أَعْلَمُ بِمَا ضَرَبْنَا بِهِ مِثْلًا وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ الْحَقَّ وَشَهِدَ رَسُولُهُ وَمَا أَنتَ بِمُعْجِزٍ لِمَنْ كَانَ فِي الْجَحِيمِ مُقِيمًا

77. Do they not know that **GOD** knows everything they conceal, as well as everything they declare?

78. Among them are gentiles who did not receive any scripture. They hear of it only through hearsay, then assume that they know it.

79. Therefore, woe to those who distort the scripture with their own hands, then say, “This is what **GOD** sent,” seeking a cheap material gain. Woe to them for such distortion, and woe to them for their illicit gains.

**Eternity of Heaven and Hell**

80. They said, “Hell will not touch us, except for a limited number of days.” Say, “Have you taken such a pledge from **GOD**—and **GOD** never breaks His promise—or, are you saying about **GOD** what you do not know?”

81. Indeed, those who earn evil works, and become surrounded by their sins, will be the dwellers of Hell; they abide therein forever.

82. As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they will be the dwellers of Paradise; they abide therein forever.

**Covenant with Israel**

83. We made a covenant with the Children of Israel: You shall not worship except **GOD**. You shall regard the parents, the relatives, the orphans, and the poor. You shall treat the people amicably. You shall observe the contact prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat). But you turned away, except a few of you, and you became averse.

فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ يَكْتُبُونَ الْكِتَابَ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ ثُمَّ يَقُولُونَ هَٰذَا مِنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ لِيَشْتَرُوا بِهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا فَوَيْلٌ لَهُمْ مِمَّا كَتَبَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَوَيْلٌ لَهُمْ مِمَّا يَكْسِبُونَ

إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَسَبُوا السَّيِّئَاتِ وَأَحَاطَتْ بِهِمُ الْخَطِيئَةُ أُولَٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ

84. We made a covenant with you,
that you shall not shed your blood,
nor evict each other from your homes.
You agreed and bore witness.

85. Yet, here you are killing each other,
and evicting some of you from their homes,
banding against them sinfully and maliciously.
Even when they surrendered,
you demanded ransom from them.
Evicting them was prohibited for you
in the first place. Do you believe
in part of the scripture
and disbelieve in part?
What should be the retribution
for those among you who do this,
except humiliation in this life,
and a far worse retribution
on the Day of Resurrection?
**GOD** is never unaware
of anything you do.

86. It is they who bought this life
at the expense of the Hereafter.
Consequently, the retribution
is never commuted for them,
nor can they be helped.

*The Prophets of Israel*

87. We gave Moses the scripture,
and subsequent to him
we sent messengers.
And we gave Jesus, the son of Mary,
profound miracles, and supported
him with the Holy Spirit.
Is it not a fact that whenever
a messenger went to you
with anything you did not like,
you turned arrogant,
and either rejected him, or killed him?

88. They even said, “Our minds are made up!”
Instead, **GOD** is the One who placed a curse upon them,
as a consequence of their disbelief. This causes them
to stay in disbelief, excepting a few of them.

---

وإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَكُمْ وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَكُمُ الطُّرَ وَأَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكُمُ الْمَنَ وَالْأَنْزِلْتُمْ وَقُلْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَوْا فِيهَا وَاتَّبِعُوا سَبِيلِي أَسْغَرُ لَكُمْ قَالُوا لَنْ نَتَّبِعَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا تَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ آبَاءَنَا وَإِنَّنَا لَنَظُنَّكَ عَلَىٰ مَا تَقُولُ كَاذِبًا
وَقَالُوا لَا تَكْفُرُوا بِآلِهَتِنَا عَنْ عِبَادَتِهَا وَاتَّبِعُوا آلِهَةً غَيْرِهَا قُلْ سَيَكْفِيكُمْ عَذَابُهُمَا عَلَى اللَّهِ وَمَا هُم بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَأَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهِمْ رُسُلًا كُلَّمَا جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ بِمَا لَا تَهْوَىٰ أَنْفُسُهُمْ فَرِيقًا كَذَّبُوا وَفَرِيقًا يَقْتُلُونَ
وَقَالُوا قُلُوبُنَا غُلْفٌ وَاسْتَمَعُوا لَهُ وَهُمْ يُسَمِعُونَ
وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَكُمْ وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَكُمُ الطُّرَ وَقُلْنَا لَكُمْ دُخُلُوا الْبَابَ سَجْدًا وَقُلْنَا لَكُمْ اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
وَوَرِثَ آدَمُ وَحُوَّهُ مِنْ جَنَّةٍ وَكُلَّمَا خَلَا عَنْهُمَا الشَّيْطَانُ قَالَ لَهُمَا إِنِّي لَكُمْ مِنْ النَّاصِحِينَ
فَأَخْرَجَهُمَا مِنْهَا فَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ جَزَائِهِمَا أَنَّهُمَا كَانَا يَكْشِفَانِ عَنْ سَوْآتِهِمَا وَكَانَا يَقُولَانِ يَا أَبَانَا إِنَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
ثُمَّ أَخْرَجْنَا مَنْ كَانَ فِيهَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَاسْتَخْلَفْنَاهُمْ فِيهَا وَرَثْنَا لَهُمْ فِيهَا جَسَدًا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحُكْمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَاهُمْ مِنْ طَيِّبَاتِ وَضَرَّبْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مِثْلَ سَبْعِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَذَالِمُونَ
وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَكُمْ وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَكُمُ الطُّرَ وَقُلْنَا لَكُمْ دُخُلُوا الْبَابَ سَجْدًا وَقُلْنَا لَكُمْ لَا تَعْدُوا فِي السَّبْتِ وَأَخَذْنَا مِنْكُمْ مِيثَاقًا ذَلِكَ وَأَن تَقُولُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
وَلَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ إِبْرَاهِيمُ وَإِسْحَاقُ وَيَعْقُوبُ يَا بَنِيَّ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَى لَكُمُ الدِّينَ فَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ
أَمْ كُنْتُمْ شُهَدَاءَ إِذْ حَضَرَ يَعْقُوبُ الْمَوْتَ إِذْ قَالَ لِبَنِيهِ قُلْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ فَإِذَا أَنتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُمْ فِي الْغَمْرَةِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا نَجْنِي بِهِ مِنْهُمْ خَبِيرًا
وَلَقَدْ وَرَثْنَا الْقَوْمَ الَّذِينَ كَانُوا يُسْتَضْعَفُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَئِمَّةً وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ الْوَارِثِينَ
وَرَزَقْنَاهُمْ مِنْ طَيِّبَاتِ وَفَضَّلْنَاهُمْ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ مِنَّا فَضْلًا يَا جِبَالُ أَوِّي بِسَبْحِي وَالطَّيْرَ وَأَلَّمْنَاهُمْ بِسَبْحِي وَإِنَّ مِنْ عِبَادِي لِلْكَافِرِينَ ظَالِمِينَ
وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا لَهُمُ الْقَوْلَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَانُ دَاوُودَ وَقَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنْطِقَ الْطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْمُبِينُ
وَتَبَدَّلَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنَ الْقَوْلِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْحَقُّ وَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ عَلَىٰ مَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ
فَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَلَمَّنَاهُمْ بِسَبْحِنَا وَإِنْ يَسْمَعُوا لَا يَهْتَدُوا وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ فِيهِ خَالِدِينَ وَظَلَمُوا فِيهِ فَسَاءَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ هُدًى لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَلَّا تَتَّخِذُوا مِنْ دُونِي وَكِيلًا
وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ هَدْنَا وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَخَذَ الْعَذَابَ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ الْبَيِّنَاتِ وَأَيَّدْنَاهُ بِرُوحِ الْقُدُسِ وَلَئِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَيُثْبِتُنَّهُ وَيُمِيتُنَّهُ وَيُسْلِمُنَّهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيَتَّخِذَ مِنْهُ وَلِيًّا وَمَا كَانَ الْمَسِيحُ ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ أَبًا لِلَّهِ وَلَا الْمَسِيحُ مِنْ الْمَسِيحِينَ وَمَنْ يَتَّخِذِ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ وَالْأَنْبِيَاءَ أَرْبَابًا فَقَدْ كَفَرَ بِالْإِيمَانِ وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا أَمَرَنَا بِالْإِحْسَانِ إِلَى النَّاسِ وَإِقَامِ الصَّلَاةِ وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ وَذَلِكَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
وَلَقَدْ قَالَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَمُبَشِّرًا بِرَسُولٍ يَأْتِي مِنْ بَعْدِي اسْمُهُ أَحْمَدُ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالُوا هَذَا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ
وَلَقَدْ قَالَ مُوسَى يَا قَوْمِ إِنَّكُمْ ظَلَمْتُمْ أَنْفُسَكُمْ بِاتِّخَاذِكُمُ الْعِجْلَ فَتُوبُوا إِلَىٰ بَارِئِكُمْ فَاقْتُلُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ ذَلِكَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ عِنْدَ بَارِئِكُمْ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِنَّهُ هُوَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَكُمْ وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَكُمُ الطُّرَ وَقُلْنَا لَكُمْ دُخُلُوا الْبَابَ سَجْدًا وَقُلْنَا لَكُمْ لَا تَعْدُوا فِي السَّبْتِ وَأَخَذْنَا مِنْكُمْ مِيثَاقًا ذَلِكَ وَأَن تَقُولُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
وَلَقَدْ قَالُوا نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ أَعَدَّهَا اللَّهُ لِلْكَافِرِينَ
وَيَا قَوْمِ مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا وَلَا تَحْقِرُونَ النَّاسَ لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَبْعَثَكُمْ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ جَاءَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ
وَلَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ إِبْرَاهِيمُ وَإِسْحَاقُ وَيَعْقُوبُ يَا بَنِيَّ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَى لَكُمُ الدِّينَ فَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ
أَمْ كُنْتُمْ شُهَدَاءَ إِذْ حَضَرَ يَعْقُوبُ الْمَوْتَ إِذْ قَالَ لِبَنِيهِ قُلْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ فَإِذَا أَنتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُمْ فِي الْغَمْرَةِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا نَجْنِي بِهِ مِنْهُمْ خَبِيرًا
وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَكُمْ وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَكُمُ الطُّرَ وَقُلْنَا لَكُمْ دُخُلُوا الْبَابَ سَجْدًا وَقُلْنَا لَكُمْ لَا تَعْدُوا فِي السَّبْتِ وَأَخَذْنَا مِنْكُمْ مِيثَاقًا ذَلِكَ وَأَن تَقُولُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
وَلَقَدْ قَالُوا نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ أَعَدَّهَا اللَّهُ لِلْكَافِرِينَ
وَلَقَدْ قَالُوا لَنْ يَدْخُلَ الْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا مَنْ كَانَ هُودًا أَوْ نَصَارَىٰ تِلْكَ وَعْدُهُمْ بِأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ وَقَدْ كَذَّبَ اللَّهُهُمْ وَكَثِيرٌ مِنْهُمْ مُصْرِفُونَ
وَلَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ إِبْرَاهِيمُ وَإِسْحَاقُ وَيَعْقُوبُ يَا بَنِيَّ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَى لَكُمُ الدِّينَ فَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ
وَلَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ مُنَافِقِينَ
وَلَقَدْ كُنَّا نَأْتِيكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ فَلَمَّا جَاءَكُمْ زَبُورٌ قُلْتُمْ أَنَّهُ سِحْرٌ وَأَكْثَرْتُمْ فِي الْإِثْمِ

وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَكُمْ وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَكُمُ الطُّرَ وَقُلْنَا لَكُمْ دُخُلُوا الْبَابَ سَجْدًا وَقُلْنَا لَكُمْ لَا تَعْدُوا فِي السَّبْتِ وَأَخَذْنَا مِنْكُمْ مِيثَاقًا ذَلِكَ وَأَن تَقُولُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

*The Heifer (Al-Baqarah) 2:89-93*

**The Quran Consummates Previous Scriptures**

89. When a scripture came to them from GOD, confirming what they have, and even though they used to prophesy its advent to the disbelievers, when their own prophecy came to pass, they rejected it. GOD’s condemnation thus afflicts the disbelievers.

90. Miserable indeed is what they sold their souls for—disbelieving in GOD’s revelations, out of sheer resentment that GOD should bestow His grace upon whomever He chooses from among His servants. Consequently, they incurred wrath upon wrath. Such disbelievers have deserved humiliating retribution.

91. When they are told, “You shall believe in what GOD has sent down herein,” they say, “We believe only in what was sent down to us.” They reject subsequent revelation, even if it is the truth from their Lord, and even though it confirms what they have. Say, “(If you did believe in the revelations given to you,) why then did you kill GOD’s prophets, if you are truthful?”

**Lessons from Israel**

92. Moses went to you with profound miracles, yet you worshiped the calf in his absence, and you turned wicked.

93. Also, we made a covenant with you, as we raised Mount Sinai above you, saying, “You shall uphold the commandments we have given you, strongly, and listen.” But they said, “We hear, but we disobey.” Their hearts became filled with adoration for the calf, due to their disbelief. Say, “Miserable indeed is what your faith dictates upon you, if you do have any faith.”

Arabic Text:

وَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ كِتَابٌ مِّنْ عِندِ اللّٰهِ مُصَدِّقٌ لِمَا مَعَهُمْ وَكَانُوا مِن قَبْلُ يَسْتَفْتِحُونَ عَلٰى الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ مَآ وَعَدُوْا عَلٰى الْكُفْرِ انْتَقَمَ اللّٰهُ مِنْهُمْ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ عَزِيْزًا حَكِيْمًا

وَقَالُوْا قُلُوْبُنَا غُلْفٌ بِهَذَا وَسَمِعُوْا وَهُمْ مُعَندٌ مِّنْ حَقٍّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُوْنَ

وَقُلْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُحِبُّوْنَ اللّٰهَ فَاتَّبِعُوْنِي يُحْبِبْكُمُ اللّٰهُ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوْبَكُمْ وَاللّٰهُ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ

وَقُلْ اَطِيْعُوْا اللّٰهَ وَاَطِيْعُوْا الرَّسُوْلَ فَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْكَافِرِيْنَ

وَلَقَدْ اَخَذَ اللّٰهُ مِيثَاقَ بَنِيْ اِسْرَائِيْلَ وَبَعَثْنَا مِنْهُمْ اثْنَيْ عَشَرَ نَقِيْبًا وَقَالَ اللّٰهُ اِنِّى مَعَكُمْ لَاَكْمَلُوْا عَشْرِيْ فَاِنَّكُمْ لَا تُفْتَنُوْنَ اِلَّا وَاَنَا اَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ

وَلَمَّا اَخَذَ مُوْسٰى مِيثَاقَهُمْ قَالُوْا لَا نُؤْمِنُ لَكَ حَتّٰى نُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَآ اُوْتِيْتَ فَاِنْ كُنْتَ صَادِقًا فَاِنَّهُمْ لَمَّا جَاءَتْهُمْ الْحَقُّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوْا اِنَّهَا سِحْرٌ مُبِيْنٌ

وَلَقَدْ اَخَذْنَا مِنْهُمْ مِيثَاقًا فَاِنَّهُمْ لَمَّا نَقَضُوْا مِيثَاقَهُمْ وَكَانُوْا بِاٰيَاتِ اللّٰهِ يَتَكَفَّرُوْنَ

وَلَقَدْ قَالُوْا يَا مُوْسٰى لَنْ نُؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتّٰى نَرَى اللّٰهَ جَهْرَةً فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّاعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُوْنَ

وَلَقَدْ جِئْتُمْ مِّنْ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ قَالُوْا اِنَّآ اَمَرْنَا اَنْ نَّسْمَعَ وَاِنَّآ اَمَرْنَا بِالْعَمَىٰ فَاِنَّهُمْ قَدْ اَضَلُّوْا وَاِنَّهُمْ كَاذِبُوْنَ

**The Heifer (Al-Baqarah) 2:102-105**

**Witchcraft Condemned**

102. They pursued what the devils told them concerning the powers of Solomon. Solomon, however, was not a disbeliever, while the devils are disbelievers. Thus, they taught the people witchcraft that was sent down through the two angels of Babel, Haroot and Maroot. These two did not divulge such knowledge without pointing out that:
   "This is a test. You shall not abuse such knowledge."
   But the people used it in such evil schemes as the breaking up of marriages. They can never harm anyone against the will of **GOD**. They learn only what hurts them, not what benefits them. And they knew full well that whoever practices such evil will have no share in the Hereafter. Miserable indeed is what they sold their souls for, if they only knew.

103. Had they believed and led a righteous life, the reward from **GOD** would have been far better, if they only knew.

**Twisting the Words of Supplication**

104. O you who believe, do not say, "Ra‘ena" (be our shepherd); you should say, "Unzurna" (watch over us), and listen. The disbelievers have incurred a painful retribution.

**Jealousy Condemned**

105. Neither the disbelievers among the followers of the scripture, nor the idol worshipers, wish to see any blessings come your way from your Lord. However, **GOD** showers His blessings upon whoever He chooses. **GOD** possesses infinite grace.

120. Neither the Jews, nor the Christians, will accept you, unless you follow their religion. Say, **"GOD’s guidance is the real guidance."**
   If you acquiesce to their wishes, despite the knowledge you have received herein, you will find no ally or supporter to help you against **GOD**.

121. Those who received the scripture, and know it as it should be known, will believe in this. As for those who disbelieve, they are the losers.

122. O Children of Israel, remember the favors I bestowed upon you, and that I blessed you more than any other people.

123. Beware of the day when no soul can help another soul, no ransom can be paid, no intercession can be useful, and no one can receive any help.

**Abraham**

124. Abraham was put to the test through certain commands, and he fulfilled them. **(God)** then said, **"I am appointing you an imam for the people."** He said, **"And also my descendants?"** He said, **"My pledge does not include the transgressors."**

125. We have rendered the Ka‘aba shrine a focal point for the people, and a safe sanctuary. You may use Abraham’s station as a prayer house. We commissioned Abraham and Ismail: **"The two of you shall purify My house for those who visit it, those who retreat therein, and those who bow and prostrate."**

126. Abraham prayed: **"My Lord, make this a peaceful land, and provide its people with fruits. Provide for those who believe in GOD and the Last Day."** **(God)** said, **"I will also provide for the one who disbelieves. I will let him enjoy, temporarily, then commit him to the retribution of Hell, and a miserable destiny."**

**The Heifer (Al-Baqarah) 2:127-134**

*Abraham Receives All Rites and Duties of Islam*

127. As Abraham raised the foundations of the shrine, together with Ismail, they prayed: “Our Lord, accept from us; you are the Hearer, the Omniscient.

128. “Our Lord, and make us Muslims (submitters) to You, and from our descendants let there be a nation of Muslims. Teach us the rites of our religion, and redeem us. You are the Redeemer, Most Merciful.

129. “Our Lord, and raise among them a messenger to recite to them Your revelations, and to teach them the scripture and wisdom, and to purify them. You are the Almighty, Most Wise.”

130. Who would forsake the religion of Abraham, except one who cheats his own soul? We have chosen him in this world, and in the Hereafter he will be among the righteous.

131. When his Lord said to him, “Submit,” he said, “I submit to the Lord of the universe.”

132. Moreover, Abraham exhorted his children to submit, and so did Jacob: “O my children, God has pointed out the religion for you; do not die except as Muslims.”

133. Had you witnessed Jacob on his death bed: he said to his children, “What will you worship after me?” they said, “We worship your god and the god of your fathers Abraham, Ismail, and Isaac; the one god. To Him we are Muslims.”

134. Such is a community from the past. For them is what they earned, for you is what you earned, and you are not answerable for anything they did.

---

*2:127-132 When the Quran was revealed, all rites and duties of the religion were already in existence. Note that the expression: “God has pointed out the religion for you” (2:132) consists of 19 Arabic letters, the word “God” is No. 78, and Verse 78 of Sura 22 informs us that Abraham is the father of Islam. See 22:78 and App. 9 & 26.

135. They said, “You have to be Jewish or Christian, in order to be guided.” Say, “Instead, we follow the religion of Abraham—monotheism—he never was an idol worshiper.”

**Do Not Make Any Distinction Among God’s Messengers**

136. Say, “We believe in **GOD**, and in what was revealed to us, and in what was revealed to Abraham, Ismail, Isaac, Jacob, and the Patriarchs; and in what was given to Moses and Jesus, and all the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction among any of them. To Him alone we are Muslims (submitters).”

137. If they believe in what you believe in, then they are guided. But if they reject it, then they are in opposition. **GOD** will suffice you against them; He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.

138. Such is **GOD**’s system, and whose system is better than **GOD**’s? “Him alone we worship.”

139. Say, “Why do you argue with us about **GOD**, when He is our Lord and your Lord; we are responsible for our deeds, and you are responsible for your deeds. To Him alone we are devoted.”

**Abolition of Bigotry and Prejudice\***

142. The fools among the people would say,
"Why did they change the direction of their Qiblah?"*

they will not follow your Qiblah.

after this knowledge has come to you, you will be a transgressor.

171. The example of those who disbelieve is like those who parrot what they hear of sounds and calls, without understanding. Deaf, dumb, and blind; they cannot understand.

**Only Four Meats Prohibited\***

172. O you who believe, eat from the good things we provide for you, and be thankful to **GOD**, if you do worship Him alone.

173. He only enjoins you from eating dead animals, blood, the meat of pigs, and animals dedicated to other than (their Creator) **GOD**. If one is forced (to eat these), without being malicious or deliberate, then he incurs no sin. **GOD** is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

174. Those who conceal what **GOD** has sent down of the scripture, and sell it for a cheap price, eat but fire into their bellies. **GOD** will not speak to them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them. They have incurred a painful retribution.

175. It is they who bought the straying at the expense of guidance, and the retribution at the expense of forgiveness. Therefore, they will have to endure Hell.

176. This is because **GOD** has revealed this scripture, truthfully, and those who dispute the scripture are the most ardent opponents.

**The Heifer (Al-Baqarah) 2:177-181**

**Righteousness Defined**

177. Righteousness is not turning your faces towards the east or the west. Righteous are those who believe in **GOD**, the Last Day, the angels, the scripture, and the prophets; and they give the money, despite loving it, to the relatives, the orphans, the needy, the traveling alien, the beggars, and to free the slaves; and they observe the contact prayers (*Salat*) and give the obligatory charity (*Zakat*); and they keep their word whenever they make a promise; and they steadfastly persevere in the face of adversity, hardship, and persecution. These are the truthful; these are the righteous.

**Equivalence is God’s Law\***

178. O you who believe, equivalence is decreed for you when dealing with murder; the free for the free, the slave for the slave, and the female for the female. If one is pardoned by the victim’s kin, an equitable compensation shall be paid. This is an alleviation from your Lord and mercy. Anyone who transgresses beyond this incurs a painful retribution.

179. Equivalence is a life-saving law for you, O you who possess intelligence, that you may be saved.

**Write A Will**

180. It is decreed herein that: when death approaches you, you shall write a will for the benefit of your parents and relatives, equitably. This is a duty upon the righteous.

181. If anyone alters a will he had heard, the sin of altering befalls those responsible for such altering. **GOD** is Hearer, Knower.

وَمَا كَانَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ لِيَنْفِرُوا كَافَّةً فَلَوْلا نَفَرَ مِنْ كُلِّ فِرْقَةٍ مِنْهُمْ طَائِفَةٌ لِيَتَفَقَّهُوا فِي الدِّينِ وَلِيُنْذِرُوا قَوْمَهُمْ إِذَا رَجَعُوا إِلَيْهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يُحَذِّرُونَ

وَلَوْلا نَفَرَ مِنْ كُلِّ فِرْقَةٍ مِنْهُمْ طَائِفَةٌ لِيَتَفَقَّهُوا فِي الدِّينِ وَلِيُنْذِرُوا قَوْمَهُمْ إِذَا رَجَعُوا إِلَيْهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يُحَذِّرُونَ

وَلَوْلا دِينُ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ حَقًّا لَّقَضَيْنَا بَيْنَكُمْ وَإِنَّ مِنَ اللَّهِ لَمَا يَسْتَوِي

وَلَوْلا كِتَابٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ سَابَقَ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِيمَا أَخَذْتُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

وَمَا كَانَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَيَنْفَعَهُمْ إِيمَانُهُمْ لَوْ أَمِنُوا وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ مُيْطِئًا لِلْكَافِرِينَ

وَلَا تَقُولُوا لِمَنْ يُقْتَلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَمْوَاتٌ بَلْ أَحْيَاءٌ وَلَكِنْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ

وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ بِشَيْءٍ مِنَ الْخَوْفِ وَالْجُوعِ وَنَقْصٍ مِنَ الْأَمْوَالِ وَالْأَنْفُسِ وَالثَّمَرَاتِ وَبَشِّرِ الصَّابِرِينَ

الَّذِينَ إِذَا أَصَابَتْهُمْ مُصِيبَةٌ قَالُوا إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ

أُولَئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَوَاتٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ وَرَحْمَةٌ وَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُهْتَدُونَ

وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِهِ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَى رَبِّهِ وَتَابَ وَعَبَدَ إِلَّا اللَّهَ فَلَهُ الرَّحْمَةُ وَكَانَ ذَلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرًا

وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا الْأَنْفُسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَمَنْ قُتِلَ مَظْلُومًا فَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لِوَلِيِّهِ سُلْطَانًا فَلَا يُسْرِفْ فِيهِ وَهُوَ مُنْتَصِرٌ

وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا مَالَ الْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَأَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ وَالْمِيزَانَ بِالْقِسْطِ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا وَإِذَا قُلْتُمْ فَاعْدِلُوا وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَى وَبِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ أَوْفُوا ذَلِكَ وَصَّاكُمْ بِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

وَلَا تَأْكُلُوا أَمْوَالَكُمْ بَيْنَكُمْ بِالْبَاطِلِ وَتُدْلُوا بِهَا إِلَى الْحُكَّامِ لِتَأْكُلُوا فَرِيقًا مِنْ أَمْوَالِ النَّاسِ بِإِثْمٍ أَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

وَلَا تَأْكُلُوا أَمْوَالَكُمْ بَيْنَكُمْ بِالْبَاطِلِ وَتُدْلُوا بِهَا إِلَى الْحُكَّامِ لِتَأْكُلُوا فَرِيقًا مِنْ أَمْوَالِ النَّاسِ بِإِثْمٍ أَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

**Footnote:**

*2:178 The Quran clearly discourages capital punishment. Every kind of excuse is provided to spare lives, even the lives of those who commit murder. Often, the victim’s kin may find it better for all concerned, under certain circumstances, to spare the life of the murderer in exchange for an equitable compensation. Additionally, capital punishment is not to be applied, for example, if a woman kills a man, or vice versa.*

191. You may kill those who wage war against you, and you may evict them whence they evicted you, for oppression is worse than murder. Do not fight them at the Sacred Mosque, unless they attack you therein. If they attack you, you may kill them. This is the just retribution for such disbelievers.

192. If they refrain, then **GOD** is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

193. You can also fight them to counter oppression, and to worship **GOD** freely. If they refrain, do not aggress, except against the aggressors.

194. Even during the Sacred Months, any aggression shall be met by an equivalent response. Thus, if they attack you, you may counter attack to inflict an equitable punishment. Observe **GOD**, and know that **GOD** is with the righteous.

195. You shall spend in the cause of **GOD**; do not throw yourselves with your own hands into destruction. You shall be charitable; **GOD** loves the charitable.

**Hajj & 'Umrah Pilgrimage\***

196. You shall observe the Hajj and 'Umrah pilgrimage for **GOD**. If you are prevented, you shall send an offering, (and observe the rituals wherever you are). Do not resume cutting your hair (the last ritual) until your offering has reached its destination. If you are ill, or suffering a head injury (that forces you to cut your hair), you shall expiate by fasting, or giving a charity, or some other form of worship. During the normal observance of Hajj, if you break the state of Ihram between 'Umrah and Hajj, you shall expiate by offering an animal sacrifice. If you cannot afford it, you shall fast three days during Hajj and seven when you return to your homes—thus completing ten—provided you do not live at the Sacred Mosque. You shall observe **GOD**, and know that **GOD** is strict in enforcing retribution.

**The Heifer (Al-Baqarah) 2:203-210**

**Last Rituals of Hajj**

203. You shall commemorate **GOD** for a number of days (in Mina); whoever hastens to do this in two days commits no sin, and whoever stays longer commits no sin, so long as righteousness is maintained. You shall observe **GOD**, and know that before Him you will be gathered.

**Appearances May Be Deceiving**

204. Among the people, one may impress you with his pious utterances in this world, as he calls upon **GOD** to witness his innermost thoughts, while he is a most ardent opponent.

205. As soon as he leaves, he roams the earth corruptly, destroying properties and lives. **GOD** does not love corruption.

206. When he is told, “Observe **GOD**,” he becomes arrogantly indignant. Therefore, his only destiny is Hell; what a miserable abode.

207. Then there is the one who dedicates his life to serve **GOD**; **GOD** is compassionate towards the worshipers.

208. O you who believe, enter into total submission, and do not follow the steps of Satan; he is your most ardent enemy.

209. If you backslide, despite these clear revelations, then know that **GOD** is Almighty, Most Wise.

210. Are they waiting until **GOD** comes to them in dense clouds, together with the angels? The whole matter will then be terminated, and to **GOD** everything will be returned.*

---
*2:210 If God and His angels show up, everyone will believe, and the test will no longer be valid. This world is a test; it is our last chance to redeem ourselves by denouncing Satan’s challenge and upholding God’s absolute authority (see the INTRODUCTION).

وَأَذَٰنًا لِّّلنَّاسِ وَأَنَاخَهُمْ فِيهِ وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا
وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ يَقُولُ إِنَّمَا أُوتِيتُ هَٰذَا بِسِحْرٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا مُخْتَلِفُونَ
وَمَا أَتَىٰهُم مِّنْ ذِكْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ مُّحْكَمًا
وَمَا كَانَ الْكَافِرُونَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِالسِّينَةِ وَقُلْنَا إِنَّكُمْ لَمِنَ الْمُوسِرِينَ
إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهِمْ فِتْيَةً فَقَالُوا إِنَّا إِلَيْكُمْ مُرْسَلُونَ
فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ رَسُلَيْنِ إِلَىٰ مَدِينَةٍ بَيْنَهُمَا فَقَالَا إِنَّا لَكُمْ لَرَسُولَانِ
فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىَ إِسْرَائِيلَ
قَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَأْذَنْ لَكُمْ ذَٰلِكَ وَإِنَّ كِيدَ كَيْدِهِ كَانَ ضِيقًا
قَالَا إِنَّا قَدْ وَقَعَ عَلَيْنَا كِذَّبُهُ وَإِنَّهُ لَفِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ
قَالَ فَمَا رَبُّكُمَا قَالَ رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا رَبُّكُمَا بِالْغَافِلِينَ
قَالَ أَلَا تَتَّقِيَانِ أَن تَأْتِيَ فِرْعَوْنَ فَيُصْبِحَكُمَا مِنْ الْمَسْحُوقِينَ
قَالَ أَلَا تَخَافَانِ اللَّهَ وَتُخْزِيَانِ عِنْدَهُ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ رَبُّنَا بِمُحْصِي الْخَلْقِ وَأَنَّهُ عَلَّمَنَا مَا لَمْ نَعْلَمْ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ
وَقَالَا يَا مُوسَى إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ مُتِّينٌ بِسُلْطَانِهِ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّهُ لَا يُهْلِكُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
فَأَتْيْنَا فِرْعَوْنَ بِآيَاتِنَا فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

**The Heifer (Al-Baqarah) 2:211-215**

**Manifested Miracles Bring Greater Responsibility\***

211. Ask the Children of Israel how many profound miracles have we shown them! For those who disregard **GOD**’s blessings that have been manifested to them, **GOD** is most strict in retribution.

212. Adorned for the disbelievers is this worldly life, and they mock those who believed. However, the righteous will be far above them on the Day of Resurrection. **GOD** endows whomever He wills, without limits.

213. The people used to be one community, until **GOD** sent the prophets, as bearers of good news, as well as warn­ers, and He revealed through them the scripture, truthfully, to judge among the people in their disputes. But those who received the scripture rejected any new scripture, despite clear proofs, due to jealousy on their part. **GOD** guides those who believe to the truth that is disputed by others, as He wills. **GOD** guides whomever He wills in a straight path.*

214. Do you expect to enter Paradise without being tested like those before you? They were afflicted with hardship and adversity, and were shaken up until the messenger and those who believed with him said, “Where is **GOD**’s victory?” **GOD**’s victory is always near.

215. They ask you about charity; say, “Whatever charity you give shall go to the parents, the relatives, the orphans, the poor, and the traveling alien.” Any good you do, **GOD** is fully aware thereof.

**Arabic Text:**

سَلْبِئِسْرَائِيلَ كَمْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنْ ءَايَاتٍ ۖ وَمَن يُكْفِرْ بِهَا فَإِنَّهُ مِنۡ عَدُوِّ اللَّهِ ۗ أَلاَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ

وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَـٰقِفَةُ ۖ وَكَذَّبُوا بِهَا ۖ وَهُمْ مُّشْرِكُونَ

كَانُواْ قَوْمًا وَاحِدًا فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَتَخَافُوهُ وَأَخْرِجُواْ مِنۡ أَرْضِهِم بِمَكْرٍ ۖ فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ ۖ فَإِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَأَيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِينَ

فَمَا كَانَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ

رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوْاْ كِتَـٰبًا مُّبَرَّكًا ٱلَّذِى بِهِۦ مُّحَمَّدٌ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ لِيُؤْمِنُواْ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَيَتَّبِعُواْ سَبِيلَ ٱلْأَمِينِ

وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُّوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًا

فَقُولُواْ تَعَالَوْاْ نَحْمِلْ عَلَيْكُمْ وَزِيرَتَكُمُ ٱلَّتِى لَكُمْ كَانَتْ تَمَنَّوْنَهَا وَإِنَّكُمْ لَفِىْ زَلَلٍ مُّبِينٍ

وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ رُشْدَهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَـٰلِمِينَ

إِذْ قَالَ لَهُ رَبُّهُ أَسْلِمْ فَسَلَمَ وَكَانَ هُوَ مُّحْسِنًا مُّؤْمِنًا

وَوَرِثْنَا بِهِۦ نَبِيًّا وَأَتْبَعْنَاهُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِ نَبِيًّا وَأَاتَيْنَاهُ مِن لُّدِّنَا وَرِثَةً وَعِزًّا

وَرَسُولًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

إِذْ قَالَ مُّوسَىٰ لِأَهْلِهِ إِنِّىْ ءَاتَيْتُكُمُ ٱلنَّارَ فَأَحْمِلُواْ إِلَيَّ مِن كُلِّ جِنْسٍ قَلِيلًا

وَوَصَّيْنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَأَوْلَـٰدَهُ وَإِسْرَائِيلَ كَمَا وَصَّيْتُ مُّوسَىٰ وَأَتَيْنَا مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْفُرْقَانِ لِيُؤْمِنُواْ بِهِۦ وَيَتَّبِعُواْ سَبِيلَ مُّحَمَّدٍ

وَقُلْنَا إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن عِندِنَا قَالُواْ لَوْلَا أُوتِينا مِثْلَ مَا أُوتِيَ مُّوسَىٰ وَمَا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَكْفُرُونَ

قُلْ مَنْ كَانَ فِىْ ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُّوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءً وَذِكْرًا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَامُواْ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

أُوْلَـٰئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَآءً بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ

وَقُلْنَا يَا مُّوسَىٰ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُؤْمِنُ مِن قَوْمِكَ إِلَّا قَوْمٌ قَلِيلٌ

فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلطَّاغُوتَ فَأَصْبَحُواْ فِيهِ عَـٰكِفِينَ

وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن عِندِنَا قَالُواْ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

وَقَالَ مُّوسَىٰ رَبِّ إِنِّىْ ءَاتَيْتُهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِن بَعْدِ مَا فَسَدَ بَيْنَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَعَفَوْاْ عَنِّىْ وَعَن قَوْمِىْ وَأَنْتَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ

وَقَالَ ٱللَّهُ هَـٰذَا قَرْيَةٌ كَانَتْ تُؤْمِنُ وَكَانَتْ تَخْشَىٰ وَتَخْشَى ٱللَّهَ وَتَخْشَى ٱلْأَخِرَةَ ۖ فَعَذَّبْنَـٰهَا بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكْسِبُونَ

216. Fighting may be forced upon you, though you do not like it. But you may dislike something which is actually good for you, and you may like something which is actually bad for you.
**GOD** knows while you do not know.

217. They ask you about fighting during the Sacred Months: say, “Fighting therein is a sacrilege. But repelling from the path of **GOD**, disbelieving in Him and in the sanctity of the Sacred Mosque, and evicting its people therefrom are greater sacrileges in the sight of **GOD**. For oppression is worse than murder.” They will continue to fight you in order to revert you from your religion, if they can. Those among you who revert from their religion, and die as disbelievers, have wasted all their works in this life and in the Hereafter. These will be dwellers of Hell, wherein they abide forever.

218. Those who believe, and those who immigrate and strive in the cause of **GOD**, have deserved **GOD**’s mercy. **GOD** is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

Intoxicants and Gambling Prohibited

219. They ask you about intoxicants and gambling:* say, “In them there is gross sin, and some benefits for the people. But their sin far outweighs their benefit.” And they ask you what to spend in charity: say, “The excess.” **GOD** thus clarifies the revelations for you, that you may reflect—

---

*2:219 The Arabic root word for “intoxicants” is “Khamara,” which means “to veil” or “cover.” Thus, any material that veils the mind is prohibited. The world now recognizes that the economic benefits reaped by the liquor industry and illicit drug dealers are not worth the traffic fatalities, devastating injuries, birth defects, brain damage to babies, family breakdowns, and other disastrous consequences of alcohol and drugs. Alcoholic beverages in the U.S. carry warnings from the Surgeon General. Check with Alcoholics Anonymous and Gamblers Anonymous for more information. See 5:90-91.

220. on this life and the Hereafter. And they ask you about the orphans: say, “Righteous upbringing is the best you can do for them. If you mix their property with yours, then treat them as members of your family.”
**GOD** knows the righteous from the wicked. Had **GOD** willed, He could have imposed harsher rules upon you. **GOD** is Almighty, Most Wise.

**Do Not Marry Idol Worshipers**

221. Do not marry idolatrous women unless they believe; a believing woman is better than an idolatrous, even if you like her. And do not give your daughters in marriage to idolaters, unless they believe. A believer is better than the idolater, even if you like him. Those people invite to Hell, while **GOD** invites to Paradise and forgiveness by His leave. He clarifies His revelations for the people, that they may remember.

**Menstruation**

222. They ask you about menstruation: say, “It is harmful. Therefore, avoid sexual intercourse with the women during menstruation, and do not approach them until they are over it. Once they are over it, you may have intercourse with them in the manner designed by **GOD**. **GOD** loves the repenters, and He loves those who are clean.”

223. Your women are the bearers of your seed. Thus, you may enjoy them however you wish, so long as you maintain righteousness. You shall observe **GOD**, and know that you will ultimately meet Him. Give good news to the believers.

**Do Not Take God’s Name in Vain**

224. Do not subject **GOD**’s name to your casual swearing, seeking a facade of righteousness and virtue, or put on a pious appearance among the people. **GOD** is Hearer, Knower.

**The Heifer (Al-Baqarah) 2:225-230**

225. **GOD** does not hold you responsible for the mere utterance of oaths; He holds you responsible for your actual intentions. **GOD** is Forgiver, Clement.

**Laws of Divorce**

226. Those who intend to estrange their wives shall wait four months (for cooling off); if they reconcile, then **GOD** is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

227. If they go through with the divorce, then **GOD** is Hearer, Knower.

228. The divorced women shall wait three menstruations (before marrying another man). It is not lawful for them to conceal what **GOD** has created in their wombs, if they believe in **GOD** and the Last Day. (In case of pregnancy,) the husband’s wishes shall supersede the wife’s wishes if he wants to remarry her. The women have rights, as well as obligations, equitably. Thus, the men’s wishes prevail (in case of pregnancy). **GOD** is Almighty, Most Wise.

229. Divorce may be retracted twice. The divorced woman shall be allowed to live in the same home amicably, or leave it amicably.* It is not lawful to take back anything you had given her, unless the couple fears that they may transgress **GOD**’s law. If there is fear that they may transgress **GOD**’s law, they commit no sin if the wife willingly gives anything back. These are **GOD**’s laws; do not transgress them. Those who transgress **GOD**’s laws are the unjust.

230. If he divorces her for the third time, it is not lawful for him to remarry her, unless she marries another man, and he divorces her. The first husband can then remarry her, so long as they observe **GOD**’s laws. These are **GOD**’s laws; He explains them for people who know.

---
*2:229 It is unlawful to throw a divorced wife into the street. Housing and alimony are among the divorcee’s rights (2:241).

لَا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ اللَّهُ بِاللَّغْوِ فِي أَيْمَانِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يُؤَاخِذُكُمْ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
وَالَّذِينَ يَبْغُونَ الزَّنَا فَعَلَيْهِمْ نِكَاحٌ أَوْ عِقَابٌ أَمَّنْ عَاقَبَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
وَالَّذِينَ يَنْعَقُضُونَ مَا أَلْزَمَهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ نِكَاحِهِمْ وَيَبْسُطُونَ مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ لِيُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ أُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْكَافِرُونَ
وَلَئِنْ طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَمَسُّوهُنَّ وَقَدْ فَرَضْتُمْ لَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةً فَنِصْفُ مَا فَرَضْتُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ يَعْفُونَ أَوْ يَعْفُوَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ عَقْدَةُ النِّكَاحِ وَأَنْ تَعْفُوا أَقْرَبُ لِلتَّقْوَى وَلَا تَنسَوُا الْفَضْلَ بَيْنَكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
وَلَئِنْ طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِنْ قَبْلِ الْوُطُءِ وَقَدْ فَرَضْتُمْ لَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةً فَنِصْفُ مَا فَرَضْتُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ يَعْفُونَ أَوْ يَعْفُوَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ عَقْدَةُ النِّكَاحِ وَعَفْوُكُمْ أَقْرَبُ لِلتَّقْوَى وَلَا تَنسَوُا الْفَضْلَ بَيْنَكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
وَلَئِنْ طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَتَمَسَّهُنَّ وَقَدْ حَدَّدْتُمْ لَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةً فَآتُوهُنَّ مَا حَدَّدْتُمْ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَهُ مَخْرَجًا وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ وَمَنْ يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا
وَالَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّونَ مِنْكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَاجًا يَتَرَبَّصْنَ بِأَنْفُسِهِنَّ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِنَّ فِيمَا فَعَلْنَ بِأَنْفُسِهِنَّ مِنْ عَفَّةٍ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ

**The Heifer (Al-Baqarah) 2:231-233**

**Women’s Rights Advocated**

231. If you divorce the women,
once they fulfill their interim (three menstruations),
you shall allow them to live in the same home amicably,
or let them leave amicably. Do not force them to stay, as a revenge.
Anyone who does this wrongs his own soul.
Do not take **GOD**’s revelations lightly,
and remember **GOD**’s blessings upon you,
and what He sent down to you of scripture and wisdom to teach you.
You shall observe **GOD**,
and know that **GOD** is fully aware of all things.

232. If you divorce the women,
once they fulfill their interim,
do not prevent them from remarrying their husbands, if they reconcile amicably.
This will be heeded by those among you who believe in **GOD** and the Last Day.
This is purer for you, and more righteous.
**GOD** knows,
while you do not know.

233. Divorced mothers shall nurse their infants two full years,
if the father so wishes. The father shall provide the mother’s food and clothing, equitably.
No one shall be burdened beyond capacity.
No mother shall be harmed on account of her infant,
nor shall the father be harmed on account of his infant.
If the father dies, his inheritor shall assume these responsibilities.
If the parents mutually agree to part,
after due consultation, they commit no sin by doing so.
You commit no sin by hiring nursing mothers,
so long as you pay them equitably.
You shall observe **GOD**,
and know that **GOD** is Seer of everything you do.

The Heifer (Al-Baqarah) 2:234-237

234. Those who die and leave wives, their widows shall wait four months and ten days (before remarriage). Once they fulfill their interim, you commit no sin by letting them do whatever they wish, equitably. **GOD** is fully Cognizant of everything you do.

235. You commit no sin if you declare your engagement to the women, or keep it secret. **GOD** knows that you will think about them. But do not meet them secretly, unless you have something righteous to discuss. Do not consummate the marriage until the interim is fulfilled. You should know that **GOD** knows your innermost thoughts, so observe Him, and know that **GOD** is Forgiver, Clement.

Breaking the Engagement

236. You commit no error if you divorce the women before touching them, or before setting the dowry for them. In that case, you shall compensate them—the rich as he can afford and the poor as he can afford—an equitable compensation. This is a duty upon the righteous.

237. If you divorce them before touching them, but after you had set the dowry for them, the compensation shall be half the dowry, unless they voluntarily forfeit their right, or the responsible party chooses to forfeit the whole dowry. To forfeit is closer to righteousness. Do not abandon the amicable relations among you. **GOD** is Seer of everything you do.

*The Heifer (Al-Baqarah) 2:238-245*

**You Shall Observe the Daily Contact Prayers (Salat)**

238. You shall observe the contact prayers (Salat), especially the middle prayer (the Afternoon Prayer), and devote your worship totally to GOD alone.

239. Under unusual circumstances, you may pray while walking or riding. Once it is safe, you shall commemorate GOD as He taught you what you never knew.

**Alimony For Widows and Divorcees**

240. For those who die and leave wives, a will shall provide their wives with support for one year, provided they stay within the same household. If they leave, you commit no sin by letting them do whatever they wish, so long as righteousness is observed. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.

241. The divorcees also shall be provided for, equitably. This is a duty upon the righteous.

242. GOD thus explains His revelations for you, that you may understand.

**Striving in the Cause of God**

243. Have you noted those who fled their homes, though they were in the thousands, fearing death? GOD said to them, “Die,” then revived them. GOD showers His blessings upon the people, but most people are not appreciative.

244. You shall fight in the cause of GOD, and know that GOD is Hearer, Knower.

245. Would you not lend GOD a good loan, to have it repaid to you multiplied manifold? GOD is the One who provides and withholds, and to Him you will be returned.

---

*2:238 All five prayers are found in 2:238, 11:114, 17:78, & 24:58. When the Quran was revealed, Salat had already been in existence (Appendices 9 & 15).*

**The Heifer (Al-Baqarah) 2:246-248**

**Saul\***

246. Have you noted the leaders among the Children of Israel after Moses? They said to their prophet, “If you appoint a king to lead us, we will fight in the cause of **GOD**.” He said, “Is it your intention that, if fighting is imposed upon you, you will not fight?” They said, “Why should we not fight in the cause of **GOD**, when we were evicted from our homes, together with our children?” Yet, when fighting was decreed for them, they turned away, except a few. **GOD** is fully aware of the transgressors.

247. Their prophet said to them, “**GOD** has appointed Taloot (Saul) to be your king.” They said, “How can he be our king when we are more worthy of kingship than he is? He is not even rich!” He said, “**GOD** has chosen him over you, and has blessed him with an abundance in knowledge and in body.” **GOD** grants His kingship to whomever He wills. **GOD** is Bounteous, Omniscient.

248. Their prophet said to them, “The sign of his kingship is that the Ark of the Covenant will be restored to you, bringing assurance from your Lord, and relics left by the people of Moses and Aaron. It will be carried to you by the angels. This should be a convincing sign for you, if you are really believers.”

**The Heifer (Al-Baqarah) 2:249-252**

**David and Goliath**

249. When Saul took command of the troops, he said, **"GOD** is putting you to the test by means of a stream. Anyone who drinks from it, does not belong with me, unless it is to taste a single sip." They drank from it, except a few. When he crossed it, together with those who believed, they said, "Now we lack the strength to face Goliath and his troops." Those who believed in meeting **GOD** said, "Many a small army defeated a large army by **GOD**’s leave. **GOD** is with those who steadfastly persevere."

250. When they faced Goliath and his troops, they prayed, "Our Lord, grant us steadfastness, strengthen our foothold, and grant us victory over the disbelieving people."

**The Believers Always Victorious**
**Victory Comes Only From God**

251. They defeated them by **GOD**’s leave, and David killed Goliath. And **GOD** granted him kingship and wisdom, and taught him as He willed. If it were not for **GOD**’s support of some people against others, there would be chaos on earth. **GOD**’s grace encompasses all creation.

252. These are **GOD**’s revelations. We recite them through you, truthfully, for you are one of the messengers.*

وَلَقَدْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ مِيثَاقَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَبَعَثْنَا مِنْهُمُ اثْنَيْ عَشَرَ نَقِيبًا وَقَالَ اللَّهُ إِنِّي مَعَكُمْ لَئِنْ أَقَمْتُمُ الصَّلَاةَ وَآتَيْتُمُ الزَّكَاةَ وَآمَنْتُمْ بِرُسُلِي وَعَزَرْتُمُوهُمْ وَأَقْرَضْتُمُ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا لَأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَلَأُدْخِلَنَّكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ فَمَنْ كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ مِنْكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ

وَلَقَدْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ مِيثَاقَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَبَعَثْنَا مِنْهُمْ اثْنَيْ عَشَرَ نَقِيبًا وَقَالَ اللَّهُ إِنِّي مَعَكُمْ لَئِنْ أَقَمْتُمُ الصَّلَاةَ وَآتَيْتُمُ الزَّكَاةَ وَآمَنْتُمْ بِرُسُلِي وَعَزَرْتُمُوهُمْ وَأَقْرَضْتُمُ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا لَأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَلَأُدْخِلَنَّكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ فَمَنْ كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ مِنْكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ

**The Heifer (Al-Baqarah) 2:253-256**

**Many Messengers/One Message**

253. We have blessed some messengers more than others. For example, GOD spoke to one of them. And we raised some of them to higher ranks. And we gave Jesus the son of Mary profound miracles, and supported him with the Holy Spirit. Had GOD willed, their followers would not have fought with each other, despite the clear proofs that came to them. Instead, they disputed among themselves; some of them believed, and some disbelieved. Had GOD willed, they would not have fought. But GOD does whatever He wills.

*The Myth of Intercession*

254. O you who believe, give from our provisions to you, before a day comes where there is no trade, no nepotism, and no intercession. The disbelievers are the unjust.

**God**

255. GOD: there is no other god besides Him, the Living, the Eternal. Never a moment of unawareness or slumber overtakes Him. To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on the earth. Who could intercede with Him, except in accordance with His will? He knows their past, and their future. No one attains any knowledge, except as He wills. His dominion encompasses the heavens and the earth, and ruling them never burdens Him. He is the Most High, the Great.

**No Compulsion in Religion**

256. There shall be no compulsion in religion: the right way is now distinguished from the wrong way. Thus, anyone who denounces the devil and believes in GOD, has gotten hold of the strongest bond that never breaks. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.

**The Heifer (Al-Baqarah) 2:257-259**

**Exiting Darkness, to the Light**

257. **GOD** is the Lord of those who believe;
He leads them out of darkness into the light.
As for those who disbelieve,
their lords are the devils;
they lead them out of the light into darkness.
They have deserved Hell,
wherein they abide forever.

**Abraham’s Debate**

258. Have you noted the one who argued with Abraham about his Lord, though **GOD** had given him kingship? Abraham said,
"My Lord grants life and death."
He said, "I grant life and death."
Abraham said, **"GOD** brings the sun from the east, can you bring it from the west?" The disbeliever was stumped. **GOD** does not guide the wicked.

**Lesson About Death**

259. Or the one who passed by a ghost town and wondered,
"How can **GOD** revive this, after it had died?" **GOD** then put him to death for one hundred years, then resurrected him. He said,
"How long have you been here?"
He said, "I have been here one day, or part of the day."
He said, "You have been here a hundred years.
Yet, look at your food and drink; they did not spoil. And look at your donkey—we thus render you a lesson* for the people.
Note how we construct the bones, then cover them with flesh."
When he realized what had happened,
he said, "Now I know that **GOD** is Omnipotent."

*2:259 The lesson we learn is that the time between death and resurrection passes like one night (see also 18:19-25 and Appendix 17).

**The Heifer (Al-Baqarah) 2:260-264**

**Every Believer Needs Assurance**

260. Abraham said, “My Lord, show me how You revive the dead.”
He said, “Do you not believe?”
He said, “Yes indeed, but I wish to reassure my heart.”
He said, “Take four birds, study their marks, place a piece of each bird on top of a hill, then call them to you; they will come to you in a hurry. And know that **GOD** is Almighty, Most Wise.”

**The Best Investment**

261. The example of those who spend their money in the cause of **GOD** is that of a grain that produces seven spikes, with a hundred grains in each spike. And **GOD** multiplies this manifold for whomever He wills. **GOD** is Bounteous, Knower.

262. Those who give their money in the cause of **GOD**, then do not follow their charity with insult or reproach, will receive their recompense from their Lord; they have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.

263. Kind words and compassion are better than a charity that is followed by insult. **GOD** is Rich, Clement.

264. O you who believe, do not nullify your charities by inflicting insult and harm. As for those who spend their money to show off, while disbelieving in **GOD** and the Last Day, their example is like a rock that is covered with a thin layer of soil; when heavy rain falls, the soil washes off, leaving the rock barren and useless. Thus, they gain nothing from their efforts. **GOD** does not guide the disbelieving people.

The Heifer (Al-Baqarah) 2:265-269

265. The example of those who give their money seeking GOD’s pleasure, and in response to their own convictions, is that of a high fertile soil; when heavy rain falls, it produces twice the yield. If heavy rain is not available, a drizzle will suffice. GOD is Seer of everything you do.

266. Does any of you wish to own a garden of palm trees and grapes, with flowing streams, and generous crops, then, just as he grows older, with children who are still dependent on him, a holocaust strikes and burns up his garden? GOD thus clarifies the revelations for you, that you may reflect.

وَمَثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ ابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاتِ اللَّهِ وَتَثْبِيتًا مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ كَمَثَلِ جَنَّةٍ بِرِكَابٍ أَصَابَهَا وَابِلٌ فَأَصَابَ فَرُوعَهَا وَأَصَابَ مَا تَرَكَ مِنْ ثَمَرٍ فَقَدْ أَذِنَ اللَّهُ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ أَنْ يَكْتُبُوا لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا

267. O you who believe, you shall give to charity from the good things you earn, and from the products we provide for you from the earth. Do not pick out that which is bad to give away, when you yourselves would not accept it unless your eyes were closed. You should know that GOD is Rich, Praiseworthy.

لَكُمُ الْأَنْفَاقُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُونَ أَنْفُسَكُمْ بِهِ مِنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُونَهُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَحْسَنُ ثَوَابًا

268. The devil promises you poverty, and commands you to commit evil, while GOD promises you forgiveness from Him, and grace. GOD is Bounteous, Omniscient.

وَلَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَإِنْ تُبْدُوا مَا فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ يُحَاسِبْكُمْ بِهِ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ يَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

269. He bestows wisdom upon whomever He chooses, and whoever attains wisdom, has attained a great bounty. Only those who possess intelligence will take heed.

**God Witnesses Anonymous Charity**

270. Any charity you give,
or a charitable pledge you fulfill,
**GOD** is fully aware thereof.
As for the wicked,
they have no supporters.

271. If you declare your charities,
they are still good.
But if you keep them anonymous,
and give them to the poor,
it is better for you,
and remits more of your sins.
**GOD** is fully Cognizant
of everything you do.

**God is the Only One Who Guides**

272. You are not responsible
for guiding them.
**GOD** is the only one who guides;
He guides whomever He wills.
Any charity you give
is for your own good.
Any charity you give shall be
only for the sake of **GOD**.
Any charity you give will be
repaid to you, without
the least injustice.

273. Charity shall go to the poor
who are suffering
in the cause of **GOD**,
and cannot emigrate.
The unaware may think
that they are rich,
due to their dignified appearance.
You can recognize them by their marks;
they never engage in begging from the people.
Whatever charity you give,
**GOD** is fully aware thereof.

274. Those who give to charity night and day,
secretly and publicly,
receive their recompense from their Lord;
they have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
