## Page 66

Surely, those who believe and lead a righteous life, and observe the contact prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), will receive their recompense from their Lord; they have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.

278. O you who believe, observe GOD and refrain from all kinds of usury, if you are really believers.

279. If you do not, then expect war from GOD and His messenger. But if you repent, you may keep your capitals, without inflicting injustice, or incurring injustice.

280. If the debtor is unable to pay, you shall wait for a better time. If you forfeit the loan as a charity, it would be better for you, if you only knew.

281. Beware of the day when you are returned to GOD, then each soul is paid for everything it had earned, without the least injustice.

---

*2:275-278 If interest on loans or deposits is excessive, it constitutes usury. Many people do not possess the ability, energy, or know-how to invest their money. They do not commit any error by depositing their money with financial institutions, and earning interest. The institutions invest their money on their behalf. Financial institutions or individuals charging in excess of 15-20% interest Per Annum are committing usury.

**The Heifer (Al-Baqarah) 2:282**

**Write Down Financial Transactions**

282. O you who believe, if you transact a loan for any period, you shall write it down. Let an impartial scribe do the writing for you. No scribe shall refuse to perform this service, in accordance with GOD’s teachings. He shall write, while the debtor dictates the terms. He shall observe GOD his Lord, and never cheat.

If the debtor is mentally incapable, or helpless, or cannot dictate, his guardian shall dictate equitably. You shall have two witnesses from among your men. If two men are not available, then choose one man and two women* whose testimony is acceptable to all parties. Thus, if one woman becomes biased, the other will remind her. The witnesses shall not refuse to testify whenever needed. Do not tire of writing all the details, no matter how long, and write down the time of repayment. This is more equitable at GOD, assures better witnessing, and eliminates any doubts you may have in the future.

As for trade transactions that you execute on the spot, you need not record them, but have them witnessed. No scribe or witness shall be harmed on account of his services. If you harm them, it will be wickedness on your part. You shall observe GOD, then GOD will teach you. GOD is Omniscient.

---
*2:282 Monetary transactions are the only events where two women substitute for one man. If the witnesses were one man and one woman, the possibility arises that they may marry each other. In this case, the welfare of one party in the transaction may be jeopardized. Oppressive men tend to generalize this verse.

283. If you are traveling, and no scribe is available, a bond shall be posted to guarantee repayment. If one is trusted in this manner, he shall return the bond when due. He shall observe **GOD** his Lord. Do not withhold any testimony by concealing what you had witnessed. Anyone who withholds a testimony has a sinful heart. **GOD** is fully aware of everything you do.

284. To **GOD** belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. Whether you declare your innermost thoughts, or keep them hidden, **GOD** holds you responsible for them. He then forgives whomever He wills, and punishes whomever He wills. **GOD** is Omnipotent.

Do Not Make Any Distinction Among God’s Messengers

285. The messenger believes in what was sent down to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. They believe in **GOD**, His angels, His scripture, and His messengers: “We make no distinction among any of His messengers,” and they proclaim: “We hear, and we obey. Forgive us, our Lord. To You is the ultimate destiny.”

286. **GOD** never burdens any soul beyond its means: to its credit is whatever it earns, and against it is whatever it commits. “Our Lord, do not condemn us if we forget or make mistakes. Our Lord, and protect us from blaspheming against You, like those before us have done. Our Lord, protect us from burdens that are heavy beyond our capacity, pardon us, and forgive us. You are our Lord and Master, so grant us victory over the disbelieving people.”

# Sura 3: The Amramites (Aali-'Imraan) 3:1-9

**In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful**

1. A.L.M.*

2. **GOD**: there is no god except He; the Living, the Eternal.

3. He sent down to you this scripture, truthfully, confirming all previous scriptures, and He sent down the Torah and the Gospel—

4. before that, to guide the people. He sent down the statute book. Those who disbelieve in GOD’s revelations incur severe retribution. **GOD** is Almighty, Avenger.

5. Nothing is hidden from **GOD**, in the earth, or in the heaven.

6. He shapes you in the wombs as He wills. There is no god except He; the Almighty, the Most Wise.

7. He revealed to you this scripture, consisting of straightforward verses, which are the essence of the scripture, as well as multiple-meaning verses. Those who harbor doubt in their hearts will pursue the multiple-meaning verses to create confusion, and to seek different meanings. No one knows their true meaning except **GOD** and those who possess knowledge. They say, “We believe in this, for it all comes from our Lord.” Only those who possess intelligence will take heed.

8. Our Lord, let not our hearts waver after You have guided us, and shower us with Your mercy; You are the Grantor.

9. Our Lord, You will surely summon all the people on a day that is inevitable. **GOD** never breaks a promise.

**The Amramites (Aali-'Imraan) 3:10-15**

**Disbelievers: Always the Ultimate Losers**

10. Those who disbelieve cannot be helped by their money or children against **GOD**. They are the fuel of Hell.

11. Like Pharaoh’s people and others before them who rejected our revelations; **GOD** punished them for their sins. **GOD** is strict in enforcing retribution.

12. Say to those who disbelieve, “You will be defeated, then gathered in Hell; what a miserable abode!”

**Believers: The Ultimate Victors**

13. An example has been set for you by the two armies who clashed. One army was fighting in the cause of **GOD**, while the other was disbelieving. They saw them as twice as many with their own eyes. **GOD** supports with His victory whomever He wills. This should be a lesson for those who possess vision.

14. Adorned for the people are such pleasures as women, children, piles upon piles of gold and silver, trained horses, livestock, and crops. Such are the vanities of this world. **GOD** possesses a far better abode.

15. Say, “Let me inform you of something that is far better than that: for those who lead a righteous life, at their Lord, gardens with flowing streams, and pure spouses. They rejoice in **GOD’s** approval.” **GOD** is Seer of His worshipers.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن تُغْنِيَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَالُهُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَٰدُهُمْ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْئًا ۖ وَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمۡ وَقُودُ ٱلنَّارِ

يَٰأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقَالُوا۟ لِإِخْوَتِهِمْ وَقَعَدُوا۟ لَوْ أَطَاعُونَا مَا قُتِلُوا۟ وَقَاتَلُوا۟ وَقَالُوا۟ ٱللَّهُ يَرْزُقُهُمْ مِنْ طَيِّبَٰتِهِۦ ۗ إِن كَانُوا۟ حَقًّا فِيمَا قَالُوا۟ لَيَكُونَنَّ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ حَقًّا ۗ قَالُوا۟ لَئِنِ ٱنتَصَرْتُمْ لَيُفْسِدُنَّ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُرِيدُونَ أَن يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ

وَلَقَدْ خَبَّرَكُم مَّا أَخَذَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ مِّن قَرْيَةٍ عَظِيمَةٍ مَّرْجُوهَةٍ أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا كَانُوا۟ لِيُؤْمِنُوا۟ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِرُسُلِهِمْ فَأَحْبَطْنَٰهُمْ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِقَوْمِهِمْ لَعَلِيمًا

لَقَدْ كَانَ فِي قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌ لِّأُولِي ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ

مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَنْعِقُونَ بِمَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ إِلَّا دُعَآءً وَبَهِيمَةٍ مُسْتَنْفِرَةٍ أَعْمَىٰ وَأَضَلَّ سَبِيلًا ۚ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَذَكَّرْتُهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُذَكَّرُوا۟ إِنَّمَا يَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ وَهُمْ بِهِۦ مُشْرِكُونَ

وَلَقَدْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا كَانَ هَٰؤُلَاءِ لِيُؤْمِنُوا۟ ۖ كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ كُلَّمَا رُزِقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مِن ثَمَرَةٍ رِّزْقًا قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا مَا رُزِقْنَا مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَأُتُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُتَشَٰبِهًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا أَزْوَٰجٌ مُطَّهَّرَةٌ ۖ وَهُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

## Page 71

16. They say, “Our Lord, we have believed; forgive us our sins, and spare us the agony of the hellfire.”

17. They are steadfast, truthful, submitting, charitable, meditators at dawn.

*The First Pillar of Islam*

18. **GOD** bears witness that there is no god except **He**, and so do the angels and those who possess knowledge. He is the absolute god. There is no god except **He**, the Almighty, the Wise.

*Only One Religion*

19. The only religion approved by **GOD** is Islam. Those who received the scripture dispute this fact, knowingly. This is due to jealousy on their part. For those who reject **GOD**’s revelations, **GOD** is most strict in reckoning.

20. If they argue with you, then say, “I have submitted myself to **GOD**; me and those who follow me.” And say to those who received the scripture, as well as those who did not receive any scripture, “Do you accept Islam as your religion?” If they do accept Islam, then they are guided. If they turn away, then your sole mission is to deliver the message. **GOD** is Seer of all the people.

21. Those who reject **GOD**’s revelations and kill the prophets unjustly, and kill those who advocate justice among the people, promise them painful retribution.

22. It is these who nullify their works in this worldly life and in the Hereafter. They will have no helpers.

---
*3:18 The First Pillar of Islam is “Shahaadah,” professing that there is no other god besides God. The words of “Shahaadah” are decreed in this verse by God Himself: “La Elaaha Ella Allah.” Any other “Shahaadah,” proclaiming that Muhammad is God’s messenger is, by definition, idol-worship. It also violates the major commandments in 2:136, 2:285, 3:84, & 4:150-152 prohibiting any distinction among God’s messengers.

**The Amramites (Aali-'Imraan) 3:23-29**

**They Do Not Believe in the Eternity of Hell**

23. Have you noted those who were given part of the scripture, and were invited to uphold this scripture of **GOD**? Some of them have turned away in aversion.

24. This is because they said, "The hellfire will not afflict us, except for a few days." They were thus deceived in their religion, by their own fabrications.

25. How will it be for them when we summon them on that inevitable day? Each soul will then be paid for everything it had earned, and no one will be wronged.

26. Say, "Our God: King of all kingship. You grant kingship to whomever You will, and remove kingship from whomever You will. You bestow dignity upon whomever You will, and humiliate whomever You will. In Your hand is all bounty. You are Omnipotent.

27. "You merge the night into the day, and merge the day into the night. You produce the living from the dead, and the dead from the living. You provide for whomever You choose, without limits."

**Choose Your Friends Carefully**

28. The believers do not ally themselves with disbelievers instead of believers. Whoever does this does not belong with **GOD**, unless you are forced to do this under the scourge of severe persecution. **GOD** alerts you that you should beware of Him alone. To **GOD** is the ultimate destiny.

29. Say, "Whether you conceal your innermost thoughts, or declare them, **GOD** is fully aware thereof." He is fully aware of everything in the heavens and the earth. **GOD** is Omnipotent.

30. The day will come when each soul will find everything good it had done brought forth. As for the evil works, it will wish that they were farther removed than the east is from the west.
   **GOD** alerts you that you should beware of Him alone.
   **GOD** is Compassionate towards the worshipers.

31. Proclaim (O Quran): “If you love **GOD**, you should follow me.”
   **GOD** will then love you, and forgive your sins.
   **GOD** is Forgiver, Merciful.

32. Proclaim: “Obey **GOD** and the messenger.”
   If they turn away, then **GOD** dislikes the disbelievers.

   The Birth of Mary

33. **GOD** has chosen (as messengers) Adam, Noah, the family of Abraham, and the Amramites from among the people.

34. They are all related to each other.
   **GOD** is Hearer, Omniscient.

35. The wife of Amram said, “My Lord, I have dedicated (the baby) in my belly to You, completely, so accept from me. You are Hearer, Omniscient.”

36. When she gave birth to her, she said, “My Lord, I have given birth to a girl”—**GOD** was fully aware of what she bore—“The male is not the same as the female. I have named her Mary, and I invoke Your protection for her and her descendants, from Satan the rejected.”

37. Her Lord accepted her a gracious acceptance, and brought her up a gracious upbringing, under the guardianship of Zachariah. Whenever Zachariah entered her sanctuary, he found provisions with her. He would ask, “Mary, where did you get this from?”
   She would say, “It is from **GOD**.
   **GOD** provides for whomever He chooses, without limits.”

Arabic Text:
يَوْمَ تَبْيَضُّ وُجُوهٌ وَتَسْوَدُّ وُجُوهٌ فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ اسْوَدَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ أَكَفَرْتُمْ بَعْدَ إِيمَانِكُمْ فَذُوقُوا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ

وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ رَبَّنَا اسْتَجِبْ دُعَاءَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ

وَقُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ

وَقُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ

وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ رَبَّنَا اسْتَجِبْ دُعَاءَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ

وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا رَبَّنَا أَرِنَا الَّذَيْنَ أَضَلْنَا مِنْ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ نَجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِنَا لِنَكُونَ مِنَ الْغَالِبِينَ

وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ الْبَيِّنَاتِ وَأَيَّدْنَاهُ بِرُوحِ الْقُدُسِ وَلَئِنْ شِئْتُمْ أَن تُبْدُوا مَا فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ فَلَا تُبْدُوهُ وَلَئِنْ تُبْدُوهُ إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ سِرَّ الْغُيُوبِ

وَمَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا يَأْتِيهِ مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ ثُمَّ يُسْلَمُونَ إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ هُدًى لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا شُعَاعَ الشَّيْطَانِ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ

وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ زَبُورًا

وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَالْأَسْبَاطَ وَعِيسَى وَأَيُوبَ وَيُونُسَ وَهَارُونَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ وَآتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ زَبُورًا

وَرُسُلًا قَدْ قَصَصْنَاهُمْ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَرُسُلًا لَمْ نَقْصُصْهُمْ عَلَيْكَ وَكَلَّمَ اللَّهُ مُوسَى تَكْلِيمًا

وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لِرَسُولٍ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ بِآيَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ فَفِي ذَلِكَ فَتَحَ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَبِيلَ الْإِيمَانِ وَيَهْدِي بِهَا مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْهُمْ وَيَضِلُّ بِهَا الْكَافِرُونَ

وَمَا كَانَ رَسُولًا أَنْ يَأْتِيَ بِسَبْيٍ حَتَّى يُبَيِّنَ اللَّهُ الْفَتْحَ أَوْ يُخْزِيَ الْكَافِرِينَ بِمَا عَمِلُوا

وَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ إِنَّ الْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ زَبُورًا

فِي ذَلِكَ فَتَحَ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَبِيلَ الْإِيمَانِ وَيَهْدِي بِهَا مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْهُمْ وَيَضِلُّ بِهَا الْكَافِرُونَ

وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ هُدًى لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا شُعَاعَ الشَّيْطَانِ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ

وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ زَبُورًا

### The Amramites (Aali-'Imraan) 3:38-45

**The Birth of John**

38. That is when Zachariah implored his Lord:
   "My Lord, grant me such a good child;
   You are the Hearer of prayers."

39. The angels called him while he was praying in the sanctuary:
   **"GOD** gives you good news of John;
   a believer in the word of **GOD**,
   honorable, moral, and
   a righteous prophet."

40. He said, "Will I have a son despite my old age, and my wife’s sterility?" He said, "**GOD** does whatever He wills."

41. He said, "My Lord, give me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you do not speak to the people for three days, except by signals. You shall commemorate your Lord frequently, and meditate night and day."

**Jesus**

42. The angels said, "O Mary, **GOD** has chosen you; He has purified you, and has chosen you over all the women.

43. "O Mary, submit to your Lord, fall prostrate, and bow down with those who bow down."

44. This is news from the past that we reveal to you. You were not present when they drew their raffles to select Mary’s guardian. You were not present when they feuded among themselves.

45. The angels said, "O Mary, **GOD** gives you good news of a Word from Him whose name shall be ‘The Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary.’ He will be prominent in this world and in the Hereafter, and one of those closest to Me."

46. "He will speak to the people from the crib, and as an adult. He will be among the righteous."

47. She said, “My Lord, how can I have a son, when no man has touched me?”
He said, “GOD thus creates whatever He wills. To have anything done, He simply says to it, ‘Be,’ and it is.

48. "He will teach him the scripture, wisdom, the Torah, and the Gospel.

49. ‘As a messenger to the Children of Israel, he will proclaim:
‘I come to you with proof from your Lord; I create for you the shape of a bird, from clay, then I blow into it, and it becomes a live bird, by GOD’s leave. I restore vision to the blind, I heal the leprous, and I revive the dead by GOD’s leave. I can tell you what you ate, and what you store in your homes. These should be sufficient proofs, if you are believers.

50. ‘I am here to confirm the previous scripture, the Torah, and to revoke certain prohibitions imposed upon you. I come to you with proof from your Lord. Therefore, you shall observe GOD, and obey me.

51. ‘GOD is my Lord and your Lord;* you shall worship Him alone. This is a straight path.’ ”

52. When Jesus sensed disbelief on their part, he said, “Who are my supporters towards GOD?”
The disciples said, “We are GOD’s supporters; we believe in GOD, and bear witness that we are Muslims.

53. “Our Lord, we believe in what You have revealed,
and we follow the messenger, so write us among the witnesses.”

*The Death of Jesus*

54. They schemed, but so did **GOD**, and **GOD** is the best schemer.

55. Thus, **GOD** said, “O Jesus, I am terminating your life on earth,
raising you to Me, and ridding you of the disbelievers.
I will raise those who follow you, above those who disbelieve,
from now until the Day of Resurrection.
To Me is your ultimate return,
then I will judge among you
regarding everything you disputed.

56. “As for those who disbelieve, I will commit them to painful retribution
in this world, and in the Hereafter.
They will have no helpers.”

57. As for those who believe, and lead a righteous life, He will pay them
fully. **GOD** dislikes the unjust.

58. We recite for you in these revelations, a message
that is full of wisdom.

*Mathematical Confirmation*

59. The example of Jesus, as far as **GOD** is concerned, is the same as
that of Adam; He created him from dust, then said to him, “Be,”
and he was.

60. This is the truth from your Lord; do not harbor any doubt about it.

61. If anyone argues with you, after this knowledge has come to you, then say,
“Let us summon our children and your children,
our women and your women,
ourselves and yourselves, then let us invoke **GOD**’s curse upon the liars.”

يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْأَنفَالِ قُلْ ٱلْأَنفَالُ لِلَّهِ وَٱلرَّسُولِ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَصْلِحُوا۟ ذَاتَ بَيْنِكُمْ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

إِنَّمَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى فُسْرَةٍ مِّنْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـَٔلِحَـَاتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ

لَهُمْ مَّرْجِعُهُمْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُحَـَاجُّونَهُۥ عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ

وَيُحَـَاجُّونَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّهِ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

ذَٰلِكَ نَتْلُوۥهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْأَيَـَاتِ وَٱلذِّكْرِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ

مَثَلُ عِيسَىٰ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ ءَادَمَ خَلَقَهُۥ مِن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

إِنَّ ٱلْحَقَّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَلاَ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْمُمْتَرِينَ

وَمَن يُحَـَاجِّكَ فِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ فَقُلْ تَعَالَوْا۟ نَدْعُ أَبْنَآءَنَا وَأَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَنِسَآءَنَا وَنِسَآءَكُمْ وَأَنفُسَنَا وَأَنفُسَكُمْ ثُمَّ نَبْتَهِلْ فَنَجْعَلْ لَّعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلْكَـَاذِبِينَ

---

*3:54-55 We learn that Jesus’ soul, the real person, was raised; i.e., Jesus’ life on earth was terminated, and his enemies crucified his body, an empty shell (See Appendix 22).

*3:59 The similarity between the creation of Jesus and Adam is confirmed mathematically; both men are mentioned in the Quran the same number of times (25 times each).

101. How could you disbelieve, when GOD’s revelations are being recited to you, and His messenger is in your midst? Whoever holds fast to GOD has been guided in a straight path.

102. O you who believe, you shall observe GOD as He should be observed, and do not die except as Muslims.

Unity: A Trait of the Believers

103. You shall hold fast to the rope of GOD, all of you, and do not be divided. Recall GOD’s blessings upon you—you used to be enemies and He reconciled your hearts. By His grace, you became brethren. You were at the brink of a pit of fire, and He saved you. GOD thus explains His revelations for you, that you may be guided.

104. Let there be a community of you who invite to goodness, advocate righteousness, and forbid evil. These are the successful ones.

105. Do not be like those who became divided and disputed after the clear proofs had come to them. These have incurred a terrible retribution—

106. on a day when some faces will be brightened with joy, while other faces will be darkened with misery. As for those whose faces are darkened: “Did you not disbelieve after believing? Consequently, taste the retribution for your disbelief.”

107. As for those whose faces are brightened, they will rejoice in GOD’s mercy; they abide therein forever.

108. These are GOD’s revelations; we recite them to you, truthfully. GOD does not wish any hardship for the people.

109. To **GOD** belongs everything in the heavens and everything in the earth, and all matters are controlled by **GOD**.

*The Best Community*

110. You are the best community ever raised among the people: you advocate righteousness and forbid evil, and you believe in **GOD**. If the followers of the scripture believe, it will be better for them. Some of them do believe, but the majority are wicked.

111. They can never harm you, except for insults. If they fight you, they will turn around and flee. They can never be victorious.

112. Humiliation is their lot wherever they go, unless they abide by **GOD**’s covenant, and the people’s covenant. They incurred wrath from **GOD**. Consequently, they were committed to disgrace. This is because they rejected **GOD**’s revelations, and used to kill the prophets unjustly. This is because they disobeyed and transgressed.

*Righteous Jews & Christians*

113. They are not all the same; among the followers of the scripture, there are those who are righteous. They recite **GOD**’s revelations through the night, and they fall prostrate.

114. They believe in **GOD** and the Last Day, they advocate righteousness and forbid evil, and they hasten to do righteous works. They are with the righteous.

115. Any good they do will not go unrewarded. **GOD** is fully aware of who the righteous are.

116. Surely, those who disbelieve will never be helped by their money or their children against **GOD**. They have incurred Hell, wherein they abide forever.

117. The example of their spending in this world is like a violent wind that hits the harvest of people who wronged their souls, and wipes it out. **GOD** never wrongs them; it is they who wrong themselves.

**Do Not Befriend Hypocrites**

118. O you who believe, do not befriend outsiders who never cease to wish you harm, and wish to see you suffer. Hatred shows through their mouths, and what their chests hide is even worse. We have clarified the revelations for you, that you may understand.

119. Here you are loving them, while they do not love you, and you believe in all the scripture. When they meet you they say, “We believe,” then as soon as they leave they bite their fingers out of rage towards you. Say, “Die in your rage.” **GOD** is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.

120. When something good touches you they hurt, and when something bad happens to you they rejoice. If you steadfastly persevere, and maintain righteousness, their schemes will never hurt you. **GOD** controls everything they do.

**The Battle of Badr**

121. Recall that you (Muhammad) set out to assign to your people their position for battle, and **GOD** is Hearer, Omniscient.

_The Amramites (Aali-'Imraan) 3:122-132_

**God’s Angels: The Invisible Soldiers**

122. Two groups of you almost failed, and **GOD** was their Lord. In **GOD** the believers shall trust.

123. Thus, **GOD** gave you victory at Badr even though you were weak. You shall observe **GOD**, to show your appreciation.

124. You told the believers, “Is it not enough that your Lord supports you with three thousand* angels, descending?”

125. Yes; if you steadfastly persevere and maintain righteousness, then they attack you suddenly, your Lord will supply you with five thousand* angels, well trained.

126. **GOD** gives you this good news, to reassure your hearts. Victory comes only from **GOD**, the Almighty, Most Wise.

127. He thus annihilates some disbelievers, or neutralizes them, so they end up in failure.

128. It is not up to you; He may redeem them, or punish them for their sins.

129. To **GOD** belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. He forgives whomever He wills, and punishes whomever He wills. **GOD** is Forgiver, Merciful.

**Usury Prohibited***

130. O you who believe, you shall not take usury, compounded over and over. You shall observe **GOD**, that you may succeed.

131. Beware of the hellfire that awaits the disbelievers.

132. You shall obey **GOD** and the messenger, that you may attain mercy.

---

*3:124-5 Thirty different numbers are mentioned in the Quran. Their total comes to 162146, or 19x8534. This conforms with the Quran’s mathematical miracle.

*3:130 Banks invest, and their net return on investment is almost invariably positive. The profits are passed on to the depositors. Since all parties are happy and no one is victimized, it is perfectly lawful to take interest from the bank (see Footnote 2:275).

وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ آَمَنَ بِهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ صَدَّ عَنْهُ وَكَفَى بِجَهَنَّمَ سَعِيرًا

وَلَوْ تَرَى إِذْ زُلْزِلُواْ فِيهَا فَأَذَانُهَا يَوْمَئِذٍ حَاقِقٌ

وَلَا يُسْأَلُ عَنْهَا أَحَدٌ

وَمَا تَنْفَعُهُمْ شَفَاعَةٌ يَنْفَعُهَا وَمَنْ كَانَ بِالْخَيْرِ فَعَالَهُ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُولَئِكَ عَلَى هُدًى مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ وَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ

وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ

وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ الْقُرَى آمَنُواْ وَاتَّقَوْاْ لَفَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَرَكَاتٍ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَكِنْ كَذَّبُواْ فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكْسِبُونَ

وَلَا تَقْرَبُواْ الصَّلَاةَ وَأَنْتُمْ سُكَارَى حَتَّى تَعْلَمُواْ مَا تَقُولُونَ وَلَا جُنُبًا إِلَّا عَابِرِي سَبِيلٍ حَتَّى تَغْتَسِلُواْ وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ مَرْضَى أَوْ عَلَى سَفَرٍ أَوْ جَاءَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ مِنَ الْغَائِطِ أَوْ لَمَسْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَلَمْ تَجِدُواْ مَاءً فَتَيَمَّمُواْ صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا فَامْسَحُواْ بِوُجُوهِكُمْ وَأَيْدِيكُمْ إِنَّ اللّهَ كَانَ عَفُوًّا غَفُورًا

وَلَا تَلْبَسُواْ ثِيَابَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَأْتُونَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ وَلاَ تَقْتُلُواْ أَنْفُسَكُمْ إِنَّ اللّهَ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيمًا

وَلَا تَقْرَبُواْ مَالَ الْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَأَوْفُواْ الْكَيْلَ وَالْمِيزَانَ بِالْقِسْطِ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا وَإِذَا قُلْتُمْ فَاعْدِلُواْ وَكَانَ أَقْرَبَ لِلتَّقْوَى وَاتَّقُواْ اللّهَ وَاسْمَعُواْ وَأَطِيعُواْ وَأَنْفِقُواْ خَيْرًا لِنَفْسِكُمْ وَمَنْ يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ

وَلَا تَقْرَبُواْ مَالَ الْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَأَوْفُواْ الْكَيْلَ وَالْمِيزَانَ بِالْقِسْطِ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا وَإِذَا قُلْتُمْ فَاعْدِلُواْ وَكَانَ أَقْرَبَ لِلتَّقْوَى وَاتَّقُواْ اللّهَ وَاسْمَعُواْ وَأَطِيعُواْ وَأَنْفِقُواْ خَيْرًا لِنَفْسِكُمْ وَمَنْ يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ

**The Amramites (Aali-'Imraan) 3:133-140**

**Attributes of the Righteous**

133. You should eagerly race towards forgiveness from your Lord, and a Paradise whose width encompasses the heavens and the earth; it awaits the righteous—

134. who give to charity during the good times and the bad times. They are suppressors of anger, and pardoners of the people. **GOD** loves the charitable.

135. If they fall in sin, or wrong their souls, they remember **GOD** and ask forgiveness for their sins—and who forgives the sins except **GOD**—and they do not persist in sinful acts, knowingly.

136. Their recompense is forgiveness from their Lord, and gardens with flowing streams; they abide therein forever. What a blessed recompense for the workers!

**Victory for the Righteous**

137. Precedents have been set for you in the past, so roam the earth and see the consequences for the rejectors.

138. This is a proclamation for the people, a beacon, and enlightenment for the righteous.

139. You shall never waver, nor worry, for you shall be the victors, if you are believers.

140. If you suffer any hardship, the enemy also suffers the same hardship. We alternate the days of victory and defeat among the people. **GOD** thus distinguishes those who truly believe, and grants martyrdom to some of you. **GOD** does not love the unjust.

141. **GOD** thus toughens those who believe, and humiliates the disbelievers.

**Our Claims Must Be Tested**

142. Do you expect to enter Paradise without **GOD** distinguishing those among you who strive, and without distinguishing those who steadfastly persevere?

143. You claimed that you longed for death before you had to face it. Now you have seen it as you looked.

144. Muhammad was no more than a messenger like the messengers before him. Should he die or get killed, would you turn back on your heels? Anyone who turns back on his heels, never hurts **GOD** in the least.
**GOD** rewards those who are appreciative.

**Time of Death Predetermined**

145. No one dies except by **GOD**’s leave, at a predetermined time. Whoever seeks the rewards of this world, we give him therefrom, and whoever seeks the rewards of the Hereafter, we give him therefrom. We will reward those who are appreciative.

146. Many a prophet had godly people fight with him, and they never wavered because of suffering in the cause of **GOD**, nor did they hesitate or become discouraged.
**GOD** loves those who are steadfast.

147. Their only utterance was to say,
“Our Lord, forgive us our sins, and our transgressions, strengthen our foothold, and grant us victory over the disbelieving people.”

148. Consequently, **GOD** granted them the rewards of this world, and the better rewards of the Hereafter. **GOD** loves the good doers.

## Page 89

The Amramites (Aali-'Imraan) 3:154-157

---

**Moment of Death Fixed and Predetermined**

154. After the setback, He sent down upon you peaceful slumber that pacified some of you. Others were selfishly concerned about themselves. They harbored thoughts about GOD that were not true—the same thoughts they had harbored during the days of ignorance. Thus, they said, “Is anything up to us?” Say, “Everything is up to GOD.” They concealed inside themselves what they did not reveal to you. They said, “If anything were up to us, none of us would have been killed in this battle.” Say, “If you stayed in your homes, those destined to be killed would have crawled into their death beds.” GOD thus puts you to the test to bring out your true convictions, and to unveil what is in your hearts. GOD is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.

155. Surely, those among you who turned back the day the two armies clashed have been duped by the devil, due to some (evil) works they had earned. GOD has pardoned them. GOD is Forgiver, Clement.

156. O you who believe, do not be like those who disbelieved and said of their kinsmen who traveled, or mobilized for war, “Had they stayed with us, they would not have died or gotten killed.” GOD renders this a source of grief in their hearts. GOD controls life and death. GOD is Seer of everything you do.

157. Whether you get killed or die in the cause of GOD, the forgiveness from GOD, and mercy, are far better than anything they hoard.

158. Whether you die or get killed, you will be summoned before **GOD**.

159. It was mercy from **GOD** that made you compassionate towards them. Had you been harsh and mean-hearted, they would have abandoned you. Therefore, you shall pardon them, and ask forgiveness for them, and consult them. Once you make up your mind, then carry out whatever you planned to do, putting your trust in **GOD**. **GOD** loves those who trust in Him.

160. If **GOD** supports you, none can defeat you. And if He abandons you, who else can support you? In **GOD** the believers shall trust.

161. Even the prophet cannot take more of the spoils of war than he is entitled to. Anyone who takes more than his rightful share will have to account for it on the Day of Resurrection. That is when each soul is paid for whatever it earned, without the least injustice.

162. Is one who seeks **GOD**’s approval the same as one who incurs wrath from **GOD**, and his destiny is Hell and a miserable abode?

163. They certainly occupy different ranks at **GOD**. **GOD** is Seer of everything they do.

164. **GOD** has blessed the believers by raising in their midst a messenger* from among them, to recite for them His revelations, and to purify them, and to teach them the scripture and wisdom. Before this, they had gone totally astray.

165. Now that you have suffered a setback, and even though you have inflicted twice as much suffering (upon your enemy), you say, “Why did this happen to us?” Say, “This is a consequence of your own deeds.” **GOD** is Omnipotent.

**Humans Continue to Defy God**

181. **GOD** has heard the utterance of those who said,

   unless he produces an offering

   Say, “Messengers before me
   did come to you with clear proofs,
   even with what you asked for,
   so why did you kill them,
   if you are truthful?”*

184. If they reject you, messengers before you have been rejected.
   They brought proofs, the Psalms,
   and the enlightening scripture.

185. Every soul is destined to taste death, and you receive your recompense on the Day of Resurrection. The one who barely misses Hell, and gets admitted into Paradise, has attained a great triumph. The life of this world is no more than an illusion.

186. You will certainly be tested, through your money and your lives,
   and you will hear from those who received the scripture,

**The Amramites (Aali-'Imraan) 3:187-194**

**Do Not Conceal Any Scriptural Truths**

187. **GOD** took a covenant from those who received the scripture: "You shall proclaim the scripture to the people, and never conceal it." But they disregarded it behind their backs, and traded it away for a cheap price. Miserable indeed is what they traded it for.

188. Do not think that those who boast about what they give, and wish to be praised for something they have not really done, do not think that they can evade the retribution; they have incurred a painful retribution.

189. To **GOD** belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. **GOD** is Omnipotent.

190. Surely, in the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the alternation of night and day, there are signs for those who possess intelligence.

191. They remember **GOD** while standing, sitting, and on their sides, and reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth: "Our Lord, You did not create all this in vain. Be You glorified. Spare us the agony of Hell."

192. "Our Lord, whomever You condemn to Hell, You have forsaken. The wicked have no helpers.

193. "Our Lord, we have heard a caller calling to faith, that: 'You shall believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, forgive us our transgressions, remit our sins, and let us be among the righteous when we die.

194. "Our Lord, grant us what you promised us through Your messengers, and do not forsake us on the Day of Resurrection. You never break a promise."

**The Amramites (Aali-'Imraan) 3:195-200**

**God Responds**

195. Their Lord responded to them: “I never fail to reward any worker among you for your work, be you male or female; you are equal to one another. Therefore, those who immigrate, and those who are evicted from their homes—those who are persecuted because of Me—and those who fight and get killed, I will surely remit their sins and admit them into gardens with flowing streams.”
Such is the reward from **GOD**.
**GOD** possesses the best reward.

196. Do not be impressed by the apparent success of disbelievers.

197. They enjoy temporarily, then end up in Hell; a miserable destiny.

198. But those who observe their Lord have deserved gardens with flowing streams; they abide therein forever. Such is their abode from **GOD**. What **GOD** possesses is far better for the righteous.

**Righteous Jews and Christians**

199. Surely, some followers of the previous scriptures do believe in **GOD**, and in what was revealed to you, and in what was revealed to them. They humble themselves before **GOD**, and they do not trade away **GOD**’s revelations for a cheap price. These have deserved their recompense at their Lord. **GOD** is the most efficient in reckoning.

200. O you who believe, you shall be steadfast, you shall persevere, you shall be united, and you shall observe **GOD**, that you may succeed.

**Sura 4: Women (Al-Nesaa') 4:1-6**

---

**In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful**

1. O people, observe your Lord; the One who created you from one being and created from it its mate, then spread from the two many men and women. You shall regard **GOD**, by whom you swear, and regard the parents. **GOD** is watching over you.

2. You shall hand over to the orphans their rightful properties. Do not substitute the bad for the good, nor shall you consume their properties by combining them with your properties. This is a gross injustice.

**Grounds For Polygamy\***

3. If you deem it best for the orphans, you may marry their mothers—you may marry two, three, or four of them. If you fear lest you become unfair, then you shall be content with only one, or with what you already have. This way, you are more likely to avoid inequity.

4. You shall give the women their due dowries, fully. If they willingly forfeit anything, then you may accept it graciously.

5. Do not give immature orphans the properties that **GOD** has entrusted to you as guardians. You shall provide for them therefrom, and clothe them, and talk to them nicely.

6. And test the orphans; when you find them mature enough after reaching puberty, give them their properties. Do not consume them extravagantly, in a hurry, before they grow up. The rich guardian shall not charge anything, but the poor guardian may charge equitably. When you give them their properties, you shall have witnesses. **GOD** suffices as Reckoner.

---

وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا تُقْسِطُوا۟ فِى ٱلْيَتَٰمَىۤ فَٱنكِحُوا۟ مَا طَابَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ مَثْنَىٰ وَثُلَٰثَ وَرُبَٰعَۖ فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوا۟ فَوَٰحِدَةً أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُكُمْۗ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَدْنَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَعُولُوا۟

وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلنِّسَآءَ صَدُقَٰتِهِنَّ نِحْلَةًۚ فَإِنْ طِبْنَ لَكُمۡ عَن شَىْءٍ مِّنْهُۥ فَكُلُوهُ حَلَٰلًا وَمُتَرَكًا لَّكُمْ

وَلَا تُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلسَّفِيهِىنَ أَمْوَالَكُمُ ٱلَّتِى جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ قِيَٰمًا وَأَرْشِدُوهُمْۖ وَأَلْمُوسُوهُمْ بِهَاۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا تَفْعَلُونَ

وَٱخْتَبِرُوا۟ ٱلْيَتَٰمَىۤ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغُوا۟ ٱلنِّكَاحَ فَإِنْ آنَسْتُم مِّنْهُمْ رُشْدًا فَأَدُّوا۟ إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَالَهُمْۗ وَلَا تَأْكُلُوهَآ إِسْرَافًا وَبِدَارًا أَن يَكْبَرُوا۟ۗ وَمَن كَانَ غَنِيًّا فَلْيَسْتَعْفِفْۖ وَمَن كَانَ فَقِيرًا فَلْيَأْكُلْ حَلَٰلًا بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِۗ فَإِذَا أَدَيْتُمُوهَا فَٱشْهَدُوا۟ۗ وَشَهِدَ ٱللَّهُۗ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ حَسِيبًا

**Women (Al-Nesaa’) 4:7-11**

**Women’s Rights**

7. The men get a share of what the parents and the relatives leave behind. The women too shall get a share of what the parents and relatives leave behind. Whether it is a small or a large inheritance, (the women must get) a definite share.

8. During distribution of the inheritances, if relatives, orphans, and needy persons are present, you shall give them therefrom, and treat them kindly.

9. Those who are concerned about their own children, in case they leave them behind, shall observe **GOD** and be equitable.

10. Those who consume the orphans’ properties unjustly, eat fire into their bellies, and incur Hell.

**If No Will Is Left\***

11. **GOD** decrees a will for the benefit of your children; the male gets twice the share of the female. If the inheritors are only women, more than two, they get two-thirds of what is bequeathed. If only one daughter is left, she gets one-half. The parents of the deceased get one-sixth of the inheritances each, if the deceased has left any children. If he left no children, and his parents are the only inheritors, the mother gets one-third. If he has siblings, then the mother gets one-sixth. All this, after fulfilling any will the deceased has left, and after paying off all debts.

When it comes to your parents and your children, you do not know which of them is really the best to you and the most beneficial. This is **GOD**’s law. **GOD** is Omniscient, Most Wise.

**Women (Al-Nesaa') 4:15-19**

**Health Quarantine**

15. Those who commit adultery among your women, you must have four witnesses against them. If they do bear witness, then you shall keep such women in their homes until they die, or until **GOD** creates an exit for them.*

16. The couple who commits adultery shall be punished.*
   If they repent and reform, you shall leave them alone. **GOD** is Redeemer, Most Merciful.

**Repentance**

17. Repentance is acceptable by **GOD** from those who fall in sin out of ignorance, and repent immediately thereafter. **GOD** redeems them. **GOD** is Omniscient, Most Wise.

18. Not acceptable is the repentance of those who commit sins until death comes to them, then say, “Now I repent.”
   Nor is it acceptable from those who die as disbelievers.
   For these, we have prepared a painful retribution.

19. O you who believe, it is not lawful for you to inherit what the women leave behind, against their will. You shall not force them to give up anything you had given them, unless they commit a proven adultery. You shall treat them nicely. If you dislike them, you may dislike something wherein **GOD** has placed a lot of good.

وَالْخَامِسَةَ أَنَّ لَعْنَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ
وَدَخَلَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مِنْ نِسَائِكُمْ فَاسْتَشْهِدُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ أَرْبَعَةً مِنْكُمْ فَإِنْ شَهِدُوا فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ فِي الْبُيُوتِ حَتَّى يَتَوَفَّاهُنَّ الْمَوْتُ أَوْ يَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُنَّ سَبِيلًا
وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَاجَهُمْ ثُمَّ انْتَهَوْا مِنْ بَعْدِ ذَلِكَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَلَيْسَ لَهُمْ شُهَدَاءُ إِلَّا أَنْفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَادَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ
وَالْخَامِسَةَ أَنَّ لَعْنَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ
وَلَوْلا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ حَكِيمٌ
وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ حُرُمَاتِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ حِجَّةٍ لَهُمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَاجَهُمْ ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُونَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا اسْتُحْسِنُوا فَأَعْتَدُوا عَلَيْهِمْ شَهَادَةَ أَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءٍ فَإِنْ شَهِدُوا فَأَمْسِكُوهُمْ فِي الْبُيُوتِ حَتَّى يَتَوَفَّاهُمُ الْمَوْتُ أَوْ يَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ سَبِيلًا
وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَاجَهُمْ ثُمَّ انْتَهَوْا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَاجَهُمْ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِلْفَاحِشَةِ بَعْدَ مَا بَيَّنَ اللَّهُ لَهُنَّ حُدُودَهُنَّ فَأَعْتَدُوا عَلَيْهِمْ شَهَادَةَ أَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءٍ فَإِنْ شَهِدُوا فَأَمْسِكُوهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَكَانُوا مِنَ الْفَاسِقِينَ
وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُولُو الْفَضْلِ مِنْكُمْ وَالسَّعَةِ أَنْ يُؤْتُوا أُولِي الْقُرْبَى وَالْمَسَاكِينَ وَالْأَمِيرِ الْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَصُدُّوا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتَوُا الزَّكَاةَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

---

*4:15 A woman witnessed by four people in the act of committing adultery on four different occasions, with four different partners, represents a danger to public health. Such a woman is a depository of germs, and a health quarantine protects the society from her. A good example of an exit that saves a quarantined woman is marriage to one who may wish to marry her, and thus protect her and the society.

*4:16 Public exposure of the sinners is a major deterrent, as we see in 5:38 and 24:2.

**Women (Al-Nesaa') 4:20-23**

**Women’s Rights**

20. If you wish to marry another wife, in place of your present wife, and you had given the latter a great deal, you shall not take back anything you had given her. Would you take it fraudulently, maliciously, and sinfully?

21. How could you take it back, after you have been intimate with each other, and after they have taken from you a solemn pledge?

**Respect for the Father**

22. Do not marry the women who were previously married to your fathers—but do not break up existing marriages—for it is a gross offense, and an abominable act.

**Incest Forbidden**

23. Prohibited for you (in marriage) are your mothers, your daughters, your sisters, the sisters of your fathers, the sisters of your mothers, the daughters of your brother, the daughters of your sister, your nursing mothers, the girls who nursed from the same woman as you, the mothers of your wives, the daughters of your wives, with whom you have consummated the marriage—if the marriage has not been consummated, you may marry the daughter. Also prohibited for you are the women who were married to your genetic sons. Also, you shall not be married to two sisters at the same time—but do not break up existing marriages. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

وإِنَّ أَحَدَهُنَّ لَمَّا قَضَيْتُمْ بِهِنَّ مَتَاعًا مُّعَيَّنًا فَآتُوهُنَّ مَتَاعَهُنَّ كِتَابًا وَشَاهِدَ بَيْنِكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا الْقِسْطَ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بِالْقِسْطِ وَإِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُفْسِدِينَ

وَلَا تَنْكِحُوا مَا نَكَحَ آبَاؤُكُمْ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ سَلَفَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ فَاحِشَةً وَمَقْتًا وَسَاءَ سَبِيلًا

وَلَا تَنْكِحُوا بِنْتَكَ وَلَا تَبْنَتْ لَكَ وَلَا تَنْكِحُوا بَنَاتَ أَخِيكُمْ وَلَا بَنَاتَ أَخَوَاتِكُمْ وَلَا بَنَاتَ خَالِيكُمْ وَلَا بَنَاتَ عَمِّيكُمْ وَلَا بَنَاتَ خَالَتِكُمْ وَلَا بَنَاتَ أَمِّيكُمْ وَلَا صَدِيقَتَكِ الَّتِي لَمَسَتْ حَدَثَهَا وَإِنْ كُنَّ مُؤْمِنَاتٍ فَإِنْ تَزَوَّجْنَ فَآتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ كِتَابًا وَشَاهِدَ بَيْنِكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا الْحُدُودَ لِلَّهِ وَلَا تُعْتَدُّوا فِي أَمْوَالِهِنَّ وَإِنْ كُنَّ صَغِيرَاتٍ مُتَّقِينَ

وَلَا تَنْكِحُوا مَا نَكَحَ آبَاؤُكُمْ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ حَتَّى يَرْمَضْنَ وَإِنَّهُ لَقَوْلٌ فَاحِشٌ وَمَقْتٌ وَسَاءَ سَبِيلًا

*4:34 This is one of the most abused verses in the Quran. God prohibits wife-beating by using the best psychological approach. If I don’t want you to shop at Market X, I will ask you to shop at Market Y, then at Market Z, then, as a last resort, at Market X. This will effectively stop you from shopping at Market X, without insulting you. Similarly, God provides alternatives to wife-beating. This sura’s theme is “protection of women.”

**4:34 This expression simply means that God is appointing the husband as “captain of the ship.” Marriage is like a ship, and the captain runs it after due consultation with his officers. A believing wife readily accepts God’s appointment, without mutiny.**

**Women (Al-Nesaa') 4:45-51**

45. **GOD** knows best who your enemies are, and **GOD** suffices as Lord and Master. **GOD** is the best Supporter.

46. Among those who are Jewish, some distort the words beyond the truth, and they say, “We hear, but we disobey,” and “Your words fall on deaf ears,” and “Ra'aena* (be our shepherd),” as they twist their tongues to mock the religion. Had they said, “We hear, and we obey,” and “We hear you,” and “Unzurna (watch over us),” it would have been better for them, and more righteous. They have incurred condemnation from **GOD** due to their disbelief, which keeps the majority of them from believing.

47. O you who received previous scripture, you shall believe in what we have revealed herein, confirming what you have, before we banish certain faces to exile, or condemn them as we condemned those who desecrated the Sabbath. **GOD**’s commands are done.

**The Unforgivable Sin**

48. **GOD** does not forgive idolatry,* but He forgives lesser offenses for whomever He wills. Anyone who sets up idols besides **GOD**, has forged a horrendous offense.

49. Have you noted those who exalt themselves? Instead, **GOD** is the One who exalts whomever He wills, without the least injustice.

50. Note how they fabricate lies about **GOD**; this alone is a gross offense.

51. Have you noted those who received a portion of the scripture, and how they believe in idolatry and false doctrine, then say, “The disbelievers are better guided than the believers?!”

---
*4:46 The word “Ra'aena” was twisted by some Hebrew-speaking people to sound like a dirty word. See 2:104.

*4:48 Idolatry is not forgivable, if maintained until death. One can always repent from any offense, including idolatry (40:66).

---

52. It is they who incurred GOD’s condemnation,
and whomever GOD condemns, you will not find any helper for him.

53. Do they own a share of the kingship?
If they do, they will not give the people as much as a grain.

54. Are they envious of the people because GOD has showered them with His blessings? We have given Abraham’s family the scripture, and wisdom; we granted them a tremendous authority.

55. Some of them believed therein, and some of them repelled therefrom; Hell suffices them as a retribution.

56. Surely, those who disbelieve in our revelations, we will condemn them to the hellfire. Whenever their skins are burnt, we will give them new skins. Thus, they will suffer continuously. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.

57. As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, we will admit them into gardens with flowing streams; they abide therein forever. They will have pure spouses therein. We will admit them into blissful shade.

Honesty & Justice Advocated

58. GOD commands you to give back anything the people have entrusted to you. And when you judge among the people, you shall be fair. GOD enlightens you with the best commandments. GOD is Hearer, Seer.

59. O you who believe, you shall obey GOD, and you shall obey the messenger and those in charge among you. If you dispute in any matter, you shall refer it to GOD and the messenger, if you believe in GOD and the Last Day. This is better for you, and provides you with the best solution.

أَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَيُوَفُّونَ لَهُمُ الْأَجْرَ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ

أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا قَبْلَكَ مِنْهُمْ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ لَمْ نَقْصُصْ عَلَيْكَ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ بِآيَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ سُوءًا فَلَا مَرَدَّ لَهُ وَإِذَا أَرَادَ بِهِمْ خَيْرًا فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهُمْ وَهُمْ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ

أَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَعَلَيْهِمْ عَذَابٌ مِنَ الرَّجْفِ بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْفُرُونَ

وَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ إِنَّ الْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ النَّاسُ بِالْقِسْطِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا الْحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأْسٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَنَافِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَنْصُرُهُ وَرُسُلَهُ بِالْغَيْبِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَى بِآيَاتِنَا أَنْ أْتِ بِقَوْمِكَ فَأَذِنَ لَهُمْ فَإِذَا جَاءَهُمُ الْقَوْلُ الْبَاقِي لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا وَكَانُوا قَوْمًا مُجْرِمِينَ

فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ

وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ هُدًى لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا سَبِيلَ الشَّيْطَانِ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ

أَنْ لَا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا اللَّهَ إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ

فَقَالَ مَلَأُ الْقَرْيَةِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ قَوْلُ رَبِّهِ غَرَقْنَاهُمْ فَأَذْهَبْنَاهُمْ وَكَانَ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ قَبْلُ كَفَرُوا فَكَانُوا مِنَ الْمُهْلَكِينَ

**Women (Al-Nesaa’) 4:60-65**

**Believers Or Hypocrites?**

60. Have you noted those who claim that they believe in what was revealed to you, and in what was revealed before you, then uphold the laws of idolatry? They were commanded to reject such laws, but it is the devil’s wish to lead them far astray.

61. When they are told, “Come to what **GOD** has revealed, and to the messenger,” you see the hypocrites shunning you completely.

62. How will it be when a disaster hits them, as a consequence of their own works? They will come to you then and swear by **GOD**, “Our intentions were honorable and righteous!”

63. **GOD** is fully aware of their innermost intentions. You shall ignore them, enlighten them, and give them good advice that may save their souls.

**Unquestioning Submission: Quality of the True Believers**

64. We did not send any messenger except to be obeyed in accordance with **GOD**’s will. Had they, when they wronged their souls, come to you and prayed to **GOD** for forgiveness, and the messenger prayed for their forgiveness, they would have found **GOD** Redeemer, Most Merciful.

65. Never indeed, by your Lord; they are not believers unless they come to you to judge in their disputes, then find no hesitation whatsoever in their hearts in accepting your judgment. They must submit a total submission.

**Women (Al-Nesaa') 4:66-74**

**The Real Test of Belief**

66. Had we decreed for them: "Offer your lives," or "Give up your homes," they would not have done it, excepting a few of them. Had they done what they were commanded to do, it would have been better for them, and more strengthening.

67. We would have granted them a great recompense.

68. And we would have guided them in a straight path.

**Equality of Believers**

69. Those who obey GOD and the messenger belong with those blessed by GOD—the prophets, the saints, the martyrs, and the righteous. These are the best company.

70. Such is the blessing from GOD; GOD is the Best Knower.

71. O you who believe, you shall remain alert, and mobilize as individuals or mobilize all together.

72. Surely, there is always the one who drags his feet, then, if a setback befalls you, he says, "GOD has blessed me that I was not martyred with them."

73. But if you attain a blessing from GOD, he would say, as if no friendship ever existed between you and him, "I wish I were with them, so I could share in such a great victory."

74. Those who readily fight in the cause of GOD are those who forsake this world in favor of the Hereafter. Whoever fights in the cause of GOD, then gets killed, or attains victory, we will surely grant him a great recompense.

وَلَوِ أَنَّهُمْ أَصَابُوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ مَا نَقَضُوا عَهْدَهُمْ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ لَيَفْعَلُونَ

وَلَوْلاَ دَفْعُ اللَّهِ النَّاسَ بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍ لَّفَسَدَتِ الأَرْضُ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ

وَلَوْلاَ أَنَّهُمْ مُؤْمِنُونَ وَأَنَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ وَيَتَّبِعُونَ الرَّسُولِ لَمُعَذِّبْتُمُوهُمْ فِيمَا عَصَوْا ثُمَّ لَمُصْبِحُونَ

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ لاَ تَتَّخِذُواْ الْيَهُودَ وَالنَّصَارَى أَوْلِيَاءَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُم مِّنكُمْ فَإِنَّهُ مِنْهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ

تَرَى كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ وَأَكْلِهِمُ السُّحْتَ لَبِئْسَ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ

لَوْلاَ يَنْهَاهُمُ الرَّبَّنِيُّونَ وَالْأَحْبَارُ عَن قَوْلِهِمُ الْإِثْمَ وَأَكْلِهِمُ السُّحْتَ لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ لاَ تَأْكُلُواْ أَمْوَالَكُمْ بَيْنَكُمْ بِالْبَاطِلِ إِلاَّ أَن تَكُونَ تِجَارَةً عَن تَرَاضٍ مِّنكُمْ وَلاَ تَقْتُلُواْ أَنفُسَكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيمًا

وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ عَمْدًا فَإِنَّ لَهُ عَذَابَ النَّارِ وَمَا لَهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ مِن نَّصِيرٍ

وَمَن يَحْفَظْ مِنْ أَوْزَارِهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ

وَمَا لَكُمْ لاَ تُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ وَالْوِلْدَانِ الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ الظَّالِمِ أَهْلُهَا وَاجْعَلْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنْكَ وَلِيًّا وَاجْعَلْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنْكَ نَصِيرًا

فَالَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ قَاتَلُواْ وَكَانُواْ أَعَزَّ حِزْبًا

وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَقُولُ آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَبِالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ وَمَا هُم بِمُؤْمِنِينَ

يُخَادِعُونَ اللَّهَ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَهُمْ لاَ يَخْدَعُونَ إِلاَّ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ

فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ فَزَادَهُمُ اللَّهُ مَرَضًا وَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكْذِبُونَ

وَلَوْلاَ دَفْعُ اللَّهِ النَّاسَ بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍ لَّفَسَدَتِ الأَرْضُ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ لاَ تَتَّخِذُواْ الْيَهُودَ وَالنَّصَارَى أَوْلِيَاءَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُم مِّنكُمْ فَإِنَّهُ مِنْهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ

تَرَى كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ وَأَكْلِهِمُ السُّحْتَ لَبِئْسَ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ

وَلَوْلاَ أَنَّهُمْ مُؤْمِنُونَ وَأَنَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ وَيَتَّبِعُونَ الرَّسُولِ لَمُعَذِّبْتُمُوهُمْ فِيمَا عَصَوْا ثُمَّ لَمُصْبِحُونَ

وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُم مِّنكُمْ فَإِنَّهُ مِنْهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ

وَمَا لَكُمْ لاَ تُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ وَالْوِلْدَانِ الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ الظَّالِمِ أَهْلُهَا وَاجْعَلْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنْكَ وَلِيًّا وَاجْعَلْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنْكَ نَصِيرًا

فَالَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ قَاتَلُواْ وَكَانُواْ أَعَزَّ حِزْبًا

وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ وَهُوَ فِي أَمْرِهِ شَكٌّ يُقَرِّبُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ فَسَيَجْعَلْ لَهُ مَخْرَجًا

وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لاَ يَحْتَسِبُ وَمَنْ يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا

**Women (Al-Nesaa’) 4:75-79**

**The Believers are Fearless**

75. Why should you not fight in the cause of **GOD** when weak men, women, and children are imploring: “Our Lord, deliver us from this community whose people are oppressive, and be You our Lord and Master.”

76. Those who believe are fighting for the cause of **GOD**, while those who disbelieve are fighting for the cause of idolatry. Therefore, fight the devil’s allies; the devil’s power is nil.

77. Have you noted those who were told, “You do not have to fight; just observe the contact prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat),” then, when fighting was decreed for them, they feared the people as much as they feared **GOD**, or even more? They said, “Our Lord, why did You force this fighting on us? If only You respited us for a while!” Say, “The materials of this world are nil, while the Hereafter is far better for the righteous; you do not incur the slightest injustice.”

**Death Already Predetermined**

78. Wherever you are, death will catch up with you, even if you live in formidable castles. When something good happens to them, they say, “This is from **GOD**,” and when something bad befalls them, they blame you. Say, “Everything comes from **GOD**.” Is it not a fact that these people fail to understand any statement?

**Nothing Bad Comes From God\***

79. Anything good that happens to you is from **GOD**, and anything bad that happens to you is from you.*
We have sent you as a messenger to the people, and **GOD** suffices as witness.

---
*4:79 Bearing in mind that God is the ultimate doer of everything (4:78 & 3:17), bad things are strictly a consequence of our own deeds (42:30, 64:11).

وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا قَاتَلُوا وَهُمْ يُقَاتَلُونَ وَيَقُولُونَ هَذَا عَلَيْنَا حَقٌّ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ لَحَفِيظًا
أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ قِيلَ لَهُمْ كُفُّوا أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ فَلَمَّا كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقِتَالُ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمْ يَخْشَوْنَ النَّاسَ كَخَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ أَوْ أَشَدَّ خَشْيَةً وَقَالُوا رَبَّنَا لِمَ كَتَبْتَ عَلَيْنَا الْقِتَالَ لَيْسْنَا بِمُصْلِحِينَ قُلْ إِنَّ الْمَالَ وَالْبَنِينَ زِينَةُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ خَيْرٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ أَمَلًا
أَيْنَمَا تَكُونُوا يُدْرِكْكُمُ الْمَوْتُ وَلَوْ كُنْتُمْ فِي بُرُوجٍ مُشَيَّدَةٍ وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ حَسَنَةٌ يَقُولُوا هَذِهِ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ يَقُولُوا هَذِهِ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ قُلْ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ كَذَلِكَ يُخْرِجُ الْحَقَّ وَيُضِلُّ الْبَاطِلَ وَمَا أَنْتَ بِوَكِيلِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ بَلْ كُلُّ إِنْسَانٍ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَبِيبٌ
وَمَا أَصَابَكُمْ مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُو عَنْ كَثِيرٍ
وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَطِيعُونَ أَنْ تَلْبَسُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا تَنْشُؤُا فِيهَا سَبِيلًا وَمَا كَانَ لِلنَّاسِ أَنْ يَكُونُوا لَكُمْ إِمَامًا وَلَوْ أَرَادُوا الْهُدَى وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ لَتَأْثِمُونَ
وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُضِلَّ قَوْمًا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَاهُمْ حَتَّى يُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الْأَمْرَ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُضِلَّ قَوْمًا وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ

80. Whoever obeys the messenger is obeying **GOD**.
    As for those who turn away, we did not send you as their guardian.

81. They pledge obedience, but when they leave you,
    some of them harbor intentions contrary to what they say.
    **GOD** records their innermost intentions. Therefore, you shall disregard them,
    and put your trust in **GOD**. **GOD** suffices as an advocate.

    *Proof of Divine Authorship*

82. Why do they not study the Quran carefully?
    If it were from other than **GOD**,
    they would have found in it many contradictions.*

83. When a rumor related to security comes their way, they spread it.
    Had they referred it to the messenger, and those in charge among them,
    those who understand these matters would have dealt with it.
    If it were not for **GOD’s** grace towards you, and His mercy, you
    would have followed the devil, except a few.

84. You shall fight for the cause of **GOD**; you are responsible only
    for your own soul, and exhort the believers to do the same.
    **GOD** will neutralize the power of those who disbelieve.
    **GOD** is much more powerful, and much more effective.

    *Limits of Responsibility*

85. Whoever mediates a good deed receives a share of the credit thereof,
    and whoever mediates an evil work, incurs a share thereof.
    **GOD** controls all things.

    *You Shall Be Courteous*

86. When greeted with a greeting, you shall respond with a better greeting
    or an equal one. **GOD** reckons all things.

---

87. **GOD**: there is no god except He.
He will surely summon you
on the Day of Resurrection—an inevitable day.
Whose narration is more truthful than **GOD**’s?

**Response to Hypocrites**

88. Why should you divide yourselves into two groups
on account of the hypocrites?
**GOD** has condemned them
because of what they earned.
Do you want to guide those
who are sent astray by **GOD**?
Whomever **GOD** sends astray,
you can never find a way for him.

89. They wish that you disbelieve as
they have disbelieved, then you
become equal. Do not consider
them friends, unless they mobilize
for the cause of **GOD**. If they turn
against you, you may fight them,
and you may kill them when
you encounter them. You shall not
accept them as friends, or allies.*

90. Exempted are those who join
people with whom you have signed
a peace treaty, and those who come
to you wishing not to fight you, nor
to fight their people. Had **GOD**
willed, He could have permitted
them to fight against you.
Therefore, if they leave you alone,
refrain from fighting you, and offer
you peace, then **GOD** gives you no
excuse to fight them.

91. You will find others who wish to make peace with you,
and also with their people.
However, as soon as war erupts, they fight against you.
Unless they leave you alone, offer you peace, and stop fighting you,
you may fight them when you encounter them.
Against these, we give you a clear authority.

**Women (Al-Nesaa') 4:92-94**

**You Shall Not Kill**

92. No believer shall kill another believer, unless it is an accident. If one kills a believer by accident, he shall expiate by freeing a believing slave, and paying a compensation to the victim’s family, unless they forfeit such a compensation as a charity. If the victim belonged to people who are at war with you, though he was a believer, you shall expiate by freeing a believing slave. If he belonged to people with whom you have signed a peace treaty, you shall pay the compensation in addition to freeing a believing slave. If you cannot afford it, you shall expiate by fasting two consecutive months, in order to be redeemed by GOD. GOD is Knower, Most Wise.

**An Unforgivable Offense**

93. Anyone who kills a believer on purpose, his retribution is Hell, wherein he abides forever, GOD is angry with him, and condemns him, and has prepared for him a terrible retribution.

94. O you who believe, if you strike in the cause of GOD, you shall be absolutely sure. Do not say to one who offers you peace, “You are not a believer,” seeking the spoils of this world. For GOD possesses infinite spoils. Remember that you used to be like them, and GOD blessed you. Therefore, you shall be absolutely sure (before you strike). GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.

---

**Women (Al-Nesaa') 4:95-101**

95. Not equal are the sedentary among the believers who are not handicapped, and those who strive in the cause of **GOD** with their money and their lives. **GOD** exalts the strivers with their money and their lives above the sedentary. For each, **GOD** promises salvation. But **GOD** exalts the strivers over the sedentary with a great recompense.

96. The higher ranks come from Him, as well as forgiveness and mercy. **GOD** is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

**Apathy Condemned**

97. Those whose lives are terminated by the angels, while they are in a state of wronging their souls, the angels will ask them, "What was the matter with you?" They will say, "We were oppressed on earth." They will say, "Was **GOD**'s earth not spacious enough for you to emigrate therein?" For these, the final abode is Hell, and a miserable destiny.

98. Exempted are the weak men, women, and children who do not possess the means, nor can find a way out.

99. These are pardoned by **GOD**. **GOD** is Pardoner, Forgiver.

100. Anyone who emigrates in the cause of **GOD** will find on earth great bounties and richness. Anyone who gives up his home, emigrating to **GOD** and His messenger, then death catches up with him, his recompense will be granted by **GOD**. **GOD** is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

101. When you travel, during war, you commit no error by shortening your contact prayers (Salat), if you fear that the disbelievers may attack you. Surely, the disbelievers are your ardent enemies.

---

**Women (Al-Nesaa’) 4:102-105**

**Precautions Required**

102. If you are with them, and lead the contact prayer (Salat) for them, let some of you stand guard; let them hold their weapons, and let them stand behind you as you prostrate. Then, let the group that has not prayed take their turn praying with you, and let the others stand guard and hold their weapons. Those who disbelieved wish to see you neglect your weapons and your equipment, in order to attack you once and for all. You commit no error, if you are hampered by rain or injury, if you put down your weapons, so long as you remain alert. **GOD** has prepared for the disbelievers a shameful retribution.

103. Once you complete your contact prayer (Salat), you shall remember **GOD** while standing, sitting, or lying down. * Once the war is over, you shall observe the contact prayers (Salat); the contact prayers (Salat) are decreed for the believers at specific times.

104. Do not waver in pursuing the enemy. If you suffer, they also suffer, except you expect from **GOD** what they never expect. **GOD** is Omniscient, Most Wise.

105. We have sent down to you the scripture, truthfully, in order to judge among the people in accordance with what **GOD** has shown you. You shall not side with the traitors.

وإِذَا قُمْتُمْ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ فَاغْسِلُوا وُجُوهَكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ إِلَى الْمَرَافِقِ وَامْسَحُوا بِرُؤُوسِكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ ۚ وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ جُنُبًا فَاطَّهَّرُوا ۚ وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ مَرْضَىٰ أَوْ عَلَى سَفَرٍ أَوْ جَاءَ أَحَدٌ مِّنكُم مِّنَ الْغَائِطِ أَوْ لَمْ تَمَسُّوا النِّسَاءَ فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا مَاءً فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا فَامْسَحُوا بِوُجُوهِكُمْ وَأَيْدِيكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَفُوًّا غَفُورًا

واذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا

وَلِنُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الْآيَاتِ وَلِنْيَقُولُوا رَأَيْنَا وَقَدْ أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْنَا الْكِتَابُ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا

وَلِيَقُولُوا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِ ۚ قُلْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَذِنَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ بِالْغَيْبِ ۚ وَمَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِرَسُولٍ سَبِيلًا مِّن بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ الْهُدَىٰ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ مُبْتَلِيًا بِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ

*4:103 Your god is whoever or whatever preoccupies your mind most of the day. In order to belong in God’s kingdom, and enjoy His grace and protection, the Quran exhorts us to remember God “always” (2:152 & 200, 3:191, 33:41-42). This profound fact explains the numerous verses asserting that “most” of those who do believe in God are going to Hell (12:106, 23:84-89, 29:61-63, 31:25, 39:38, 43:87). See Footnote 3:191 and Appendix 27.

114. There is nothing good about their private thoughts, unless they advocate charity, or a righteous work, or conciliation among the people. Anyone who does this, seeking GOD’s approval, we will grant him a great recompense.

115. As for the one who opposes the messenger, after the guidance has been pointed out to him, and follows other than the believers’ way, we will direct him in the direction he has chosen, and commit him to Hell; what a miserable destiny!

*The Unforgivable Sin*

116. GOD does not forgive idolatry (if maintained until death);* He forgives lesser offenses for whomever He wills. Anyone who sets up any idol besides GOD has strayed far astray.

117. They even worship female gods besides Him; as a matter of fact, they only worship a rebellious devil.

118. GOD has condemned him, and he said, “I will surely recruit a definite share of Your worshipers.”

119. “I will mislead them; I will entice them; I will command them to (forbid the eating of certain meats by) marking the ears of livestock; I will command them to distort the creation of GOD.” Anyone who accepts the devil as lord, instead of GOD, has incurred a profound loss.

120. He promises them and entices them; what the devil promises is no more than an illusion.

121. The final abode for these is Hell; they can never evade it.

وَلَكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَأَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُاْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

وَمَنْ يُشَاقِقِ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِن بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَيَتَّبِعْ غَيْرَ سَبِيلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ نُوَلِّهِ مَا تَوَلَّىٰ وَنُصْلِهِ جَهَنَّمَ وَسَاءَتْ مَصِيرًا

لَا يَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَنَٰيَةَ أَن يُشْرَكَ بِهِۦ وَيَغْفِرُ مَا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَمَنْ يُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلَٰلًا بَعِيدًا

وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ هَٰؤُلَاءِ شُفَعَاؤُنَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ قُلْ أَتَعْلَمُونَ أَعْلَمَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ أَعْظَمُ بِظُلْمٍ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَيُؤْتَىٰ بِهِ ٱلْأَنبِيَاءُ وَٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلُواْ فِى جَنَّةِ نَعِيمٍ

لَأَكُلُّهُمْ إِذَا جَاءَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْعِظَةُ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَسَنُحِىِهِمْ سَبِيلَهُمْ وَسَنَزِيدُهُمْ مِّنْ أَعْمَٰلِهِمْ وَسَنَجْعَلُهُمْ جَزَاءَ دِهَادًا

وَمَنْ يُشَاقِقِ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِن بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَيَتَّبِعْ غَيْرَ سَبِيلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لَا نَتَّبِعُهُۥ بِسَبِيلِنَا

وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ آمَنَ بِهِۦ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ لَمْ يُؤْمِنْ بِهِۦ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِىَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مَحِلًّا

وَلَكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِى عِزَّةٍ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ جَزِيلُ ٱلْأَجْرِ

لَا يَأْتِيكُمُ ٱلشَّرُّ مِن بَيْنِهِۦ وَلاَ مِن دُونِهِۦ وَلاَ تُغْنِىْ عَنكُمْ شَرَّهُ شَيْئًا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ

وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِى ٱلْأَخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ

أُوْلَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ نَصِيبٌ مِّنَ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ

وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ كُونُواْ حَشَرَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَقَالُواْ نَحْنُ أَحْشَرُ مَنْ هَلَكَ مِن قَبْلِنَا وَإِنَّا لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّمَّآ تُوعَدُونَ

وَمَا عَلِّمُوهُمْ بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ظَنًّا وَإِنْ أَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا هَوَىً فَقَدْ كَانَ هَٰذَا لَمَسْكَنًا خَابًا

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلطَّغْفُ وَكَانَ قَوْمًا كَفُورًا

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِآيَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِهِۦ فَقَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ كَذُوبٌ

فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ مِن عِندِنَا قَالُواْ قَتَلُوهُ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَكَذُوبٌ

فَأَخْرَجْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ فِى غَرَامٍ وَقَالُواْ ٱهْبِطُواْ فِى حَمِيمٍ فَلَمَّا هَبِطُواْ فِيهِ جَعَلَ لَهُمْ بَابًا مِّن رَّحْمَةٍ مِنَّا وَأَنقَذَهُۥ وَأَهْلَهُۥ وَأَصْحَابَهُۥ مِن ٱلْغَرَقِ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِبْرَٰهِيمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِلَيْهِمْ فَقَالَ إِنَّنِىَ مُرْسَلٌ إِلَيْكُمْ

أَنِ ٱعْبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ

فَقَالُواْ أَتَجْعَلُ ٱللَّهَ وَحْدَةً وَذَلِكَ شَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ

وَقَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ ٱنَّنَا لَنَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُقْتَرَفِينَ

فَأَلْقَاهُمْ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهُ بِخَٰرِجِينَ

ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِهِۦ بِآيَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

فَقَالُواْ سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلطَّاغُوتَ وَٱلْبَحْرَ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ وَكَانَ فِرْعَوْنَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَيْهِمَا خُلَفَٰٓءَ وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمَا مُهْتَدِينَ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ بِآيَٰتِنَا إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِهِۦ فَقَالُواْ سَاحِرَانِ مُبِينَانِ

فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ مِن عِندِنَا قَالُواْ إِنَّمَا أَنتُمَا سَاحِرَانِ مُبِينَانِ

فَأَلْقَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ يَقُولُ آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

رَبِّ فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ وَقَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَقَوْمِ لُوطٍ

وَقَوْمِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَقَوْمِ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ وَقَوْمٍ أَيَّدْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْبَطِشَةِ فُجِّرُواْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ هُم وَمَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُمْ وَكَانَ فِرْعَوْنُ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلطَّغْفُ وَكَانَ قَوْمًا كَفُورًا

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِآيَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِهِۦ فَقَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ كَذُوبٌ

فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ مِن عِندِنَا قَالُواْ قَتَلُوهُ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَكَذُوبٌ

فَأَخْرَجْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ فِى غَرَامٍ وَقَالُواْ ٱهْبِطُواْ فِى حَمِيمٍ فَلَمَّا هَبِطُواْ فِيهِ جَعَلَ لَهُمْ بَابًا مِّن رَّحْمَةٍ مِنَّا وَأَنقَذَهُۥ وَأَهْلَهُۥ وَأَصْحَابَهُۥ مِن ٱلْغَرَقِ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِبْرَٰهِيمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِلَيْهِمْ فَقَالَ إِنَّنِىَ مُرْسَلٌ إِلَيْكُمْ

أَنِ ٱعْبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ

فَقَالُواْ أَتَجْعَلُ ٱللَّهَ وَحْدَةً وَذَلِكَ شَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ

وَقَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ ٱنَّنَا لَنَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُقْتَرَفِينَ

فَأَلْقَاهُمْ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهُ بِخَٰرِجِينَ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِهِۦ بِآيَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

فَقَالُواْ سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلطَّاغُوتَ وَٱلْبَحْرَ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ وَكَانَ فِرْعَوْنَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

122. As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, we will admit them into gardens with flowing streams, wherein they live forever.
Such is the truthful promise of GOD.
Who is more truthful than GOD?

123. It is not in accordance with your wishes, or the wishes of the people of the scripture: anyone who commits evil pays for it, and has no helper or supporter, besides GOD.

124. As for those who lead a righteous life, male or female, while believing, they enter Paradise, and never suffer the slightest harm.

*Abraham:
Original Messenger of Islam*

125. Whose religion is better than one who submits totally to GOD, leads a righteous life, and upholds the creed of Abraham: monotheism? GOD has chosen Abraham as a beloved friend.

126. To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. GOD is in full control of all things.

127. They consult you concerning women: say, “GOD enlightens you regarding them, as recited for you in the scripture. You shall restore the rights of orphaned girls whom you deprive of their dowries when you marry them: you shall not take advantage of them. The rights of orphaned boys must be protected as well. You shall treat the orphans equitably. Whatever good you do, GOD is fully aware thereof.”

وَاللَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَنُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ذَلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
أَنْهَا حَقَّاءُ وَمَنْ أَصْدَقُ مِنَ اللَّهِ حَدِيثًا
وَمَا كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ أَبَا أَحَدٍ مِنْ رِجَالِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَخَاتَمَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا
وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ دِينًا مِمَّنْ أَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ وَاتَّبَعَ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا وَاتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلًا
لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرًا
وَسَأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْيَتَامَى قُلْ إِصْلَاحٌ لَّهُمْ خَيْرٌ وَإِنْ تُخَالِطُوهُمْ فَإِخْوَانُكُمْ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْمُفْسِدَ مِنَ الْمُصْلِحِ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَأَعْنَتَكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ

*4:125 All messengers since Adam have preached one and the same religion. Abraham was the original messenger of the creed named “Islam” (22:78, Appendix 26). “Islam” is not a name, but rather a description meaning “Submission.”*
