وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوًّا شَيَاطِينَ الْإِنْسِ وَالْجِنِّ يُوحِي بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ زُخْرُفَ الْقَوْلِ غُرُورًا ۚ وَلَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّكَ مَا فَعَلُوهُ فَذَرْهُمْ وَمَا يَفْتَرُونَ

وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِمْ فَسَأَلُوهُمْ الْأَجْرَ وَالْأَكْلَ وَقَالُوا إِنْ نَحْنُ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ تُؤْتَوْنَ سَخْرَةً وَتَعْتَبُونَ

وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَا تَسْمَعُوا لِهَٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ وَالْغَوَّا فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُونَ

فَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ دُنْيَا وَلَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُم جَمِيعًا

فَسَأَلَهُ الَّذِي كَفَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ أَلَا تَأْتِيَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يَكُونَ لَهُمْ آيَةٌ

قَالَ إِنَّمَا عَذَابِي أَشَدُّ وَأَبْقَى

وَرَأَيْتَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ حَافِّينَ مِنْ حَوْلِ الْكُرْسِيِّ مُسَبِّحِينَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَقِيلَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

وَقَالَ الَّذِي كَفَرَ وَكَذَّبَ بِآيَاتِنَا وَقَالَ سَأُعْطَىٰ خَيْرًا مِّنْ هَٰذَا مُحْضَرًا وَأُطْلِقُ إِلَيْهِ رَجُلًا يَأْتِينِي بِهِ

قَالَ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ بِهِ شَيْئًا وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلُهَا ظَالِمُونَ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا وَبَعْثًا فَنُقِصُّ عَلَيْهِمْ رِزْقًا فَاعْتَبُوا وَكَانُوا بِآيَاتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ

وَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا مَعَهُمْ انْفَكَرُوا زُمَرًا شُجَّاعًا وَزُمَرًا يَتَّبِعُونَ أَمْرَ أَهْلِ الْقُرَىٰ وَكَانُوا لَوْ لَا كِتَابُ اللَّهِ عَلَىٰ إِحْدَاهُمْ وَعْدًا مِّنَ اللَّهِ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

فَآمَنَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِأَنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ

وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَا تَسْمَعُوا لِهَٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ وَالْغَوَّا فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُونَ

فَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِظَالِمِينَ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا فَأَخَذَهُمُ الطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ

فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَأَصْحَابَ السَّفِينَةِ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا آيَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا دَاوُودَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ وَآتَيْنَاهُمَا عِلْمًا وَتَقْوَىٰ وَعَلَّمَاهُمَا مِمَّا يَعْلَمَانِ يُوسُفَ وَأَخَاهُ إِذْ قَالَا لِفَتَيَيْنِ فِي السِّجْنِ ائْتُونَا بِمَلْكٍ نَّحْنُ لَهُ بِمُبِينٍ

فَأَجَابَهُمَا رَسُولٌ بِمَا حَقَّقَهُ وَقَالَ هَٰذَا مِمَّا عِندِي عِلْمٌ وَقَدْ أَرْسَلَهُ رَبِّي حَقًّا وَقَالَ رَبِّ مَا شِئْتَ رَبِّ إِنِّي أَرِيدُ بِهَٰذَا بِنْتِيَ هِيَ عَذْرَاءُ وَأَنَا أَرْجُو أَنْ تَقَرَّبَ بِهَا وَتَرْحَمَ طَائِفَةً مِّنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَارُونَ بِآيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ

إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا وَكَانُوا قَوْمًا مُجْرِمِينَ

فَقَالُوا أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبِشْرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا مِنَّا مُسْتَضْعَفُونَ أَفَطَمَّنَا اللَّهُهُمَا وَهُمَا فِي بِلَادِنَا تُفْعَلُ فِيهَا كُلُّ شَيْءٍ سَخِرَةٌ وَتَعْتَبُونَ

فَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِظَالِمِينَ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا لُوطًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ لَتَرَوْنَهَا فِي بَنَاتِكُمْ وَتَأْتُونَ الْمُنْكَرَ فِي أَعْمَالِكُمْ بَلْ أَحْسَنُ مِثْلَ هَٰذَا مَوْضِعًا وَرَبُّكُمْ خَيْرٌ وَأَحْسَنُ نَجْزًى لِلْمُتَّقِينَ

أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا فُجَّرًا وَبَطَّرُوا آيَاتِنَا كُلَّهَا

فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ أَحْسَنُ مَا خُذْنَا بِهِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ

**The Cave (Al-Kahf) 18:46-53**

**Rearranging Our Priorities**

46. Money and children are the material enjoyments of this life, but the righteous works provide an eternal recompense from your Lord, and a far better hope.

47. The day will come when we wipe out the mountains; you will see the earth barren, and we will summon them, without leaving out a single one of them.

48. They will be presented before your Lord in a row. You have come to us as individuals, just as we created you initially. Indeed, this is what you claimed will never happen.

49. The record will be shown, and you will see the guilty fearful of its contents. They will say, “Woe to us. How come this book leaves nothing, small or large, without counting it?” They will find everything they had done brought forth. Your Lord is never unjust towards anyone.

**Classification of God’s Creatures**

50. We said to the angels, “Fall prostrate before Adam.” They fell prostrate, except Satan. He became a jinn, for he disobeyed the order of His Lord. Will you choose him and his descendants as lords instead of Me, even though they are your enemies? What a miserable substitute!

   ![Arabic Text]
   أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّي أَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَأَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْتُمُونَ
   وَمَا أَدْرِيكُمْ لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ يُبْدِي أَمْرًا قَرِيبًا أَوْ يُخْفِيهِ
   إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْئًا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ
   وَمَا هُمْ عَلَىٰ شَيْءٍ شُرَكَاءُ
   وَيَدْعُونَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَيَنْفَعُهُمْ وَاللَّهُ هُوَ الْحَمِيدُ
   قَدْ كَفَرَ الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْمَسِيحُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَقَالَ الْمَسِيحُ يَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ مَنْ يُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ فَقَدْ حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَأْوَاهُ النَّارُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنْصَارٍ

51. I never permitted them to witness the creation of the heavens and the earth, nor the creation of themselves. Nor do I permit the wicked to be members in My kingdom.*

52. The day will come when He says, “Call upon My partners, whom you claimed to be gods besides Me,” they will call on them, but in vain. A gulf of hatred will separate them from each other.

53. The guilty will see Hell and will realize that they will fall into it; they will have no escape therefrom.

---
*18:50 When the great feud in the heavenly society took place (38:69), all creatures became classified into angels, jinns, and humans (Appendix 7).
*18:51 God knew that Satan and his supporters (jinns and humans) were going to make the wrong decision. Hence their exclusion from witnessing the creation process.

**The Cave (Al-Kahf) 18:54-61**

**Disbelievers Refuse to Accept the Completeness of the Quran**

54. We have cited in this Quran every kind of example, but the human being is the most argumentative creature.

55. Nothing prevented the people from believing, when the guidance came to them, and from seeking the forgiveness of their Lord, except that they demanded to see the same (miracles) as the previous generations, or challenged to see the retribution beforehand.

56. We send the messengers as deliverers of good news, as well as warners. Those who disbelieve argue with falsehood to defeat the truth, and they take My signs and warnings in vain.

**Divine Intervention**

57. Who are more evil than those who are reminded of their Lord’s revelations, then disregard them, without realizing what they are doing. Consequently, we place shields on their hearts to prevent them from understanding it (the Quran), and deafness in their ears. Thus, no matter what you do to guide them, they can never ever be guided.

58. Yet, your Lord is the Forgiver, full of mercy. If He called them to account for their deeds, He would have annihilated them right there and then. Instead, He gives them a respite until a specific, predetermined time; then they can never escape.

59. Many a community we annihilated because of their transgressions. We designated a specific time for their annihilation.

**Valuable Lessons from Moses and His Teacher**

60. Moses said to his servant, “I will not rest until I reach the point where the two rivers meet, no matter how long it takes.”

61. When they reached the point where they met, they lost their fish; it found its way back to the river, sneakily.

**Arabic Text:**

ولقد صَرَّفْنَا فِي هَذَا الْقُرْآنِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ فَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا إِذْ جَاءَهُمُ الْهُدَى وَيَسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّهُمْ إِلَّا أَن تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْحَقُّ بَيِّنًا فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا بِهِ مِن قَبْلُ فَكَذَّبُوا بِهِ هَذَا وَهُمْ بِهِ يَلْعَبُونَ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ النَّاسُ بِالْقِسْطِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا الْحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأْسٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَنَافِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَنْصُرُهُ وَرُسُلَهُ بِالْغَيْبِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا فَأَخَذَهُمُ الطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَى بِآيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ

إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَقَارُونَ فَقَالُوا سَاحِرٌ كَذُوبٌ

فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا قَالُوا لَئِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ سَحَرَ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِمَا يَعِدُنَا إِنْ كُنَّا بِالْحَقِّ هَادِينَ

فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ مُوسَى بِآيَاتِنَا قَالُوا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ

وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِالسِّينَاءِ

وَأَنْزَلْنَا الْمَنَارَ وَكُنَّا مُنْتَقِمِينَ

وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا آلَ لُوطٍ بِالْعَذَابِ الْمُصِيبِ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَىٰ كُلَّمَا جَاءَ أُمَّةً رَّسُولُهَا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ

ثُمَّ أَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ نَحْنُ أَحْكَمُ الْحَاسِبِينَ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَى وَأَخَاهُ هَارُونَ بِآيَاتِنَا إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ فَقَالُوا سِحْرٌ مُفْتَرًى وَمَا كُنَّا بِمُؤْمِنِينَ

فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا قَالُوا لَئِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ سَحَرَ إِنَّنَا بِهِ مُنْتَقِمُونَ

فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ مُوسَى بِآيَاتِنَا قَالُوا سِحْرٌ وَمَا رَأَيْنَا فِيهِ مِثْلًا

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ

أَنْ عَبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ

فَقَالُوا أَتَتَّخِذُنَا مُلْكًا قَلِيلًا وَإِنَّا لَكَ بِالْمُقْبِلِينَ

قَالَ إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ عَذَابُنَا قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِالَّذِي أَرْسَلَكَ بِهِ رَبُّكَ وَأَرْسَلَ مَعَكَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ فَلَمَّا رَأَوُا الْعَذَابَ قَالُوا أَلَا تَجِدُونَ حِجْرًا

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَى وَهَارُونَ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ بِآيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ

فَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَعْلَمُ

وَلَقَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِبَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَأَرْسِلُوا مَعِيَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ

قَالَ إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ مُرْسِلُونَ

فَلَمَّا أَرْسَلْنَاهُمُ اسْتُفْتِيَ فِرْعَوْنُ أَحْزَبُهُمْ أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ لَفَارِقُونَ

فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ مُوسَى بِآيَاتِنَا قَالُوا لَنْ نُؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّى يُبَيِّنَ اللَّهُ لَنَا وَإِنَّا لَفِي شَكٍّ مِّنْ مَّقَامِكَ يَا مُوسَى

فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا قَالُوا لَئِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ سَحَرَ إِنَّنَا بِهِ مُنْتَقِمُونَ

فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ مُوسَى بِآيَاتِنَا قَالُوا سِحْرٌ وَمَا رَأَيْنَا فِيهِ مِثْلًا

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَى وَأَخَاهُ هَارُونَ بِآيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ

إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ فَقَالُوا سِحْرٌ مُفْتَرًى وَمَا كُنَّا بِمُؤْمِنِينَ

فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا قَالُوا لَئِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ سَحَرَ إِنَّنَا بِهِ مُنْتَقِمُونَ

فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ مُوسَى بِآيَاتِنَا قَالُوا سِحْرٌ وَمَا رَأَيْنَا فِيهِ مِثْلًا

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَى وَهَارُونَ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ بِآيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ

فَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَعْلَمُ

وَلَقَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِبَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَأَرْسِلُوا مَعِيَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ

قَالَ إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ مُرْسِلُونَ

فَلَمَّا أَرْسَلْنَاهُمُ اسْتُفْتِيَ فِرْعَوْنُ أَحْزَبُهُمْ أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ لَفَارِقُونَ

وَلَقَدْ قَالَ مُوسَى يَا قَوْمِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ آمَنْتُمْ بِاللَّهِ فَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلُوا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُسْلِمِينَ

فَقَالُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ

وَلَقَدْ أَنْجَيْنَاهُمْ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْمُحِيطِ

وَلَقَدْ وَصَّيْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَنِّي أَكْفِيكُمْ شَرَّ الْعَادِيِّينَ

فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

وَلَقَدْ قَالَ مُوسَى يَا قَوْمِ اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ أَنْجَاكُمْ مِنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ وَيُقَتِّلُونَ أَبْنَاءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَاءَكُمْ وَفِي ذَٰلِكُمْ بَلَاءٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌ

وَلَقَدْ قَالَ مُوسَى يَا قَوْمِ اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَعَلَ فِيكُمْ أَنْبِيَاءَ وَجَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَاءَ وَآتَاكُمْ مِّنَ الْجِبَالِ مَثِيبًا وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ أَنْتُمْ تَظَاهَرُونَ

62. After they passed it, he said to his servant, "Let us have lunch. All this traveling has thoroughly exhausted us."

63. He said, "Remember when we sat by the rock back there? I paid no attention to the fish; the devil made me forget it, and it found its way back to the river, strangely."

64. (Moses) said, "That was the place we wanted." They traced their steps back.

65. They found one of our servants, whom we blessed with mercy, and bestowed upon him from our own knowledge.

66. Moses said to him, "Can I follow you, that you may teach me some of the knowledge and the guidance bestowed upon you?"

67. He said, "You cannot stand to be with me."

68. "How can you stand that which you do not comprehend?"

69. He said, "You will find me, God willing, patient. I will not disobey any command you give me."

70. He said, "If you follow me, then you shall not ask me about anything, unless I choose to tell you about it."

71. So they went. When they boarded a ship, he bore a hole in it. He said, "Did you bore a hole in it to drown its people? You have committed something terrible."

72. He said, "Did I not say that you cannot stand to be with me?"

73. He said, "I am sorry. Do not punish me for my forgetfulness; do not be too harsh with me."

74. So they went. When they met a young boy, he killed him. He said, "Why did you kill such an innocent soul, who did not kill another soul? You have committed something gross."

قَالَ إِنْ كُنْتَ سَافِرًا فَإِنَّهُ لَمُقْتَضٍ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ قَاعِدًا فَإِنَّهُ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ يَمُرَّ الْقَائِلُ

فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قَالَ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَأَعْلَمُ بِمَا أَخْفَى وَمَا أَعْلَنَ وَإِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُفْتَرِينَ

فَلَمَّا رَكِبَا فِي الْفُلْكِ جَعَلَ سَبِيلَهُ فَأَغْرَقَهُمَا قَالَتَا إِنَّا لُغُوبَانِ

فَأَخَذَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا فَأَلْقَاهُمَا إِلَى مَكَانٍ بَرَرْنَا لَهُ وَقَالَا رَبَّنَا جَعَلْتَ هَذَا مَقَامًا وَمَأْوًى وَأَنْجَيْتَنَا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ

وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ وَأَلْحِقْنَا بِالصَّالِحِينَ

فَأَخَذْنَاهُمَا وَمَنْ كُنَّا مِنْ شُهَدَاءَهُمْ فَأَلْقَيْنَاهُمْ إِلَى مَكَانٍ بَرَرْنَا لَهُ وَقَالَ لَهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ مُسْتَضْعَفُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَسَكَنُوا فِيهَا وَلَمَسْنَا مِنْهُمْ شَيْئًا

وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَاهُمْ بِآيَةٍ مُبِينَةٍ فَإِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ كَافِرُونَ

75. He said, “Did I not tell you that you cannot stand to be with me?”

76. He said, “If I ask you about anything else, then do not keep me with you. You have seen enough excuses from me.”

77. So they went. When they reached a certain community, they asked the people for food, but they refused to host them. Soon, they found a wall about to collapse, and he fixed it up. He said, “You could have demanded a wage for that!”

78. He said, “Now we have to part company. But I will explain to you everything you could not stand.

79. ‘As for the ship, it belonged to poor fishermen, and I wanted to render it defective. There was a king coming behind them, who was confiscating every ship, forcibly.

80. ‘As for the boy, his parents were good believers, and we saw that he was going to burden them with his transgression and disbelief.*

81. ‘We willed that your Lord substitute in his place another son; one who is better in righteousness and kindness.

82. ‘As for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city. Under it, there was a treasure that belonged to them. Because their father was a righteous man, your Lord wanted them to grow up and attain full strength, then extract their treasure. Such is mercy from your Lord. I did none of that of my own volition. This is the explanation of the things you could not stand.’”

Zul-Qarnain: The One With the Two Horns

83. They ask you about the one with the two horns. Say, “I will narrate to you some of his history.”

---

*18:80 Adolf Hitler was a cute and seemingly innocent child. Had he died as a child, many would have grieved, and many would have even questioned God’s wisdom. We learn from these profound lessons that there is a good reason behind everything.

**The Cave (Al-Kahf) 18:84-97**

84. We granted him authority on earth, and provided him with all kinds of means.

85. Then, he pursued one way.

86. When he reached the far west, he found the sun setting in a vast ocean, and found people there. We said, “O you with two horns, you can rule as you wish; either punish, or be kind to them.”

87. He said, “As for those who transgress, we will punish them, then, when they return to their Lord, He will commit them to more retribution.

88. ‘As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they receive a good reward; we will treat them kindly.’”

89. Then he pursued another way.

90. When he reached the far east, he found the sun rising on people who had nothing to shelter them from it.

91. Naturally, we were fully aware of everything he found out.

92. He then pursued another way.

93. When he reached the valley between two palisades, he found people whose language was barely understandable.

**Gog and Magog\***

94. They said, “O you with the two horns, Gog and Magog are corruptors of the earth. Can we pay you to create a barrier between us and them?”

95. He said, “My Lord has given me great bounties. If you cooperate with me, I will create a dam between you and them.

96. ‘Bring to me masses of iron.’” He filled the gap between the two palisades, then said, “Blow.” Once it was red hot, he said, “Help me pour tar on top of it.”

97. Thus, they could not climb it, nor could they bore holes in it.

---

*18:94-98 One of my duties as God’s Messenger of the Covenant is to state that Gog and Magog, the final sign before the end of the world, will reappear in 2270 AD (1700 AH), just 10 years before the end. Note that Gog and Magog occur in Suras 18 and 21, precisely 17 verses before the end of each sura, representing 17 lunar centuries (72:27).

_The Cave (Al-Kahf) 18:98-110_

98. He said, “This is mercy from my Lord. When the prophecy of my Lord comes to pass, He will cause the dam to crumble. The prophecy of my Lord is truth.”

99. On that day, we will let them mingle with one another, then the horn will be blown, and we will summon them all together.

100. We will present Hell, on that day, to the disbelievers.

101. They are the ones whose eyes were too veiled to see My message. Nor could they hear.

102. Did those who disbelieved think that they could get away with setting up My servants as gods besides Me? We have prepared for the disbelievers Hell as an eternal abode.

_The Worst Losers_

103. Say, “Shall I tell you who the worst losers are?

104. “They are the ones whose works in this life are totally astray, but they think that they are doing good.”

105. Such are the ones who disbelieved in the revelations of their Lord and in meeting Him. Therefore, their works are in vain; on the Day of Resurrection, they have no weight.

106. Their just requital is Hell, in return for their disbelief, and for mocking My revelations and My messengers.

107. As for those who believe and lead a righteous life they have deserved a blissful Paradise as their abode.

108. Forever they abide therein; they will never want any other substitute.

_The Quran: Everything We Need_

109. Say, “If the ocean were ink for the words of my Lord, the ocean would run out, before the words of my Lord run out, even if we double the ink supply.”

110. Say, “I am no more than a human like you, being inspired that your God is one God. Those who hope to meet their Lord shall work righteousness, and never worship any other god besides His Lord.”

# Mary (Maryam) 19:1-11

---

## Sura 19: Mary (Maryam)

**In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful**

1. K. H. Y. ‘A. S.* (Kaaf Haa Yaa ‘Ayn Saad)

   Zachariah

2. A narration about your Lord’s mercy towards His servant Zachariah.

3. He called his Lord, a secret call.

4. He said, “My Lord, the bones have turned brittle in my body, and my hair is aflame with gray. As I implore You, my Lord, I never despair.

5. “And I fear for my (female) dependants after me, for my wife has been sterile. Grant me, from You, an heir.

6. “Let him be my heir and the heir of Jacob’s clan, and make him, my Lord, acceptable.”

   John

7. “O Zachariah, we give you good news; a boy whose name shall be John (Yahya). We never created anyone like him before.”

8. He said, “My Lord, will I have a son despite my wife’s sterility, and despite my old age?”

9. He said, “Thus said your Lord: ‘It is easy for Me to do. I created you before that, and you were nothing.’”

10. He said, “My Lord, give me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three consecutive nights.”

11. He came out to his family, from the sanctuary, and signaled to them: “Meditate (on God) day and night.”

---

*19:1 This is the maximum number of Quranic Initials, because this sura deals with such crucial matters as the miraculous birth of John and the virgin birth of Jesus, and strongly condemns the blasphemy of Jesus’ sonship to God. The 5-lettered initials provide powerful physical evidence to support these issues (See Appendices 1 & 22).

The Birth of Jesus

    "Do not grieve. Your Lord has provided you with a stream.

25. 'And if you shake the trunk of this palm tree, it will drop ripe dates for you.'

---
*19:25 Thus, Jesus was born in late September or early October. This is when dates ripen in the Middle East to the point of falling off the tree.

وَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِيْحْيَىٰ وَصَلَّيْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَكَانَ طَيِّبًا صَالِحًا
وَبَرًّا بِوَالِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ جَبَّارًا عُتُوًّا
وَلَتَبَرَّكَ فِيهِ رَبُّكَ أَحْسَنَ تَبَرُّكَهُ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ
وَمَرْيَمَ اِسْتَبْرَكَ بِهَا رَبُّهَا وَاخْتَارَهَا عَلَى نِسَاءِ الْعَالَمِينَ
يَا مَرْيَمُ اِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَاكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَفَضَّلَكِ عَلَى نِسَاءِ الْعَالَمِينَ
يَا مَرْيَمُ اِقْنُتِي لِرَبِّكِ وَاسْجُدِي وَارْكَعِي مَعَ الرَّاكِعِينَ
ذَلِكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَامَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
اِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مُتَرَجِّلَهُمْ وَمُتَّقِيَهُمْ وَكَانُوا بِذَلِكَ مُحِيطِينَ
فَاخْتَارَهَا رَبُّهَا وَأَنْبَتَهَا نَطْقًا حَسَنًا وَكَانُوا يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
يَا مَرْيَمُ قْنُتِي لِرَبِّكِ وَاسْجُدِي وَارْكَعِي مَعَ الرَّاكِعِينَ
فَإِذَا رَضِعْتِ فَأَطْعِمِي وَإِذَا جِعْتِ فَاسْرُكِي وَإِذَا شِفْتِ فَإِنِّي أَرَاكِ بِالْغُلَامِ وَقَالَتْ يَا وَيْلَتَحِيَ عَلَىَّ يَبْقَىٰنِي اللَّهُ رَبِّي وَرَزَقَنِي مِنْ حَيْثُ لَمْ أَرْجُ وَكَانَ رَبِّي سَمِيعًا دُعَاءَ
فَأَجَاءَهَا رَبُّهَا بِرُوحٍ مِنْهُ وَصَوَّرَهَا بَشَرًا كَالِمَةً قَالَ إِنِّي رَبُّكَ فَاخْتَرْتَهَا وَطَهَّرْتَهَا عَنْ الْغَيْبِ فَكَانَتْ وَهْبَةً مِنْ عِنْدِي فَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ وَتَزَوَّدِي صَاعًا مِنْ طَيِّبٍ فَأَطْعِمِي وَأَطْعِمْ مَنْ لَمْ يُؤْمِنْ فَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ عَمَلَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ مِنْهُ مُنْصَرٌ وَمِنْ وَرَاءِ ذَلِكَ مِنْ عِنْدِي عَفْوٌ لِمَنْ شَرَحَهُ وَأَمْرٌ مُقَرَّنٌ
فَأَتَتْ بِهِ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُ قَالُوا يَا مَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ بِشَيْءٍ فَرِيٍّ
يَا أُخْتِ هَارُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ امْرَأَ سَوْءٍ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكَ بَغِيًّا
فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ قَالُوا كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَنْ كَانَ فِي الْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا
قَالَ إِنِّي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ آتَانِيَ الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلَنِي نَبِيًّا
وَجَعَلَنِي مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُ وَأَوْصَانِي بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالزَّكَاةِ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِهِ إِلَيَّ
وَمَكْرُوهًا وَحَتَّىٰ أَتِيَ الْيَوْمَ الْآخِرَ بِمَا وَعَدَ رَبِّي وَكَانَ وَعْدَ رَبِّي حَقًّا
فَأَصْبَحَتْ بِهِ قَوْمُهَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ
قَالَتْ يَا بُنَيَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَحْسِرُ عَلَيْكَ خَافَتْ أَنْ يَقْتُلُوهُ قَالَتْ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً وَكَانَ رَبِّي سَمِيعًا دُعَاءَ
فَأَخَذَتْهُ أُمُّهُ مُفْتَرِضَةً قَالَتْ يَا بُنَيَّ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَسْقِيكَ شَيْئًا فَلَمَّا بَسَطْتُ مِثْيَالِي وَجَدْتُ عَلَيْهِ رُطَبًا قَالَتْ يَا بُنَيَّ كَيْفَ تُحَدِّثُنِي بِشَيْءٍ لَمْ أَكُنْ أَعْلَمِهِ قَالَتْ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُهُ فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ
أَنِّي أُقَتَّلُ وَإِنِّي أُحْيَىٰ وَأَنِّي أَحْيِي الْمَوْتَىٰ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّي وَيُبَيِّنُ لِي مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
وَمَا أَنَا إِلَّا عَبْدٌ مُبَارَكٌ وَكَانَ رَبِّي مُتَوَفِّيًا
وَمَرْيَمَ اِسْتَبْرَكَ بِهَا رَبُّهَا وَاخْتَارَهَا عَلَى نِسَاءِ الْعَالَمِينَ
يَا مَرْيَمُ اِقْنُتِي لِرَبِّكِ وَاسْجُدِي وَارْكَعِي مَعَ الرَّاكِعِينَ
ذَلِكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَامَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
فَاخْتَارَهَا رَبُّهَا وَأَنْبَتَهَا نَطْقًا حَسَنًا وَكَانُوا يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
يَا مَرْيَمُ قْنُتِي لِرَبِّكِ وَاسْجُدِي وَارْكَعِي مَعَ الرَّاكِعِينَ
فَإِذَا رَضِعْتِ فَأَطْعِمِي وَإِذَا جِعْتِ فَاسْرُكِي وَإِذَا شِفْتِ فَإِنِّي أَرَاكِ بِالْغُلَامِ وَقَالَتْ يَا وَيْلَتَحِيَ عَلَىَّ يَبْقَىٰنِي اللَّهُ رَبِّي وَرَزَقَنِي مِنْ حَيْثُ لَمْ أَرْجُ وَكَانَ رَبِّي سَمِيعًا دُعَاءَ

26. "Eat and drink, and be happy. When you see anyone, say,
‘I have made a vow of silence; I am not talking, today, to anyone.’ "

27. She came with him to her family, carrying him. They said,
“O Mary, you have committed something gross.

28. “O descendant of Aaron, your father was not a bad man,
nor was your mother unchaste.”

29. She pointed to him. They said, “How can we talk with an infant in the crib?”

30. (The infant spoke and) said,
“I am a servant of **GOD**.
He has given me the scripture,
and made me a prophet.

31. “He made me blessed wherever I go,
and enjoined me to observe the contact prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat)
for as long as I live.

32. “I am to honor my mother; He did
not make me a disobedient rebel.

33. “And peace be upon me
the day I was born, the day I die, and
the day I get resurrected.”

34. Such was Jesus, the son of Mary.
This is the truth of this matter,
about which they have a lot of doubt.

35. **GOD** is never to beget a son,
be He glorified. To have anything
done, He simply says to it,
“Be,” and it is.

36. He also proclaimed,
“**GOD** is my Lord and your Lord;
you shall worship Him alone.
This is the straight path.”*

37. The various parties disputed among themselves (regarding the identity of Jesus).
Therefore, woe to those who disbelieve from the sight of a terrible day.

38. Wait till you hear them and see them when they come to face us.
The transgressors on that day will be totally astray.

---
*19:36 This is similar to the statement attributed to Jesus in the Gospel of John 20:17.

39. Warn them about the day of sorrow, when judgment will be issued.
    For they are totally oblivious; they do not believe.

40. We are the ones who inherit the earth and everyone on it;
    to us they will be returned.

*Abraham*

41. Mention in the scripture Abraham; he was a saint, a prophet.

42. He said to his father, “O my father, why do you worship what can neither hear, nor see, nor help you in any way?

43. “O my father, I have received certain knowledge that you did not receive. Follow me, and I will guide you in a straight path.

44. “O my father, do not worship the devil. The devil has rebelled against the Most Gracious.

45. “O my father, I fear lest you incur retribution from the Most Gracious, then become a slave of the devil.”

46. He said, “Are you rejecting my gods, O Abraham? Unless you stop, I will surely stone you. Leave me alone.”

47. He said, “Peace be upon you. I will implore my Lord to forgive you; He has been Most Kind to me.

48. “I will abandon you and the gods you worship besides GOD. I will worship only my Lord. By imploring only my Lord alone, I cannot go wrong.”

49. Because he abandoned them and the gods they worshipped besides GOD, we granted him Isaac and Jacob, and we made each of them a prophet.

50. We showered them with our mercy, and we granted them an honorable position in history.

*Moses*

51. Mention in the scripture Moses. He was devoted, and he was a messenger prophet.

52. We called him from the right side of Mount Sinai.
We brought him close, and we conferred with him.

53. And we granted him, out of our mercy, his brother Aaron as a prophet.

54. And mention in the scripture Ismail. He was truthful when he made a promise, and he was a messenger prophet.

55. He used to enjoin his family to observe the contact prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat); he was acceptable to his Lord.

56. And mention in the scripture Idris.
He was a saint, a prophet.

57. We exalted him to an honorable rank.

58. These are some of the prophets whom GOD blessed. They were chosen from among the descendants of Adam, and the descendants of those whom we carried with Noah, and the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and from among those whom we guided and selected. When the revelations of the Most Gracious are recited to them, they fall prostrate, weeping.

Losing the Contact Prayers (Salat)

59. After them, He substituted generations that lost the contact prayers (Salat), and pursued their lusts. Consequently, they will go astray.

60. Only those who repent, believe, and lead a righteous life will enter Paradise, without the least injustice.

61. (They enter) the gardens of Eden, which the Most Gracious has promised for His worshipers in the future. Certainly, His promise will come to pass.

62. They will not hear any nonsense therein; only peace. They receive their provisions therein, endlessly.

63. Such is Paradise; we grant it to those among our creatures who are righteous.

64. We do not come down except by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs our past, our future, and everything between them. Your Lord is never forgetful.

وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْأَخْيَرِينَ
وَقَالَ أَخُوهُمْ هَارُونَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
وَذَكَرُوهُ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ سِدِّيقًا نَبِيًّا
وَكَانَ يَعِظُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلْزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِ مَرْضِيًّا
وَذَكَرُوهُ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَبِيًّا
وَأَرْشَفْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مَكَانٍ عَلِيٍّ
أُوْلَٰئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ وَٱلْأَوْلِيَآءِ وَٱلْأَنْبِيَآءِ وَٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ فَأَصْبَحَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ بَعْضٍ ۚ وَتِيفْرَةٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَيَشْتَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ثَمَنًا خَزِيًّا ۖ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَنْ يَقُولُ إِنَّمَا أُوتِيتُمُوهُ بِسِحْرٍ مُّبِينٍ
وَمَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عِلْمٍ إِلَّا لِنَجْزٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ أَحَدِ ٱلْأَوَٰكِرِ جَعَلْنَا أَوْلَٰيِهِۦ ظَٰلِمِينَ
فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ غَاسِقَ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ مُسْرِفِينَ
ثُمَّ وَرَىٰنَا مِنْهُمْ خَالِفِينَ وَأَخَذْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ ۖ وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ جُنْدًا مُّدْهَمِينَ
وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأُمَمُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّ فِيهَا لَأَيَٰتٍ وَإِنَّ فِيهَا لَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ
وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِى إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْأَلُوهُ ٱلْأَجَلَ وَٱسْتَخِفُّوهُ ۚ وَقَالُوا۟ يَا حَرُوثُ إِن كُنتَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
فَأَجَلُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُهُ ۚ وَكَانَ يَوْمَئِذٍ دَاهِرًا
ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِۦ بِآيَٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ بِهَا جَبَّارِينَ
فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ ٱلْأَوَٰكِرِ أَوْرَثْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ مِن بَعْدِهِم مِّنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن نَّرَضِىٰ بِهِۦ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ هَٰذَا قَادِرٌ

ثُمَّ إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِۦ بِآيَٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ بِهَا جَبَّارِينَ
فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ ٱلْأَوَٰكِرِ أَوْرَثْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ مِن بَعْدِهِم مِّنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن نَّرَضِىٰ بِهِۦ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ هَٰذَا قَادِرٌ
وَرَسَلْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِم عِيسَىٰ ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ رَأْفَةً وَرَحْمَةً وَرَهْبَٰنِيَّةً ٱخْتَرْتُمُوهَا مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُرِيدُونَ إِلَّآ أَن تُرْضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَتُرْضُوهُ ۚ فَأَوْرَثْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنْهُۥ مَثِيبَةً ۚ وَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱفْتَرَقُوا۟ ۚ وَإِن مِّنْهُم لَمِنْ ءَامَنَ بِهِۦ وَإِن مِّنْهُم لَمِنْ كَفَرَ بِهِۦ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَىٰ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّينَ إِنِّى مُنْصَرٌ بِٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطْتُ فِيهِ ۚ فَمَن كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ مِنكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
وَمَا نُرْسِلُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ ۖ فَمَنْ ءَامَنَ وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
وَيَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوا۟ قَوَّٰمِينَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ شُهَدَآءَ لِلَّهِ وَلَوْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَوِ ٱلْوَالِدَيْنِ وَٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ ۚ أَلَا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْذَرُ مَن تَحْذَرُونَ ۖ فَإِنْ نَّكَثُوْا فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ
وَمَا كَانَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ لِيَنفَعُوهُمْ نَفْعًا إِذَآ أَتَتْهُمْ رِسَٰلَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ إِلَّا وَقُوْا عَلَىٰ مَآ أَمَرَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَكَانُوا۟ مُنْتَهِينَ
وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَيَّامُ نُدَاوِلُهَا بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَيَتَّخِذَ مِنكُمْ شُهَدَآءَ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدًا
يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِۦ وَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
وَلَا تَوَلَّوْا۟ حِزْبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مُنْقَلِبِينَ
وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَمَا تَقَدَّمَتْ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ فَسَوْفَ تُرَىٰهَا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
لَقَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ فَقِيرٌ وَقَالَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَاشَ لِلَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ أَعِزَّةً
يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ ٱلْيَهُودَ وَٱلْنَّصَٰرَىٰ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۖ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُم مِّنكُمْ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
وَتَرَىٰ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَأَكْلِهِمُ ٱلْأَمْوَالَ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ ۗ سَاءَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفْرَحُونَ بِمَآ أَتَوْا۟ وَيُحِبُّونَ أَن يُحْمَدُوا۟ بِمَا لَمْ يَفْعَلُوهُ ۖ وَلَا يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُۥ لَا يُعْجِبُ ٱللَّهَ ۗ سَاءَ دِينُهُمْ وَهُمْ لَأَفْسَقُوْنَ
وَلَقَدْ ذَرَأْنَا لِلْجَٰهِلِينَ
وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِى إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْأَلُوهُ ٱلْأَجَلَ وَٱسْتَخِفُّوهُ ۚ وَقَالُوا۟ يَا حَرُوثُ إِن كُنتَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ أَحَدِ ٱلْأَوَٰكِرِ جَعَلْنَا أَوْلَٰيِهِۦ ظَٰلِمِينَ
فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ غَاسِقَ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ مُسْرِفِينَ
ثُمَّ وَرَىٰنَا مِنْهُمْ خَالِفِينَ وَأَخَذْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ ۖ وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ جُنْدًا مُّدْهَمِينَ
وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأُمَمُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّ فِيهَا لَأَيَٰتٍ وَإِنَّ فِيهَا لَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ
وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِى إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْأَلُوهُ ٱلْأَجَلَ وَٱسْتَخِفُّوهُ ۚ وَقَالُوا۟ يَا حَرُوثُ إِن كُنتَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ غَاسِقَ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ مُسْرِفِينَ
وَمَا نُرْسِلُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ ۖ فَمَنْ ءَامَنَ وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَارُونَ بِآيَٰتِنَا إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِۦ فَقَالُوا۟ مُرْسَلَانِ إِلَىٰكُمْ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ ٱلْأَوَٰكِرِ أَوْرَثْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ مِن بَعْدِهِم مِّنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن نَّرَضِىٰ بِهِۦ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ هَٰذَا قَادِرٌ
وَرَسَلْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِم عِيسَىٰ ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ رَأْفَةً وَرَحْمَةً وَرَهْبَٰنِيَّةً ٱخْتَرْتُمُوهَا مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُرِيدُونَ إِلَّآ أَن تُرْضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَتُرْضُوهُ ۚ فَأَوْرَثْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنْهُۥ مَثِيبَةً ۚ وَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱفْتَرَقُوا۟
وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ وَلَا نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا إِذَا تَمَنَّىٰ أَلْقَى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ فِىٓ أُمْنِيَّتِهِۦ فَيَنْسَخُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأُمْنِيَّةَ ۖ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ ٱللَّهُ آيَٰتِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
لِيَجْعَلَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ آيَةً ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ عَدُوًّا مُّبِينًا
وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ أَنَّهُۥ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَيَسْتَقِيمُوا۟
وَلِيَأْخُذَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ ۖ وَيَزِيدَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَقِينًا
وَلِيَكُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ وَٱلْإِيمَٰنَ يَتَفَتَّحُوا۟ ۚ وَيَزِيدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ هُدًى ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
وَلِيَكُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ وَٱلْإِيمَٰنَ يَتَفَتَّحُوا۟ وَيَزِيدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ هُدًى ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
وَلِيَكُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ وَٱلْإِيمَٰنَ يَتَفَتَّحُوا۟ وَيَزِيدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ هُدًى ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
وَلَا تَقُولَنَّ لِشَيْءٍ إِنِّى سَأَفْعَلُهُۥ غَدًا
إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَذَكِّرْ بِرَبِّكَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ وَقُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَهْدِيَنِ رَبِّىٓ أَقْرَبَ مِن هَٰذَا سَبِيلًا
وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِيهَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّىٰ ۖ ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلْفَصْلِ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ يُجْلَىٰ فِيهِمْ ۖ وَهُوَ أَلْعَمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ سَعَدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْحَيَٰوةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهِيَ خَيْرَةٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا۟ خَٰتِمَةَهُمْ سَآءَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
وَلَا تَقُولَنَّ لِشَيْءٍ إِنِّى سَأَفْعَلُهُۥ غَدًا
إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَذَكِّرْ بِرَبِّكَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ وَقُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَهْدِيَنِ رَبِّىٓ أَقْرَبَ مِن هَٰذَا سَبِيلًا
وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِيهَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّىٰ ۖ ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلْفَصْلِ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ يُجْلَىٰ فِيهِمْ ۖ وَهُوَ أَلْعَمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
وَلَا تَقُولَنَّ لِشَيْءٍ إِنِّى سَأَفْعَلُهُۥ غَدًا
إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَذَكِّرْ بِرَبِّكَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ وَقُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَهْدِيَنِ رَبِّىٓ أَقْرَبَ مِن هَٰذَا سَبِيلًا
وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِيهَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّىٰ ۖ ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلْفَصْلِ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ يُجْلَىٰ فِيهِمْ ۖ وَهُوَ أَلْعَمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
وَلَا تَقُولَنَّ لِشَيْءٍ إِنِّى سَأَفْعَلُهُۥ غَدًا
إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَذَكِّرْ بِرَبِّكَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ وَقُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَهْدِيَنِ رَبِّىٓ أَقْرَبَ مِن هَٰذَا سَبِيلًا

65. The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; you shall worship Him and steadfastly persevere in worshiping Him. Do you know of anyone who equals Him?

66. The human being asks, “After I die, do I come back to life?”

67. Does the human not remember that we created him, and he was nothing?

**Special Warning to the Leaders**

68. By your Lord, we will certainly summon them, together with the devils. We will gather them around Hell, humiliated.

69. Then we will pick out from each group the most ardent opponent of the Most Gracious.

70. For we know full well those who are most deserving of burning therein.

**Everyone Experiences Hell\***

71. Every single one of you must experience Hell; this is an irrevocable decision of your Lord.

72. Then we rescue the righteous therefrom, and leave the transgressors in it, humiliated.

73. When our revelations are recited to them, clearly, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, “Which of us is more prosperous? Which of us is in the majority?”

74. Many a generation have we annihilated before them, who were more powerful, and much better looking.

75. Say, “Indeed, those who choose to go astray, the Most Gracious will lead them on, until they see what is promised to them—either the retribution or the Hour. That is when they find out who really is worse off, and weaker in power.”

76. GOD augments the guidance of those who choose to be guided. For the good deeds are eternally rewarded by your Lord; they bring far better returns.

وأنَخْرِجْ يَدَكَ مِنَ الْجَيْبِ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ وَأَضْمِمْ إِلَيْكَ جَنَاحَكَ مِنْ رَحْمَةٍ وَرُؤْيَةٍ مِنَ الْآيَاتِ
فَأَلْقِهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ حَيَّةٌ تَسْعَى
فَأَخَذَهَا فِيهَا قَبْضَةٌ وَمَا زَلَّ يَدُهُ بِالْجَنَاحِ وَهُوَ يَنْظُرُ
فَقُلْنَا اِقْذِفْهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ سَاطِعٌ مُبِينٌ
وَلِيَأْخُذَ بِأَحْزَمِهَا وَيَخْشَى لَا يَعُودُ عَلَيْهِمْ خَطِرَةٌ
فَأَقْبِلْ عَلَيْهِمَا وَلاَ تَخَافَا إِنَّهُمَا مُؤْمِنَانِ
فَسَجَدَا وَسَجَدَ مَعَهُمَا دَاوُودُ وَإِسْحَاقُ وَيَعْقُوبُ وَأَوْلَادُهُمْ وَيُوسُفُ وَمُوسَى وَهَارُونَ وَكَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ
وَنَبِئْهُمْ بِخَبَرِ الْأَبْرَارِ
إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ
وَنَجَّيْنَاهُمْ بِبَشِيرٍ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
وَمُوسَى قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّكَ آتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الْمُلْكِ مَا لَمْ تُؤْتِيهِ أَحَدًا مِنْ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
وَلَا قَرِيبًا وَلَا بَعِيدًا رَبِّ قُلْ لِي وَأَقْرِضْنِي إِلَىٰ قَوْمِي فَإِنَّهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ
قَالَ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَبَلَاءَ وَأَنَّهُ سَيَحْزُنُكَ وَيَجْعَلُنَّكَ مِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ
قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ يُكَذِّبُوا
وَيَحِيطُوا بِطَرْفِي وَلَيَطْمَعُوا
قَالَ فَانْظُرْ إِلَىٰ إِلَهِكَ الَّذِي ظَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ عَاهِدَتُهُ لَأُحْرِقَنَّهُ ثُمَّ لَأَنْظُرَنَّ إِلَىٰ إِلَهِكَ مِنْ بَعْدُ وَإِنَّهُ سَيَكُونُ مِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ
قَالَ رَبِّ لاَ تَذَرْنِي وَحِيدًا وَأَجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ أَهْلِي ذَرِّيَّةً وَأَصْبِحْتُ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَرَزَقْنَاهُ مِنْ لَدُنَّا رَحْمَةً وَجَعَلْنَاهُ نَبِيًّا وَشَرِيفًا وَأَوْصَيْنَاهُ بِالتَّقْوَى وَبِالصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ أَمْرِنَا يُذْكِرُونَ
وَنَضْرِبُ لَهُمْ أَمْثَالَهُمْ وَيَنْسَوْنَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُمْ كَافِرُونَ
وَوَرِثَهُ آلُ فِرْعَوْنَ بَعْدَهُ وَزُلْزِلَ فِيهِمْ سَيِّئَاتُ السَّاعَةِ وَبِئْسَ الْوَرِيثُونَ

وَلِيَحْزُنَ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ وَكَانَ عَمَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ خَيْرًا
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا أَهْلَكْنَا الْقُرُونَ الْأُولَىٰ بَيْنَةً لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
وَمَا كُنْتَ بِجَانِبِ الْغَرْبِيِّ إِذْ قَضَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَى الْأَمْرَ وَمَا كُنْتَ مِنَ الشَّاهِدِينَ

38. "When we revealed to your mother some revelation.

39. "Saying: 'Throw him into the box, then throw him into the river. The river will throw him onto the shore, to be picked up by an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his.' I showered you with love from Me, and I had you made before My watchful eye.

40. "Your sister walked, and said, 'I can tell you about a nursing mother who can take good care of him.' We thus returned you to your mother, that she may be happy and stop worrying. And when you killed a soul, we saved you from grief, then we tested you thoroughly. You stayed years with the people of Midyan, and now you have come back in accordance with a predetermined plan.

41. "I have made you just for Me.

42. "Go to Pharaoh, together with your brother, supported by My signs. Do not waver in remembering Me.

43. "Go to Pharaoh, for he transgressed.

44. "Speak to him nicely; he may take heed, or become reverent."

45. They said, "Our Lord, we fear lest he may attack us, or transgress."

46. He said, "Do not be afraid. I will be with you, listening and watching.

47. "Go to him and say, 'We are two messengers from your Lord. Let the Children of Israel go, and do not persecute them. We bring a sign from your Lord. Peace be upon those who follow the guidance.' "

48. (They said to Pharaoh) "We have been inspired that the retribution will inevitably afflict those who disbelieve and turn away."

49. He said, "Who is the Lord of the two of you, O Moses."

50. He said, "Our Lord is the One who granted everything its existence, and its guidance."

51. He said, "What about the past generations?"

52. He said, “The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord never errs, nor does He forget.”

53. He is the One who made the earth habitable for you. He paved for you roads therein. And He sends down from the sky water whereby we produce many different kinds of plants.

54. Eat and herd your livestock. These are signs for those who possess intelligence.*

55. From it we created you, into it we return you, and from it we bring you out once more.

56. We showed him all our signs, but he disbelieved and refused.

57. He said, “Did you come here to take us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?”

58. “We will surely show you similar magic. Therefore, set an appointment that neither we, nor you will violate; in a neutral place.”

59. He said, “Your appointed time shall be the day of festivities. Let us all meet in the forenoon.”

60. (On the appointed day,) Pharaoh summoned his forces, and came.

61. Moses said to them, “Woe to you. Do you fabricate lies to fight GOD and thus incur His retribution? Such fabricators will surely fail.”

62. They disputed among themselves, as they conferred privately.

63. They said, “These two are no more than magicians who wish to take you out of your land with their magic, and thus destroy your ideal way of life.

64. “Let us unite our plans and face them as a united front. The winner today will surely succeed.”

وَجَعَلَ فِىۡهِنَّ نُجُومًاۖ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخۡرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلۡأَكۡمَامِ مِنۡهُۥ طَعَامًا لَّكُمۡ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ لِتَجۡرِيَ فِيهِۦ فِى ٱلۡبَحۡرِ بِأَمۡرِهِۦ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرَ
وَقَدۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ پَٰعِدًاۚ أَفَلَا تَشۡكُرُونَ
وَقَدۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ أَثۡنَآءَۢ أَوَّلِۭ ثُمَّ يُنۡشِئُكُمۡ خُلُقًا ءَاخَرَۖ وَإِذۡلَكُمۡ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّجۡعُۖ
وَعَرَضۡنَا لَهُۥٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ
قَالَ هَلۡ أَتَاكُمۡ مَّلَكٌ أَوۡ جِئۡنَا إِلَيۡكُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ
قَالُوٓاْ أَتَيتُمۡنَا لِتُخۡرِجُونَا مِنۡ أَرۡضِنَا بِسِحۡرِكُمۡۚ وَقَدۡ جِئۡنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُصَدِّّقِينَ
قَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَرَأَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ كَانَ ٱلۡحَقُّ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّهُۥ وَقَعَ عَلَيۡكُم مَّا تُوعَدُونَ
فَأُولَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُواْ هَٰذَا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَمَا كَانُواْ فِى ٱلۡأَخِرَةِ بِمُصۡلِحِينَ
وَتَنَٰزَعُواْ أَمۡرَهُمۡ بَيۡنَهُمۡ ثُمَّ قَالُواْ ٱقۡدُرُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡۖ فَلۡيُرۡسِلۡ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِّمَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۡ طَائِرِهِۦ وَٱلۡإِنۡسِ وَٱلۡحَيَوٰنِ لِيُرۡسِلُواْ بِأَلۡفَايَۢتِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ شَهِيدٌ

65. They said, “O Moses, either you throw, or we will be the first to throw.”

66. He said, “You throw.” Whereupon, their ropes and sticks appeared to him, because of their trickery, as if they were moving.

67. Moses harbored some fear.

68. We said, “Have no fear. You will prevail.

69. “Throw what you hold in your right hand, and it will swallow whatever they fabricated. What they fabricated is no more than the scheming of a magician. The magician’s work will not succeed.”
   *The Experts Recognize The Truth*

70. The magicians fell prostrate, saying, “We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.”

71. He said, “Did you believe in him without my permission? He must be your chief; the one who taught you magic. I will surely cut your hands and feet on alternate sides. I will crucify you on the palm trunks. You will find out soon which of us can inflict the worst retribution, and who outlasts whom.”

72. They said, “We will not prefer you over the clear signs that came to us, and over the One who created us. Therefore, issue whatever judgment you wish to issue. You can only rule in this lowly life.

73. “We have believed in our Lord, that He may forgive us our sins, and the magic that you had forced us to perform. God is far better and Everlasting.”

74. Anyone who comes to his Lord guilty, will incur Hell, wherein he never dies, nor stays alive.

75. As for those who come to Him as believers who had led a righteous life, they attain the high ranks.

76. The gardens of Eden, beneath which rivers flow. They abide therein forever. Such is the reward for those who purify themselves.

وَلَقَدْ قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَا هَامَانُ ابْنِ لِي صَرْحًا أَعْلَاهُ وَارْبِطْ لِي خُطَّاً

أَعْمَالًا فَأَنَا أَطَّلِعُ إِلَى إِلَهِ مُوسَى وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّهُ كَاذِبًا وَكَذَلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِلْكَافِرِينَ سَيُؤْتِيهِمْ مَا يَعْمَلُونَ

فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّاعِقَةُ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

فَلَمْ يَسْتَطِيعُوا فِي اللَّهِ مَكْرًا وَمَا كَانُوا مُحِيطِينَ

وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْهُدَى وَأَوْرَثْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ الْكِتَابَ الْحَكِيمَ

77. We inspired Moses: “Lead My servants out,
and strike for them a dry road across the sea.
Do not fear getting caught; do not worry.”

78. Pharaoh pursued them with his troops.
The sea overwhelmed them, as it was destined to overwhelm them.

79. Thus, Pharaoh misled his people; he did not guide them.

80. O Children of Israel, we delivered you
from your enemy, summoned you
to the right side of Mount Sinai,
and we sent down to you
manna and quails.

81. Eat from the good things we
provided for you, and do not
transgress thereby, lest you incur
My wrath. Whoever incurs My wrath
has fallen.

82. I am surely Forgiving for those who
repent, believe, lead a righteous life,
and steadfastly remain guided.

The Children of Israel Rebel

83. “Why did you rush away from your
people, O Moses?”

84. He said, “They are close behind me,
and I rushed to You my Lord,
that You may be pleased.”

85. He said, “We put your people
to the test after you left,
and the Samarian misled them.”

86. Moses returned to his people,
angry and disappointed, saying,
“O my people, did your Lord
not promise you a good promise?
Could you not wait?
Did you want to incur wrath from your Lord?
Is this why you broke your covenant with me?”

87. They said, “We did not break our covenant with you on purpose.
But we were loaded down with jewelry,
and decided to throw our loads in.
This is what the Samarian suggested.”

88. He produced for them a calf, complete with a calf’s sound.*
   They said, “This is your god, and the god of Moses.” Thus, he forgot.

89. Do they not see that it neither responded to them,
   nor possessed any power to harm them, or benefit them?

90. And Aaron had told them, “O my people, this is a test for you.
   Your only Lord is the Most Gracious, so follow me, and obey my commands.”

91. They said, “We will continue to worship it, until Moses comes back.”

92. He said, “O Aaron, what stopped you,
   when you saw them go astray—

93. “from following my orders?
   Have you rebelled against me?”

94. He said, “O son of my mother; do not pull me by my beard and my head.
   I was afraid that you might say that I divided the Children of Israel,
   and did not follow your orders.”

95. He said, “What is the matter with you, O Samaritan?”

96. He said, “I saw what they could not see, so I grabbed a fistful (of dust)
   from the place where the messenger stood, and used it (to mix into the golden calf). This is what my mind inspired me to do.”

97. He said, “Then go, and throughout your life, do not even come close.
   You have an appointed time (for your final judgment) that you can never evade. Watch your god that you used to worship; we will burn it and throw it into the sea, to stay there forever.”

   You Have But One God

98. Your only god is **GOD**; the One besides whom there is no other god.
   His knowledge encompasses all things.

---

*20:88 & 96 The Samaritan went to the spot where God spoke to Moses, and grabbed a fistful of dust upon which God’s voice had echoed. This dust, when mixed with the molten gold caused the golden statue to acquire the sound of a calf.

99. We thus narrate to you some news from the past generations. We have given you a message from us.

100. Those who disregard it will bear a load (of sins) on the Day of Resurrection.

101. Eternally they abide therein. What a miserable load on the Day of Resurrection!

102. That is the day when the horn is blown, and we summon the guilty on that day blue.

103. Whispering among themselves, they will say, “You have stayed (in the first life) no more than ten!”

104. We are fully aware of their utterances. The most accurate among them will say, “You stayed no more than a day.” On the Day of Resurrection

105. They ask you about the mountains. Say, “My Lord will wipe them out.

106. “He will leave them like a barren, flat land.

107. “Not even the slightest hill will you see therein, nor a dip.”

108. On that day, everyone will follow the caller, without the slightest deviation. All sounds will be hushed before the Most Gracious; you will hear nothing but whispers.

109. On that day, intercession will be useless, except for those permitted by the Most Gracious, and those whose utterances conform to His will.

110. He knows their past and their future, while none encompasses His knowledge.

111. All faces will submit to the Living, the Eternal, and those who are burdened by their transgressions will fail.

112. As for those who worked righteousness, while believing, they will have no fear of injustice or adversity.

113. We thus revealed it, an Arabic Quran, and we cited in it all kinds of prophecies, that they may be saved, or it may cause them to take heed.

ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ
قُرْآنًا أَرْسَلْنَاهُ بِعِلْمٍ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نَسْتَعْصِرُهُ
أَوَلَمْ نَقْرَأْ عَلَيْكَ كِتَابَ مُوسَى
مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ فِيهِ مُبْتَلًى وَحِكْمَةً لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
وَقَالَ مُوسَى إِنْ كُنْتُمْ آمَنْتُمْ بِاللَّهِ فَاعْتَمِرُوا وَلاَ تَعْتَمِرُوا بِعِلْمٍ مِمَّا أُوتِيتُمْ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْعَلُونَ ذَلِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ
فَلَمَّا جَاءَ مُوسَى لِمِيقَاتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهُ رَبُّهُ قَالَ رَبِّ أَرِنِي أَنْظُرْ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ لَنْ تَرَانِي وَلَكِنِ انْظُرْ إِلَى الْجَبَلِ فَإِنِ اسْتَقَرَّ مَكَانَهُ فَسَوْفَ تَرَانِي فَلَمَّا تَجَلَّى رَبُّهُ لِلْجَبَلِ جَعَلَهُ دُكْهَانًا وَخَرَّ مُوسَى صَعِقًا فَلَمَّا أَفَاقَ قَالَ سُبْحَانَكَ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
قَالَ يَا مُوسَى إِنِّي اصْطَفَيْتُكَ عَلَى النَّاسِ بِرِسَالَتِي وَكَلَامِي فَخُذْ مَا آتَيْتُكَ وَكُنْ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ
وَقَلَبْنَا الْكَلِمَةَ لِيَكُونَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِيهَا لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
وَلِيَكُونَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا فِيهَا يُوقِنُونَ وَلِيَكُونَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ مِنْهَا يَقُولُوا لِلنَّاسِ أَلَا تَتَّبِعُونَ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ وَأَنْزَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
وَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ وَمَا أَنْتَ بِأَلْبِسِهِمْ بِشَيْءٍ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ إِلَّا نَذِيرًا
وَمَا قَدَمْنَا إِلَيْكَ قَبْلَهُ مِنْ كِتَابٍ وَلَا مِنْ رِسَالَةٍ إِلَّا كُنَّا جَاعِلِينَ إِيَّاهُ مُبْسِطًا وَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا الْجَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَافِرِينَ حَصِيرًا
قُلْ آمَنْتُ بِالْقُرْآنِ كُلِّهِ مَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ آمَنَ وَأَنْتُمْ بِهِ مُشْفِقُونَ
وَقُلْ آمَنْتُ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنْ كِتَابٍ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
وَقُلْ رَبِّمَغْفِرَةً وَرَحْمَةً وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
وَقُلْ لَا أُوتِيتُ بِهِ خَيْرًا وَلَا أَقُولُ إِنِّي مِنَ الْمُبْطِلِينَ

114. Most Exalted is **GOD**, the only true King. Do not rush into uttering the Quran before it is revealed to you, and say, “My Lord, increase my knowledge.”

*Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand*

115. We tested Adam in the past, but he forgot, and we found him indecisive.

116. And when we said to the angels, “Fall prostrate before Adam,” they fell prostrate, except Satan; he refused.

117. We then said, “O Adam, this is an enemy of you and your wife. Do not let him evict you from Paradise, lest you become miserable.

118. “You are guaranteed never to hunger therein, nor go unsheltered.

119. “Nor will you thirst therein, nor suffer from any heat.”

120. But the devil whispered to him, saying, “O Adam, shall I show you the tree of eternity and unending kingship?”

121. They ate from it, whereupon their bodies became visible to them, and they tried to cover themselves with the leaves of Paradise. Adam disobeyed his Lord, and went astray.

122. Then his Lord chose him, redeemed him, and guided him.

123. He said, “Go down therefrom, all of you, as enemies of one another. When guidance comes to you from Me, anyone who follows My guidance will not go astray, nor suffer any misery.

124. “As for the one who disregards My message, he will have a miserable life, and we will resurrect him on the Day of Resurrection blind.”

125. He will say, “My Lord, why did you summon me blind, when I used to be a seer?”

---

*20:115 When Satan challenged God’s absolute authority (38:69), you and I did not make a firm stand against Satan. God is giving us a chance, on this earth, to redeem ourselves by denouncing Satan and upholding God’s absolute authority (Appendix 7).*

126. He will say, “Because you forgot our revelations when they came to you, you are now forgotten.”

127. We thus requite those who transgress and refuse to believe in the revelations of their Lord. The retribution in the Hereafter is far worse and everlasting.

128. Does it ever occur to them how many previous generations we have annihilated? They are now walking in the homes of those before them. These are signs for those who possess intelligence.

129. If it were not for your Lord’s predetermined plan, they would have been judged immediately.

130. Therefore, be patient in the face of their utterances, and praise and glorify your Lord before sunrise and before sunset. And during the night glorify Him, as well as at both ends of the day, that you may be happy.

131. And do not covet what we bestowed upon any other people. Such are temporary ornaments of this life, whereby we put them to the test. What your Lord provides for you is far better, and everlasting.

**The Parents’ Responsibility**

132. You shall enjoy your family to observe the contact prayers (Salat), and steadfastly persevere in doing so. We do not ask you for any provisions; we are the ones who provide for you. The ultimate triumph belongs to the righteous.

**Why Messengers?**

133. They said, “If he could only show us a miracle from his Lord!” Did they not receive sufficient miracles with the previous messages?

134. Had we annihilated them before this, they would have said, “Our Lord, had You sent a messenger to us, we would have followed Your revelations, and would have avoided this shame and humiliation.”

135. Say, “All of us are waiting, so wait; you will surely find out who are on the correct path, and who are truly guided.”

وَلِلَّهِ الْمَشْرِقُ وَالْمَغْرِبُ فَأَيْنَمَا تُوَلُّوا فَثَمَّ وَجْهُ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ

أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
وَلَقَدْ وَرَثْنَا الْقُرَى وَبَدَّلْنَا بِهِمْ أَصْحَابَهَا وَكَتَبْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ فِي الْأَنْجِيَةِ وَفِي الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ
وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَأَذَقْنَاهُمْ شِقَابًا وَلَأَتَوْا عَلَيْهَا غَمَّازِينَ
فَصَبَّرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ وَزِيدْنَا لَهُمْ أَجَلًا إِلَى مَحْشَرِهِمْ
فَإِنَّكَ لَا تَجِدُ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا وَلَا تَجِدُ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَغْيِيرًا
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَى أُمَمٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْبَأْسَاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
فَلَوْلَا كَانَ قَوْمٌ مِنْهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ فَنَفَعْهُمْ إِيمَانُهُمْ وَلَكِنْ لَا يَسْتَكْثِرُونَ
فَلَمَّا نَسُوا مَا ذُكِّرُوا بِهِ أَشْرَكُوا بِهِ وَكَانُوا قَوْمًا مُجْرِمِينَ
فَكَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي كُلَّ شَاكِرٍ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَى بِآيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ
إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَقَارُونَ فَقَالُوا سَاحِرٌ كَذُوبٌ
فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا قَالُوا اقْتُلُوهُ وَإِنَّهُ لَكَذُوبٌ
فَأَخْرَجْنَاهُمْ مِنْ قُرًى كَانُوا فِيهَا ظَالِمِينَ وَكَانَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَرَةُ سَبْعِ لَيَالٍ وَثَمُودَ
فَأَخْرَجْنَاهُمْ مِنْ قَرْيَتِهِمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا مُجْرِمِينَ
وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّا لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مَكَانًا حَسَنًا وَرَزَقْنَاهُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَمَا هُمْ بِإِخْلَافِ أَمْرِنَا مُعْجِزِينَ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَاهُمْ كِتَابًا مُبِينًا هُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
فَمَا كَانُوا إِلَّا يَخْتَلِفُونَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًا بَيْنَهُمْ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
فَإِنَّكَ لَا تَهْدِي مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ
وَقَالُوا إِنْ نَتَّبِعِ الْهُدَى مَعَكَ نُخْرَجْ مِنْ أَرْضِنَا أََوَلَمْ نُخْرَجْ مِنْهَا سَبْقًا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعْجِزِينَ
وَقَالُوا إِنَّنَا وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا عَلَى أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَى آثَارِهِمْ مُقْتَدُونَ
وَقَالُوا لَئِنْ نَتَّبِعِ الْهُدَى مَعَكَ لَيُطْرَكُنَّا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ أَفَإِنَّا لَمِنَ الْمُفْتَرِينَ
أَمْ قَالُوا إِنْ نَتَّبِعِ الْهُدَى مَعَكَ لَيُخْرَجُنَّا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا بِالْبَاطِلِ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَفِيظٌ
وَقَالُوا مَتَى هُوَ قَالَ هُوَ قَرِيبٌ

فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًا صَفْصَفًا

فَأَمَّا يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَى النَّارِ نَارَ دَاوُدَ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهَا خَاشِعُونَ
لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ حَرَجَهَا وَهُمْ فِيهَا يُسْتَأْصَنُونَ

فَصَبَّرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ وَزِيدْنَا لَهُمْ أَجَلًا إِلَى مَحْشَرِهِمْ
فَإِنَّكَ لَا تَجِدُ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا وَلَا تَجِدُ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَغْيِيرًا
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَى بِآيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ
إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَقَارُونَ فَقَالُوا سَاحِرٌ كَذُوبٌ
فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا قَالُوا اقْتُلُوهُ وَإِنَّهُ لَكَذُوبٌ

# The Prophets (Al-Anbyaa’) 21:1-10

**Sura 21: The Prophets (Al-Anbyaa’)**

In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful

1. Fast approaching is the reckoning for the people, but they are unaware, averse.

**Opposition to New Revelations**

2. Whenever a reminder comes to them from their Lord, which is new, they listen to it heedlessly.

3. Their hearts are heedless. And the transgressors confer secretly: “Is he not just a human being like you? Would you accept magic when you see it?”*

4. He said, “My Lord knows every thought in the heaven and the earth. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.”

5. They even said, “Hallucinations,” “He made it up,” and, “He is a poet. Let him show us a miracle like the those of previous messengers.”

6. None of the communities that we annihilated in the past were believers. Are these people believers?

7. We did not send before you except men whom we inspired. Ask the experts if you do not know.

8. We did not give them bodies that did not eat, nor were they immortal.

9. We fulfilled our promise to them; we saved them with whomever we willed, and annihilated the transgressors.

10. We have sent down to you a scripture containing your message. Would you not understand?

---

*21:3 Although both the Bible (Malachi 3:3) and the Quran (3:81) clearly prophesy the advent of God’s Messenger of the Covenant, when he did appear, supported with ‘one of the greatest miracles’ (74:30-35), he was met with heedlessness and opposition. The divine assertion that every ‘new’ revelation is opposed has been proven by the fierce opposition to the Quran’s great miracle. (see Appendices 1 & 2).

One God

**The Prophets (Al-Anbyaa’) 21:25-35**

**One God/One Message/One Religion**

25. We did not send any messenger before you except with the inspiration: "There is no god except Me; you shall worship Me alone."

26. Still, they said, “The Most Gracious has begotten a son!”
Glory be to Him. All (messengers) are (His) honored servants.

27. They never initiate any utterances; they strictly follow His commands.

28. He knows their future and their past. They do not intercede, except for those already accepted by Him, and they are worried about their own necks.*

29. If any of them claims to be a god besides Him, we requite him with Hell; we thus reward the wicked.

*The Big Bang Theory Confirmed*

30. Do the unbelievers not realize that the heaven and the earth used to be one solid mass that we exploded into existence? And from water we made all living things. Would they believe?

31. And we placed on earth stabilizers, lest it tumbles with them, and we placed straight roads therein, that they may be guided.

32. And we rendered the sky a guarded ceiling. Yet, they are totally heedless of the signs therein.

33. And He is the One who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon; each floating in its own orbit.

34. We never decreed immortality for anyone before you; should you die, are they immortal?

35. Every soul will taste death, after we put you to the test through adversity, as well as prosperity, then to us you ultimately return.

**The Prophets (Al-Anbyaa’) 21:36-44**

**All Messengers Ridiculed**

36. When those who disbelieved see you, they ridicule you:
   “Is this the one who talks about your idols?”
   They totally disregard the message of the Most Gracious.

37. The human being is impatient by nature.
   I will surely show you My signs;
   do not be in such a hurry.

38. They challenge:
   “Where is that (retribution), if you are truthful?”

39. If only those who disbelieved could realize how it will be when they try to ward the fire off their faces and their backs!
   They will receive no help.

40. Indeed, it will come to them so suddenly, they will be utterly stunned.
   They can neither repel it, nor receive any respite.

41. Messengers before you have been ridiculed, and those who ridiculed them have incurred the consequences of their ridiculing.

**Humans’ Priorities Confused**

42. Say, “Who takes care of you during the night and the day, other than the Most Gracious?”
   Indeed, they are totally disregarding the message of their Lord.

43. Do they have gods who can protect them from Us?
   They cannot even help themselves.
   Nor can they accompany one another when they face Us.

44. We have provided for these people and their ancestors, up until an old age. Do they not see that every day on earth brings them closer to the end? Can they reverse this process?

وَلَا تُقَاتِلْهُمْ كُلَّهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتُوكَ الْإِسْلَامُ وَإِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِّنْ عِنْدِنَا وَإِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِّنْ عِنْدِنَا

وَلَقَدْ هَدَيْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَىٰ مَكَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

**The Prophets (Al-Anbyaa’) 21:45-57**

45. Say, “I am warning you in accordance with divine inspiration.”
However, the deaf cannot hear the call, when they are warned.

46. When a sample of your Lord’s retribution afflicts them,
they readily say, “We were indeed wicked.”

47. We will establish the scales of justice on the Day of Resurrection.
No soul will suffer any injustice. Even the equivalent of a mustard seed will be accounted for. We are the most efficient reckoners.

**Prophets Moses and Aaron**

48. We gave Moses and Aaron the Statute Book, and a beacon,
and a reminder for the righteous—

49. who reverence their Lord,
even when alone in their privacy, and they worry about the Hour.

50. This too is a blessed reminder that we have sent down. Are you denying it?

**Abraham**

51. Before that, we granted Abraham his understanding,
for we were fully aware of him.*

52. He said to his father and his people,
“What are these statues to which you are devoting yourselves?”

53. They said, “We found our parents worshiping them.”

54. He said, “Indeed, you and your parents have gone completely astray.”

55. They said, “Are you telling us the truth, or are you playing?”

56. He said, “Your only Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, who created them. This is my testimony.

57. “I swear by God, I have a plan to deal with your statues, as soon as you leave.”

---
*21:51 Was Abraham so smart as to discover God, or did God grant him the intelligence because He knew that he deserved to be saved? As it turns out, this whole world was created to redeem those among us who deserve redemption. When the angels suggested to throw us all in Hell, God told them, ‘I know what you do not know’ (2:30). At the same time, this world proves Satan’s incompetence as a god (App. 7).

58. He broke them into pieces, except for the big one,
    that they may refer to it.

59. They said, “Whoever did this to our gods
    is really a transgressor.”

60. They said, “We heard a youth threaten them;
    his name is Abraham.”

61. They said, “Bring him before the eyes
    of all the people;
    let them bear witness.”

62. They said, “Did you do this to our
    gods, O Abraham?”
    **Abraham Proves His Point**

63. He said, “It is that big one who did it.
    Go ask them, if they can speak.”

64. They were taken aback,
    and said to themselves,
    “Indeed, you have been wrong.”

65. Yet, they reverted to their old ideas:
    “You know full well that these
    cannot speak.”

66. He said, “Do you then worship
    besides GOD what possesses
    no power to benefit you
    or harm you?

67. “Shame on you and on whatever you
    worship besides GOD.
    Do you not understand?”
    **Profound Miracle**

68. They said, “Burn him and support your gods,
    if this is what you decide to do.”

69. We said, “O fire, be cool and safe for Abraham.”

70. Thus, they schemed against him, but we made them the losers.

71. We saved him, and we saved Lot,
    to the land that we blessed for all the people.

72. And we granted him Isaac and Jacob as a gift,
    and we made them both righteous.

**The Prophets (Al-Anbyaa’) 21:73-81**

**Abraham: Delivered All Religious Duties of Islam**

73. We made them imams who guided in accordance with our commandments, and we taught them how to work righteousness, and how to observe the contact prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat).*
To us, they were devoted worshipers.

**Lot**

74. And we granted Lot wisdom and knowledge, and we saved him from the community that practiced abominations; they were wicked and evil people.

75. We admitted him into our mercy, for he was righteous.

**Noah**

76. And, before that, Noah called and we responded to him. We saved him and his family from the great disaster.

77. We supported him against the people who rejected our revelations. They were evil people, so we drowned them all.

**David and Solomon**

78. And David and Solomon once ruled with regard to someone’s crop that was destroyed by another’s sheep. We witnessed their judgment.

79. We granted Solomon the correct understanding, though we endowed both of them with wisdom and knowledge. We committed the mountains to glorify (God) and to serve David, as well as the birds. This is what we did.

80. And we taught him the skill of making shields to protect you in war. Are you then thankful?

81. For Solomon, we committed the wind gusting and blowing in his service. He could direct it as he wished, to whatever land he chose, and we blessed such land for him. We are fully aware of all things.

**The Prophets (Al-Anbyaa’) 21:82-90**

82. And of the devils there were those who would dive for him (to harvest the sea), or do whatever else he commanded them to do. We kept them in his service.

**Job**

83. And Job implored his Lord: “Adversity has befallen me, and, of all the merciful ones, You are the Most Merciful.”

84. We responded to him, relieved his adversity, and restored his family for him, and doubled them. That was a mercy from us, and a reminder for the worshipers.

85. Also, Ismail, Idris, Zal-Kifl; all were steadfast, patient.

86. We admitted them into our mercy, for they were righteous.

**Jonah**

87. And Zan-Noon (Jonah, “the one with an ‘N’ in his name”), abandoned his mission in protest, thinking that we could not control him. He ended up imploring from the darkness (of the big fish’s belly): “There is no other god besides You. Be You glorified. I have committed an error.”

88. We responded to him, and saved him from misery; we thus save the believers.

**Zachariah and John**

89. And Zachariah implored his Lord: “My Lord, do not keep me without an heir, though You are the best inheritor.”

90. We responded to him and granted him John; we fixed his wife for him. That is because they always hastened to work righteousness, and implored us in situations of joy, as well as fear. To us, they were reverent.

**Arabic Text:**

وَمِنَ الشَّيَاطِينِ مَنْ يَغُوصُونَ لَهُ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذَلِكَ وَكَانُوا لَهُ مُخْبِتِينَ
وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ إِنَّمَا أُوتِيتُ هَذَا مِنْ عِندِ الْعِلْمِ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا مُمْتَرِبُونَ
وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ إِنَّمَا أَخْبَرْتُكُمْ بِمَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ فَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا الْأَمْرَ مِنْهُ وَقُلْ إِنَّمَا أَتَّبِعُ مَا يُوحَى إِلَيَّ وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ الْقَوْلَ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَتَّبِعُوهُ إِلَّا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ
وَقَالُوا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ إِلَّا مُفْسِدِينَ
وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ فَإِذَا أُنْزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ مُبَيِّنَةٌ وَقُبِضَتْ قُلُوبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَحَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ الرَّحْمَنِ وَكَانُوا لِلْحَقِّ مُحِقِّينَ
وَقَالُوا لَوْلَا كُنَّا نَزِلْنَا عَلَيْهِ آيَاتٍ سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَمْ كُنَّا نَزِلْنَا أَمْ كَانُوا لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ إِعْجَاجًا كَذَلِكَ نَصْرِفُ بِالْأَثِيمِينَ
وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَا تَأْتِنَا بِهَذَا الْقُرْآنِ بِالْأَمْرِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ إِلَّا بِالْأَمْرِ تَفْتَرُونَ
فَقُلْ لَوْ كَانَ الْبَحْرُ مِدَادًا لِكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّي لَنَفِدَ الْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنْفَدَ كَلِمَاتُ رَبِّي وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِ مُزَاجًا
وَقُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يُوحَى إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَاسْتَقِيمُوا إِلَيْهِ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ وَوَيْلٌ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ
الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُمْ بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا فَأَخَذَهُمُ الطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ
فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَأَصْحَابَ السَّفِينَةِ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا آيَةً وَلِلْعَالَمِينَ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا دَاوُودَ إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَظْلِمُونَ
يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ شَدِيدٍ مِثْلَ يَوْمِ عَاشُورَاءَ قَدْ أَعْلَمَكُمُ اللَّهُ فَلَا تَكُونُوا فِي غَفْلَةٍ مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَفِي غَفْلَةٍ عَنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ
يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ مُحِيطٍ
يَا دَاوُودُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاكَ خَلِيفَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الْهَوَى فَيُضِلَّكَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ بِمَا نَسُوا يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ
وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِنْ لُغُوبٍ
فَاسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ الرَّحْمَنُ فَاسْأَلْ بِهِ خَبِيرًا
ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَسَوَّاهَا وَعَدَّ شُعَاعَ الشَّمْسِ وَالْقَمَرِ وَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ تَأْمُرُهُ قَدْرٌ مُقَدَّرَةٌ
وَأَمْرُهُ إِذَا أَرَادَ شَيْئًا أَنْ يَقُولَ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا إِيَّاهُ هُدًى لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَلَّا تَتَّخِذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا آَخَرَ إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ شَدِيدٍ
يَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَتِيَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَأَنْ أَوفِيَ بِعَهْدِي عَلَيْكُمْ فَاتَّقُونِ
وَآمِنُوا بِمَا أَنْزَلْتُ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا مَعَكُمْ وَلَا تَكُونُوا أَكْثَرَ الْكَافِرِينَ
وَلَا تَشْتَرُوا بِآيَاتِي ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا وَاتَّقُونِ
وَلَا تَلْبِسُوا الْحَقَّ بِالْبَاطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُوا الْحَقَّ وَأَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
وَعَادُوا وَقَالُوا لَنْ نُؤْمِنَ بِهَذَا الْقُرْآنِ وَلَا بِالَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَإِنْ كُنَّا لَمُشْرِكِينَ
فَقُلْ سَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُسْتَأْصِلٌ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا النُّبُوَّةَ وَالْكِتَابَ فَمِنْهُمْ مُهْتَدٍ وَكَثِيرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ
ثُمَّ قَفَّيْنَا عَلَى آثَارِهِمْ بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيْنَا بِعِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَآتَيْنَاهُ الْإِنجِيلَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوهُ رَأْفَةً وَرَحْمَةً وَرَهْبَانِيَّةً ابْتَدَعُوهَا مَا كَتَبْنَاهَا عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَّا ابْتِغَاءَ رِضْوَانِ اللَّهِ فَمَا رَعَوْهَا حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهَا فآتَيْنَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنْهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ وَكَثِيرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ
يَا عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ اذْكُرْ نِعْمَتِيَ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى وَالِدَتِكَ إِذْ أَيِّدْتُكَ بِرُوحِ الْقُدُسِ تُكَلِّمُ النَّاسَ فِي الْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًا وَإِذْ عَلَّمْتُكَ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَالتَّوْرَاةَ وَالْإِنجِيلَ وَإِذْ تَخْلُقُ مِنَ الطِّينِ كَهَيْئَةِ الطَّيْرِ بِإِذْنِي فَتُنْفِخُ فِيهَا فَتَكُونُ طَيْرًا بِإِذْنِي وَتُبْرِئُ الْأَكْمَهَ وَالْأَبْرَصَ بِإِذْنِي وَإِذْ تُخْرِجُ الْمَوْتَى بِإِذْنِي وَإِذْ كَانْتُ مِنَ الْغُبَرَاتِ فَأَنْشَأْتُكَ وَإِذْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصِّبْيَانِ تَخْتَلِفُ الْأَمْرَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ وَإِذْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْكَهْلِ وَكَانَتْ شَيْبَتِي عَلَيْكَ وَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْعُجْبَانِ فَذَكَرْتُكَ فَكَذَلِكَ نُنْجِي الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَقُلْ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا سَأَعْمَلُ فِي رَبِّي إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ مُحِيطٍ
فَكْفُرْ بِهِمْ وَاسْتَعْذِرْ إِلَيْهِمْ وَقُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْنَا الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَوْ نَرَى رَبَّنَا لَقَدِ اسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْا عِتِيًّا
فَلَمَّا جَاءَتْهُمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالُوا مَا هَذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُفْتَرًى وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ إِلَّا مُفْتَرِينَ
وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَهَدَى النَّاسَ جَمِيعًا وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِرَبِيبٍ وَلَا هُمْ عَلَيْكَ بِمُشْفِقِينَ
وَمَا كَانَ النَّاسُ إِلَّا أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً فَاخْتَلَفُوا وَلَوْ لَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ فِيمَا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
وَمَا يَمْلِكُ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِنْ يَمْلِكُوا مِنْ نَشَأَةٍ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَهُمْ فِيهِ شِرْكٌ وَمَا عَلَيْهِ مِنْهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَى بِآيَاتِنَا أَنْ أَخْرِجْ قَوْمَكَ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَذَكِّرْهُمْ بِأَيَّامِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
وَمُوسَى قَالَ إِنِّي قَتَلْتُ مِنْهُمْ نَفْسًا فَأَخَافُ أَنْ يَقْتُلُونِ
وَقَالَ الَّذِي آمَنَ مِنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَتَخَوَّفُ أَنْ يُقَضَى عَلَيْهِ مِنْ قِبَلِ فِرْعَوْنَ أَوْ أَنْ يُصْبِحَ فِي الْأَرْضِ آمِرًا لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْأَسَ مِنْهُمْ أَذْهَبَ بِهِ إِلَى بَيْتِهِ وَكَانَ بَيْتُهُ مُنْتَصِرًا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَانَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَرْفَعُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَكَانَ فِرْعَوْنُ مِنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ
وَلَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ تَوَجَّهَ بِالْغَيْبِ وَأَنَا أَرَاكَ مِنْ الْغَائِبِينَ
فَأَخَذْنَاهُ وَغَرَّقْنَاهُ فَإِنَّا كُنَّا لَهُ لَنَظِيرًا
وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي السَّمَاءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلْنَاهَا زِينَةً لِلنَّاظِرِينَ
وَمَا كُنَّا لِبَنِي آدَمَ خَلْقًا مِنْ قَبْلُ وَمَا نَحْنُ مُعَذِّبِينَ
