Arabic Text:

ولَئِنْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّيحَ الْعَاصِفَ لَمُصْفَرُّوا مُصْفَرِينَ
وَمَا أَنتَ بِهَدِيَّ الْعُمِيِّ عَنْ ضَلَالِهِمْ وَمَا هَدَيْتَ مَنْ أَنتَ بِهِ خَائِنٌ
إِلَّا مَنْ آتَيْنَاهُ رَحْمَتَنَا وَأَخَذْنَا بِالْعُقَدَةِ الَّتِي فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْعَوْنَ
وَقُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يُوحَى إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَاسْتَقِيمُوا إِلَيْهِ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ وَوَيْلٌ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ
الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُمْ بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ
وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ سَيَقُولُونَ اللَّهُ قُلْ أَفَلا تَتَّقُونَ
لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَإِنْ تُبْدُوا مَا فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ يُحَاسِبْكُمْ بِهِ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ يَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَى أُمَمٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْبَأْسَاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
فَلَوْلَا نَصَرَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ فَكَانَ ذَلِكَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
فَلَوْلَا كَانَ النَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً لَجَعَلْنَا لِمَنْ يَكْفُرُ بِالرَّحْمَانِ لِبَابًا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُ آثَارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَأَخَذْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ مُحْصِرِينَ
وَهَذِهِ حَقِيقَةٌ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ بِهَا بَيْنَهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا كَافِرِينَ
وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِالْعَذَابِ وَإِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا جَابِرِينَ
وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَاهُمْ بِآيَةٍ مُبِينَةٍ فَإِنَّهُمْ قَالُوا إِنَّمَا سَحَرَ مُوسَى وَإِنَّا لَفِي شَكٍّ مِّمَّا يَدْعُونَا إِلَيْهِ وَكَذَلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ
وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا آلَ لُوطٍ بِالْعَذَابِ وَإِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا فَاسِقِينَ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَامِيَةً مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ وَأَعْجَبْنَاهُمْ فَعِلْتُمْ سَيِّئَةً مُبِينًا
وَلَقَدْ سَأَلَهُمْ سُلَيْمَانُ وَقَالَ إِنَّ الْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُوا قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوا أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَا أَذِلَّةً وَكَذَلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
قَالَ إِنِّي مُؤْتَمَنٌ عَلَيْهِ فَأَتُونِي بِسُلْطَانٍ فَسَأَخُصَّ بِهِ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
قَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ إِنَّهُ قَدْ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيَّ رَسُولٌ فَإِنَّهُ إِلَّا أَنْ أَرْجِعَ إِلَيْهِ وَأَحْضُرَ بِهِ عَذَابَ اللَّهِ أَوْ يَخُضَّنِي اللَّهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ
قَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَفْتُونِي فِي أَمْرِي إِنِّي لَا أَرَى حَقَّ سَبِيلِي
قَالُوا إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْمُفْتُونَ كُلٌّ فِي أَمْرِهِ بَدِيعٌ فَأَمَّا بَعْضُنَا فَقَالُوا لَا تَتَّخِذْ فِرْعَوْنَ وَأَخَاهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا دِينَكُمْ إِنَّهُمَا فَسَقَا
وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا فَإِنَّهُ سَيَقُولُ إِنِّي أَنَا رَسُولُ الرَّحْمَانِ
فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَكَانُوا لَفِي الْآخِرَةِ مُشْرِكِينَ
فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ وَإِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا ظَالِمِينَ
فَكَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُجْرِمِينَ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَى وَأَخَاهُ هَارُونَ بِآيَاتِنَا إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلِئِهِ فَقَالَا إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
فَلَمَّا جَاءُوهُمُ قَالَا إِنَّا لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
قَالَ أَلَا تَخَافُونَ أَنَّهُ يَرْجِعَكُمْ إِلَى سُلْطَانِهِ فَيُفْسِدَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَيَخْلَ قُلُوبَ أَهْلِهَا وَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ
قَالَ فَمَا رَبُّكُمَا يَا مُوسَى
قَالَ رَبُّنَا الَّذِي أَعْطَى كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلْقَهُ ثُمَّ هَدَى
قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ الْقُرُونِ الْأُولَى
قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ رَبِّي فِي كِتَابٍ لَا يَضِلُّ رَبِّي وَلَا يَسْتَبْدِعُ
قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
قَالَ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ بِهِ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ وَكَانُوا لِلْحَقِّ مُحِجِّرِينَ
قَالَ فَمَا بَالُهُمْ
قَالَ هُمْ فِي ضَلَالٍ وَمُثْقَفٍ
قَالَ فَمَا بَالُكَ تَقْتُلُ نَفْسًا تَزْعُمُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ لَنْ يُحْيِيهَا إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ
قَالَ وَرَبِّي لَأُقَتِلَنَّهَا لَئِنْ أَتَيْتَنِي بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ
فَأَخْرَجْنَاهَا وَهِيَ تَسْتَغِيثُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْهَا فَلَمَّا أَلْقَيْنَا عَلَيْهَا مِنْ عَذَابِنَا إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَسْتَغِيثُهُمْ وَكَانُوا لِلْعَذَابِ مُشْرِكِينَ
وَلَقَدْ وَصَّيْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ فِي الْكِتَابِ لَتُفْسِدُنَّ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَلَتَعْلُنَّ عُلُوًّا كَبِيرًا
فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ أُولَاهُمَا بَعَثْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ عِبَادًا لَنَا أُولِي بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ فَجَاسُوا خِلَالَ الدِّيَارِ وَكَانَ وَعْدًا مَفْعُولًا
ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَا لَكُمُ الْكَرَّةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَمْدَدْنَاكُمْ بِأَمْوَالٍ وَبَنِينَ وَجَعَلْنَاكُمْ أَكْثَرَ نَفِيرًا
لَوْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا تُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا تَنْقُطُعُوا أَرْحَامَكُمْ لَوْلَا أَنْ يَكُونُوا قَوْمًا سَافِرِينَ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ
أَنْ لَا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا اللَّهَ إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
قَالُوا يَا نُوحُ مَا جِئْتَنَا بِبَيِّنَةٍ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَارِكِ آَلِهَتِنَا عَنِ امْرِنَا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
فَأَكْذَبُوكُمْ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا لِي وَرَبِّي إِنَّهُ هُوَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
وَقَالَ لَا تَسْتَغْفِرُوا لِي وَلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُوا لِي إِنِّي أَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكُمْ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ رَحِيمٌ رَحِيمٌ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَى ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا فَقَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ هُوَ أَنْشَأَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ وَاسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوا إِلَيْهِ إِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٌ مُجِيبٌ
قَالُوا يَا صَالِحُ إِنَّكَ كُنْتَ فِينَا مَرْجُوًّا قَبْلَ هَذَا أَتَقْتُلُنَا وَمَا يُحْيِيكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ لَوْ كُنْتُ عَلَى مَا زَعْتُمْ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ
يَا قَوْمِ لِلَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
قَالُوا يَا صَالِحُ إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ وَمَنْ مَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُفْتَرِينَ
قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَرَزَقَنِي مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَى مَا أَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا الْإِصْلَاحَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ وَمَا تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى رَبِّي شَيْئًا
قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَرَزَقَنِي مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَى مَا أَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا الْإِصْلَاحَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ وَمَا تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى رَبِّي شَيْئًا
قَالُوا إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مِنَ الْمُفْتَرِينَ
فَأَخَذَهُمْ الْعَذَابُ وَإِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا ظَالِمِينَ
فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَمَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ خَلَائِفَ وَأَغْرَقْنَا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَإِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا جَابِرِينَ
وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي الْقُرْآنِ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ حَبَلًا مَّشْنُوقًا
وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ أَهْلَ بَيْتٍ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ مَصَارِعَ وَأَنْهَرًا وَفَاكِهَةً وَقَالُوا بَلْ وَالِدَنَا الْغَاوُونَ
وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ مَسَاجِدَ لِيَتَطَهَّرُوا فِيهَا وَيُطَّفَى عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ ثَمَرَاتِ مَا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ وَلَا يَسْتَكْبِرُوا بِهِ وَيَذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَى مَا رَزَقَهُمْ مِنْ بَهِيمَةِ الْأَنْعَامِ وَقَالَ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْبَرُّ الْعَلِيمُ
وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ مَسَاجِدَ لِيَتَطَهَّرُوا فِيهَا وَيُطَّفَى عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ ثَمَرَاتِ مَا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ وَلَا يَسْتَكْبِرُوا بِهِ وَيَذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَى مَا رَزَقَهُمْ مِنْ بَهِيمَةِ الْأَنْعَامِ وَقَالَ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْبَرُّ الْعَلِيمُ

**Sura 31: Luqmaan (Luqmaan)**

In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful

1. A. L. M.*

2. These (letters) are miracles of this book of wisdom.

3. A beacon and a mercy for the pious.

4. Who observe the contact prayers (Salat), give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and as regards the Hereafter, they are absolutely certain.

5. They are following the guidance from their Lord; they are the winners.

6. Among the people, there are those who uphold baseless Hadith, and thus divert others from the path of GOD without knowledge, and take it in vain. These have incurred a shameful retribution.

7. And when our revelations are recited to the one of them, he turns away in arrogance as if he never heard them, as if his ears are deaf. Promise him a painful retribution.

8. Surely, those who believe and lead a righteous life have deserved the gardens of bliss.

9. Eternally they abide therein. This is the truthful promise of GOD. He is the Almighty, Most Wise.

10. He created the heavens without pillars that you can see. He established on earth stabilizers (mountains) lest it tumbles with you, and He spread on it all kinds of creatures. And we send down from the sky water to grow all kinds of beautiful plants.

11. Such is the creation of GOD; show me what any idols besides Him have created. Indeed, the transgressors are far astray.

---

**Arabic Text:**

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

1. أَلَمْ
2. تَلَقَّفْنَ هَٰذِهِ الْقُرْآنَ
3. إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ لِلنَّاسِ بَلَاغًا وَمَوْعِظَةً وَشِفَاءً وَرَحْمَةً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
4. وَالَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَاةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُمْ بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
5. لَهُمْ جَزَاءُ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
6. إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ فَاعْبُدِ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ الدِّينَ
7. أَلَا لِلَّهِ الدِّينُ الْخَالِصُ وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَافِرِينَ حَصِيرًا
8. قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ
9. لَا أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ وَلَا أَنْتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ وَلَا أَنَا عَابِدٌ مَا عَبَدتُّمْ وَلَا أَنْتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِيَ دِينِ
10. أَلَا إِنَّهُ حَقٌّ وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
11. قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ وَكَفَرْتُمْ بِهِ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ عَلَىٰ مِثْلِهِ فَآمَنَ وَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ

## Page 431

Luqmaan 31:12-19

---

Luqmaan’s Wisdom

12. We have endowed Luqmaan with wisdom: “You shall be appreciative of **GOD**.”
Whoever is appreciative is appreciative for his own good,
but if one turns unappreciative, then **GOD** is in no need, Most Praised.

13. Thus, Luqmaan said to his son, as he enlightened him,
“O my son, do not set up any idols besides **GOD**; idolatry is a gross injustice.”

14. We enjoined the human being to honor his parents.
His mother bore him, and the load got heavier and heavier. It takes
two years (of intensive care) until weaning. You shall be appreciative
of Me, and of your parents. To Me is the ultimate destiny.

15. If they try to force you to set up idols besides Me, do not obey them.
But continue to treat them amicably in this world. You shall follow only
the path of those who have submitted to Me. Ultimately, you all return
to Me, then I will inform you of everything you have done.

Luqmaan’s Advice

16. “O my son, know that even something as tiny as a mustard seed,
deep inside a rock, be it in the heavens or the earth, **GOD** will
bring it. **GOD** is Sublime, Cognizant.

17. “O my son, you shall observe the contact prayers (Salat),
enjoin righteousness and forbid evil, and remain steadfast in the face of
adversity. These are the most honorable traits.

18. “You shall not treat the people with arrogance,
nor shall you walk on earth proudly.
**GOD** does not like the arrogant showoffs.

19. “Walk humbly and lower your voice—the ugliest voice is the donkey’s voice.”

---
*31:13 How will you feel if you take care of a child, give him the best education, and prepare him for life, only to see him thank someone else? Thus is idolatry; injustice.

---
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا لُقْمَانَ الْحِكْمَةَ أَنْ شَكُرْ لِلَّهِ وَمَنْ يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا فَأَخَذَهُمُ الطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ
وَقَالَ لُقْمَانُ رَبِّ إِنِّي مَأْزُونٌ بِصُغْرَى مَا فِيَّ وَإِنِّي خَافُ أَنْ أَعْصِيَ رَبِّي وَإِنْ تَرَكَانِي فَإِنَّكَ أَنْتَ أَطْهَرُ مِنِّي وَتَقِيَّتُكَ خَيْرٌ فَأَمَرَ رَبُّهُ أَنْ تَسْلُخْ لَهُ وَقَالَ وَهُمْ قَالُوا إِنَّ الْمَسِيحَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَكَلِمَتُهُ أَلْقَاهَا إِلَى مَرْيَمَ وَرُوحٌ مِّنْهُ فَآمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَلَا تَقُولُوا ثَلَاثَةٌ انْتَهُوا خَيْرًا لَكُمْ إِنَّمَا اللَّهُ إِلَهُ وَاحِدٌ سُبْحَانَهُ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ وَلَدٌ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
وَلَقَدْ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ آدَمَ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ
وَلَقَدْ عَلَّمَ آدَمَ الْأَسْمَاءَ كُلَّهَا ثُمَّ عَرَضَهُمْ عَلَى الْمَلَائِكَةِ فَقَالَ أَنْبِئُونِي بِأَسْمَاءِ هَؤُلَاءِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
قَالُوا سُبْحَانَكَ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَا إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمْتَنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ
قَالَ يَا آدَمُ أَنْبِئْهُمْ بِأَسْمَائِهِمْ فَإِذَا أَنْبَأْتَهُمْ بِأَسْمَائِهِمْ قَالَ اللَّهُ إِنَّكَ لَا تَعْلَمُ هَذَا وَقَالَ اللَّهُ إِنَّمَا يُخْفِي عَلَى اللَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ
وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِ نَفْسُهُ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ
إِذَا جَلَسَ وَإِذَا قَامَ
وَلَقَدْ حَفِظْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِفْظًا شَدِيدًا وَاتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً قُلْ سَتَعْلَمُونَ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَى بِآيَاتِنَا أَنْ أَخْرِجْ قَوْمَكَ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَذَكِّرْهُمْ بِأَيَّامِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
وَلَقَدْ وَصَّيْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ وَهْنًا عَلَى وَهْنٍ وَفِصَالُهُ فِي عَامَيْنِ فَاشْكُرْنِي وَأَبَاكَ وَأُمَّكَ إِلَيَّ الْمَصِيرُ
وإِنْ جَاهَدَاكَ عَلَى أَنْ تُشْرِكَ بِي مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا وَصَاحِبْهُمَا فِي الدُّنْيَا مَعْرُوفًا وَاتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ مَنْ أَنَابَ إِلَيَّ ثُمَّ إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
يَا بُنَيَّ إِنَّ هَذَا هُوَ عَبْدٌ لَّنَا كَرِيمٌ
لَّقَدْ آتَيْنَاهُ مِنْ لَدُنَّا حِكْمَةً وَفَضَّلْنَاهُ بِهَا عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ
وَلَقَدْ هَادَيْنَاهُ فِي السَّبِيلِ مُسْتَقِيمًا
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا لُقْمَانَ الْحِكْمَةَ قُلْ هَلْ يَنْتَظِرُونَ إِلَّا مِثْلَ عَامِي هَذَا وَقَبْلَهُ أَلَا يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا لُقْمَانَ الْحِكْمَةَ أَنْ شَكُرْ لِلَّهِ وَمَنْ يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا فَأَخَذَهُمُ الطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ
وَقَالَ لُقْمَانُ رَبِّ إِنِّي مَأْزُونٌ بِصُغْرَى مَا فِيَّ وَإِنِّي خَافُ أَنْ أَعْصِيَ رَبِّي وَإِنْ تَرَكَانِي فَإِنَّكَ أَنْتَ أَطْهَرُ مِنِّي وَتَقِيَّتُكَ خَيْرٌ فَأَمَرَ رَبُّهُ أَنْ تَسْلُخْ لَهُ وَقَالَ وَهُمْ قَالُوا إِنَّ الْمَسِيحَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَكَلِمَتُهُ أَلْقَاهَا إِلَى مَرْيَمَ وَرُوحٌ مِّنْهُ فَآمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَلَا تَقُولُوا ثَلَاثَةٌ انْتَهُوا خَيْرًا لَكُمْ إِنَّمَا اللَّهُ إِلَهُ وَاحِدٌ سُبْحَانَهُ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ وَلَدٌ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
وَلَقَدْ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ آدَمَ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ
وَلَقَدْ عَلَّمَ آدَمَ الْأَسْمَاءَ كُلَّهَا ثُمَّ عَرَضَهُمْ عَلَى الْمَلَائِكَةِ فَقَالَ أَنْبِئُونِي بِأَسْمَاءِ هَؤُلَاءِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
قَالُوا سُبْحَانَكَ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَا إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمْتَنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ
قَالَ يَا آدَمُ أَنْبِئْهُمْ بِأَسْمَائِهِمْ فَإِذَا أَنْبَأْتَهُمْ بِأَسْمَائِهِمْ قَالَ اللَّهُ إِنَّكَ لَا تَعْلَمُ هَذَا وَقَالَ اللَّهُ إِنَّمَا يُخْفِي عَلَى اللَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ
وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِ نَفْسُهُ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ
إِذَا جَلَسَ وَإِذَا قَامَ

20. Do you not see that **GOD** has committed in your service everything in the heavens and the earth, and has showered you with His blessings—obvious and hidden? Yet, some people argue about **GOD** without knowledge, without guidance, and without (knowing) the enlightening scripture.

**Following Parents Blindly: A Common Tragedy**

21. And when they are told, “Follow these revelations of **GOD**,” they say, “No, we follow only what we found our parents doing.”
What if the devil is leading them to the agony of Hell?

**The Strongest Bond**

22. Only those who submit completely to **GOD**, while leading a righteous life, have gotten hold of the strongest bond. For **GOD** is in full control of all things.

23. As for those who disbelieve, do not be saddened by their disbelief; to us is their ultimate return. We will then inform them of everything they had done. **GOD** is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.

24. We let them enjoy temporarily, then commit them to severe retribution.

25. If you ask them, “Who created the heavens and the earth,” they will say, “**GOD**.” Say, “Praise be to **GOD**.” Indeed, most of them do not know.

26. To **GOD** belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. **GOD** is the Most Rich, Most Praised.

**These Are All the Words We Need**

27. If all the trees on earth were made into pens, and the ocean supplied the ink, augmented by seven more oceans, the words of **GOD** would not run out. **GOD** is Almighty, Most Wise.

28. The creation and resurrection of all of you is the same as that of one person. **GOD** is Hearer, Seer.

وَمَا بِكُمْ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَلَا يُنْفِقُوهَا وَإِذَا نُفِقَتْ فَلَا يُرْفَقُ بِهَا وَهُمْ بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ

وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ أَمِنُوا وَاتَّقَوْا لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَى بِآيَاتِنَا وَأَلْهَكْنَا بِهَا فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمَهُ فَاضْطَرَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ حَبْلِ الْغَرَقِ وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنَّمَا أُرْسِلْتُمْ بِسِحْرٍ

وَلَقَدْ جَرَيْنَا بِمُوسَى بِآيَاتِنَا فَسَحَرَ بِهَا فِرْعَوْنُ وَقَوْمُهُ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ

وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِبْرَةً هَلْ يُسْمَعُونَ أَوْ هُمْ إِلَّا مُسْتَكْبِرُونَ

وَقَالُوا لَنْ نُؤْمِنَ بِهَذَا الْقُرْآنِ وَلا بِالَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَإِنْ كُنَّا لَفِي شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَذْكُرُنَا

فَقُلْ سِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ انْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ

وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلا تَكُ فِي ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ

وَقَالُوا لَنْ نُؤْمِنَ بِهَذَا الْقُرْآنِ وَلا بِالَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَإِنْ كُنَّا لَفِي شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَذْكُرُنَا

فَقُلْ سِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ انْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ

وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ أَمِنُوا وَاتَّقَوْا لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ مِنْ سُلَالَةٍ مِّنْ طِينٍ

ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاهُ نُطْفَةً فِي قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ

ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا النُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْمُضْغَةَ عِظَامًا فَكَسَوْنَا الْعِظَامَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَاهُ خَلْقًا آَخَرَ فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ

ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ

ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ

وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَائِقَ وَكُنَّا فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَفِعْلِ الْلَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَبَاسًا لِّمَنْ نُرِيدُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفُورُ

وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُطْلِعَكُمْ عَلَى الْغَيْبِ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَجْتَبِي مِنْ رُّسُلِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ فَآَمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَإِنْ تُؤْمِنُوا فَسَتَرْضَوْا

وَلَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَى وَالْبَصِيرُ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَتْلُو عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ وَهُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ

وَلَا تَسْتَوِي الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةُ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي السَّمَاءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّاهَا لِلنَّاظِرِينَ

وَحَفِظْنَاهَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ مَّرِيدٍ

إِلَّا مَنْ اِخْتَبَأَ فِي سَمَّاعٍ فَأَلْقَى عَلَيْهِ حَجَرًا مِّنْ مَرْجَانٍ

فَلَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَنْظُرُونَ

وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لِلْجَهَنَّمَ أَصْحَابًا كُلَّمَا مَاتَ مِنْهُمْ خَلَفَهُ آَخَرُ فَحُشِرُوا لَهَا كُلَّهُمْ

هَذَا قِصَاصُ الْأَعْمَى وَالْبَصِيرِ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ أُولَئِكَ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ

وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مَوَاضِيعَ مُبَارَكَاتٍ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا مَقَامَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ

وَوَعَدْنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ أَنِ اِقْتَرَفَا ذَلِكَ مِنْ أَهْلِهِمَا إِنَّهُ وَعْدُ مُسْتَقِيمٌ

وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا الْكَعْبَةَ بَيْتًا مُثَمَّنًا لِّالنَّاسِ وَأَمَنًا وَاتَّخِذُوا مَقَامَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى وَعَهِدْنَا إِلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ أَن طَهِّرَا بَيْتِيَ لِلطَّائِفِينَ وَالْعَاكِفِينَ وَالرُّكَّعِ السُّجُودِ

وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا الْكَعْبَةَ بَيْتًا مُثَمَّنًا لِّالنَّاسِ وَأَمَنًا وَاتَّخِذُوا مَقَامَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى وَعَهِدْنَا إِلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ أَن طَهِّرَا بَيْتِيَ لِلطَّائِفِينَ وَالْعَاكِفِينَ وَالرُّكَّعِ السُّجُودِ

وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا الْكَعْبَةَ بَيْتًا مُثَمَّنًا لِّالنَّاسِ وَأَمَنًا وَاتَّخِذُوا مَقَامَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى وَعَهِدْنَا إِلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ أَن طَهِّرَا بَيْتِيَ لِلطَّائِفِينَ وَالْعَاكِفِينَ وَالرُّكَّعِ السُّجُودِ

وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا الْكَعْبَةَ بَيْتًا مُثَمَّنًا لِّالنَّاسِ وَأَمَنًا وَاتَّخِذُوا مَقَامَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى وَعَهِدْنَا إِلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ أَن طَهِّرَا بَيْتِيَ لِلطَّائِفِينَ وَالْعَاكِفِينَ وَالرُّكَّعِ السُّجُودِ

Luqmaan 31:29-34

**God ALONE Worthy of Worship**

29. Do you not realize that **GOD** merges the night into the day,
and merges the day into the night?
And that He has committed the sun and the moon;
each running in its orbit for a specific life span?
And that **GOD** is fully Cognizant of everything you do?

30. This proves that **GOD** is the truth, that any idol they set up besides Him
is falsehood, and that **GOD** is the Most High, Most Great.

31. Do you not see that the ships roam the sea, carrying **GOD**’s
bounties, to show you some of His signs? In this, there are
signs for everyone who is steadfast, appreciative.

32. When violent waves surround them, they implore **GOD**, sincerely
devoting the religion to Him alone. But as soon as He saves them
to the shore, some of them revert. None discards our revelations
except the betrayer, unappreciative.

33. O people, you shall reverence your Lord, and fear a day when a father
cannot help his child, nor a child can help his father. Certainly, **GOD**’s
promise is truth. Therefore, do not be distracted by this life; do not
be distracted from **GOD** by illusions.

34. With **GOD** is the knowledge about the Hour (end of the world).* He is
the One who sends down the rain, and He knows the contents of the womb.
No soul knows what will happen to it tomorrow, and no one knows in which
land he or she will die. **GOD** is Omniscient, Cognizant.

---

**Sura 32: Prostration (Al-Sajdah)**

*31:34 In accordance with 72:27, God has revealed the end of the world through His Messenger of the Covenant. See 15:87, 20:15, and Appendix 25 for the details.

**Prostration (Al-Sajdah) 32:1-11**

**In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful**

1. A. L. M.*

2. The book is, without a doubt, a revelation from the Lord of the universe.

3. They may say, “He fabricated it.” No. This is the truth from your Lord, to warn people who never received a warner before you, that they may be guided.

**No Mediator Between God and You**

4. **GOD** is the One who created the heavens and the earth, and everything between them in six days, then assumed all authority. You have none besides Him as Lord, nor a mediator. Would you not take heed?

5. All matters are controlled by Him from the heaven to the earth. To Him, the day is equivalent to one thousand of your years.

6. Such is the Knower of all secrets and declarations; the Almighty, Most Merciful.

**The Origin of Man**

7. He perfected everything He created, and started the creation of man from clay.

8. Then He continued his reproduction through a certain lowly liquid.

9. He shaped him and blew into him from His spirit. And He gave you the hearing, the eyesight, and the brains; rarely are you appreciative.

10. They wondered, “After we vanish into the earth, do we get created anew?” Indeed, they have disbelieved in meeting their Lord.

11. Say, “You will be put to death by the angel in whose charge you are placed, then to your Lord you will be returned.”

---
*32:1 The meaning of these letters is given in the next verse: “This book is, without a doubt, a revelation from the Lord of the universe.” See Appendix 1 for the details.

الِفْ لَمْرَ

إِنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ بَلْ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لِنُذِيرَ قَوْمًا مَّا أُنْذِرَ آبَاؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَافِلُونَ

اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ آبَائِكُمْ ۚ فَهُوَ الْحَقُّ ۖ قَوْلُهُ ۖ وَعَلَيْهِ يُتَقَوَّلُ ۚ

يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يُنْبِتُهَا رَبِّي دَاوِرًا

يَجْعَلُ مَا يَشَاءُ مُسْتَقِرًّا ۚ قَدْ فَصَّلَ اللَّهُ الْأَيَاتِ ۚ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَذَكَّرُونَ

الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا وَأَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجًا مِّن نَّبَاتٍ مُّخْتَلِفًا

لَا تَسْتَقِيمُ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَهُوَ يَتَوَفَّىٰ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ

يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

الَّذِي أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ ۖ وَبَدَأَ خَلْقَ الْإِنْسَانِ مِن طِينٍ

ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهُ مِن سُلَالَةٍ مِّن مَّاءٍ مَّهِينٍ

ثُمَّ سَوَّاهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِهِ ۖ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ

وَقَالُوا أَئِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا وَرُفَاتًا أَئِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

قُلْ كُنْتُمْ مِّنْ أَجْلِهِ مُبْعَثِينَ

**Prostration (Al-Sajdah) 32:12-20**

**Too Late**

12. If only you could see the guilty when they bow their heads before their Lord: “Our Lord, now we have seen and we have heard; send us back and we will be righteous. Now we have attained certainty.”

13. Had we willed, we could have given every soul its guidance, but it is already a predetermined fact that I will fill Hell with jinns and humans, all together.*

14. Taste the consequences of your forgetting this day—we now forget you. Taste the eternal retribution in return for your works.

15. The only people who truly believe in our revelations are those who fall prostrate upon hearing them. They glorify and praise their Lord, without any arrogance.

   وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى الْأَرْضِ زِينَةً لَهَا لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ فِيمَا أُوتُوا۟ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ

16. Their sides readily forsake their beds, in order to worship their Lord, out of reverence and hope. And from our provisions to them, they give.

   وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ هَادُوا يَبْغُونَ الْفَوْتَ وَالْبَرَكَةَ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ وَرَبُّكَ أَوْلَىٰ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

   **Heaven: Indescribably Beautiful**

17. You have no idea how much joy and happiness are waiting for you as a reward for your (righteous) works.

   لَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَّا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ

18. Is one who is a believer the same as one who is wicked? They are not equal.

   لَا يَسْتَوِي أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ وَأَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ

19. As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they have deserved the eternal Paradise. Such is their abode, in return for their works.

   وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَسَيُوَفِّيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَرَبُّكَ لَا يَظْلِمُ الْعَبِيدَ

20. As for the wicked, their destiny is Hell. Every time they try to leave it, they will be forced back. They will be told, “Taste the agony of Hell which you used to deny.”

   وَلَقَدْ ذَرَأْنَا لِلْجَاهِلِينَ سَبِيلًا فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا فَزُيِّنَتْ لَهُمْ قِبَلَهُمْ وَأَمَّا الْكَافِرُونَ فَقُولُوا لَهُمْ أَعْمَالُكُمْ شَتَّى

---

**Footnotes:**

*32:12 If sent back, they would commit the same sins. See Footnote 6:28.

*32:13 The majority of humans “insist” on going to Hell, choosing to ignore God’s invitations to redeem them. God will not put a single person into Hell. Those who fail to redeem themselves by denouncing idolatry and devoting themselves to God ALONE, then developing their souls through the practices prescribed by our Creator, will have to run to Hell on their own volition, because they cannot stand God’s energy.

**Prostration (Al-Sajdah) 32:21-30**

**Take A Hint**

21. We let them taste the smaller retribution (of this world), before they incur the greater retribution (of the Hereafter), that they may (take a hint and) reform.

22. Who is more evil than one who is reminded of these revelations of his Lord, then insists upon disregarding them? We will certainly avenge from the guilty.

23. We have given Moses the scripture—do not harbor any doubt about that—and we made it a guide for the Children of Israel.

24. We appointed from among them imams who guided in accordance with our commandments, because they steadfastly persevered and attained certainty about our revelations.

25. Your Lord is the One who will judge them on the Day of Resurrection, regarding everything they disputed.

26. Did it ever occur to them how many generations we have annihilated before them? They now live in their ancestors’ homes. This should provide sufficient signs. Do they not hear?

27. Do they not realize that we drive the water to arid lands, and produce with it crops to feed their livestock, as well as themselves? Do they not see?

28. They challenge: “Where is that victory, if you are truthful?”

29. Say, “The day such a victory comes, believing will not benefit those who did not believe before that, nor will they be given another chance.”

30. Therefore, disregard them and wait, they too are waiting.

**Sura 33: The Parties (Al-Ahzaab)**

---
![Arabic Text]
وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ فَمَا اسْتَكَانُوا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَكَانُونَ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ هُدًى لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَنْزَلْنَا مَعَهُ الْكِتَابَ مُفْصَلًا لِيَهْدُوا بِهِ وَكَانُوا بِآيَاتِنَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ رُشْدَهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِ عَالِمِينَ
إِذْ قَالَ ل أَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا هَذِهِ التَّمَاثِيلُ الَّتِي أَنْتُمْ لَهَا عَاكِفُونَ
قَالُوا وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا لَهَا عَابِدِينَ
قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ أَنْتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُمْ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
قَالُوا أَجِئْتَنَا بِالْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنْتَ مِنَ اللَّاعِبِينَ
قَالَ بَلْ رَبُّكُمْ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ الَّذِي فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا عَلَى ذَلِكَ مِنْ الشَّاهِدِينَ
وَتَاللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَامَكُمْ بَعْدَ أَنْ تُوَلُّوا مُدْبِرِينَ
فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَاذًا إِلَّا أَصْنَامَهُمْ لِيَرْجَعُوا إِلَيْهِمْ يَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا كَاذِبِينَ
قَالُوا مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا بِآلِهَتِنَا إِنَّهُ لَفَاعِلٌ عَمَّالٌ
قَالُوا سَمِعْنَا غُلَامًا يَذْكُرُهُمْ يَقُولُ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُهُ بِعَيْنَيَاتِي وَإِذَا هُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
قَالُوا فَأْتُوا بِهِ عَلَى عَيْنَيْهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ وَهُمْ بِهِ يَلْعَبُونَ
قَالُوا هَذَا سَاحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
فَأَلْقَى فِي السِّجْنِ حَتَّى يَعْلَمَ مَا يُجِيبُهُمْ بِهِ قَالَ تَعَالَى هُوَ رَبُّكُمْ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ الَّذِي خَلَقَهُنَّ وَأَنَا عَلَيْهِ شَهِيدٌ
وَلَقَدْ وَصَّيْنَا الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ وَإِيَّاكُمْ أَنِ اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
فَإِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكُمْ مَا حَمَلْتُمْ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَحَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
وَقِفُوهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ مَسْئُولُونَ
وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَنْ يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَا أَبْصَارُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمْ وَلَكِنْ ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَثِيرًا مِمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
وَلَقَدْ جِئْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَهُمْ وَآبَاؤُهُمْ بِالْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَأَطْنَبْتُمْ أَمْرَهُمْ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
إِذَا دَعَوْا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَإِلَى رَسُولِهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَكُمْ فَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُولُونَ مُدْبِرِينَ وَمَا يُرِيدُونَ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ وَفِسَادًا وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّهُمْ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ
أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا قَوْمًا غَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا هُمْ مِنْكُمْ وَلا مِنْهُمْ وَيَحْلِفُونَ عَلَى الْكَذِبِ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
إِنَّمَا يَعْمَلُ هَذَا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَعَضَّ اللَّهُ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَافِرُونَ
لَا يَدْرُونَ أَيَّ شَيْءٍ يُنْفِقُونَ وَيَتَّبِعُونَ كُلَّ شَيْطَانٍ مَرِيدٍ
لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ
وَلَقَدْ جِئْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَهُمْ وَآبَاؤُهُمْ بِالْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَأَطْنَبْتُمْ أَمْرَهُمْ أَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
فَإِنْ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا بِهَذَا فَقَدْ أَعْطَيْنَاكَ مَا سَعَيْتَ إِلَيْهِ إِلَيْهِمْ مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ عَلَيْهِمْ سَوْفَ يُسْأَلُونَ

**The Parties (Al-Ahzaab) 33:1-6**

**In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful**

1. O you prophet, observe **GOD**, and do not obey the disbelievers and hypocrites.
   **GOD** is Omniscient, Most Wise.

2. Follow what is revealed to you from your Lord.
   **GOD** is fully Cognizant of everything you all do.

3. You shall put your trust in **GOD**. **GOD** suffices as an advocate.

**Devotion to God Is Indivisible**

4. **GOD** did not give any man two hearts. Nor did He turn your wives whom you estranged (according to your custom) into your mothers.*
   Nor did He turn your adopted children into genetic offspring. All these are mere utterances that you have invented. **GOD** speaks the truth, and He guides in the (right) path.

**Do Not Change Your Names**

5. You shall give your adopted children names that preserve their relationship to their genetic fathers. This is more equitable in the sight of **GOD**. If you do not know their fathers, then, as your brethren in religion, you shall treat them as members of your family. You do not commit a sin if you make a mistake in this respect; you are only responsible for your actual intentions. **GOD** is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

6. The prophet is closer to the believers than they are to each other, and his wives are like their mothers. Those who are related to each other shall take care of one another in accordance with **GOD’s** scripture. Thus, the believers shall take care of their relatives who immigrate to them, provided they have taken care of their own families first. These are commandments of this scripture.

---

*33:4 It was a custom in Arabia to estrange the wife by declaring that she was like the husband’s mother. Such an unfair practice is abrogated by the Quran.

**The Parties (Al-Ahzaab) 33:7-15**

**Muhammad Pledges to Support God’s Messenger of the Covenant\***

7. Recall that we took from the prophets their covenant, including a pledge from you (O Muhammad), and from Noah, Abraham, Moses, and Jesus the son of Mary. We took from them a solemn pledge.*

8. He will surely question the truthful about their truthfulness, and has prepared for the disbelievers (in this Quranic fact) a painful retribution.

**The Battle of the Parties**

9. O you who believe, remember GOD’s blessing upon you when soldiers attacked you; we sent upon them violent wind, and invisible soldiers. GOD is Seer of everything you do.

10. They came from above you, and from beneath you. Your eyes and hearts were terrified, and you harbored unbefitting thoughts about GOD.

11. That is when the believers were truly tested, and were severely shaken up.

12. The hypocrites and those with doubts in their hearts said, “What GOD and His messenger promised us was no more than an illusion!”

13. A group of them said, “O people of Yathrib, you cannot attain victory; go back.” Others made up excuses to the prophet: “Our homes are exposed,” when they were not exposed. They just wanted to flee.

14. Had the enemy invaded, and asked them to join, they would have joined the enemy without hesitation.

15. They had covenanted with GOD in the past that they would not turn around and flee; making a pledge with GOD involves responsibility.

---

*33:7 This verse refers to the covenant that is detailed in 3:81. God took a covenant from the prophets that they shall support His Messenger of the Covenant who would come after them, and is destined to unify their messages under the banner of worshiping God alone. The specific identity of that messenger, and details of incontrovertible supporting evidence are given in Appendices 2 and 26. The Covenant was made before creation, and was finally fulfilled in Mecca, December 21, 1971 (Zul-Hijja 3, 1391).

وإِذْ يَقُولُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَرَضٌ مَاذَا وَعَدَكُمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ قَالُوا وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ الْحَقَّ وَقَالُوا لَا دَرَكَ عَلَيْنَا قَالُوا وَعَدَكُمَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَإِنْ نَحْنُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ مُرْتَابُونَ
قَالُوا ادْخُلُوا فِي الدِّينِ كَافِرِينَ قُلْ لَنْ نَدْخُلَهُ إِلَّا إِذَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَمَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِنَفْسٍ مِّن قَبْلُ سَبِيلًا
وَقَالُوا لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا هَاهُنَا مَعَ الْمُهْلِكِينَ
فَلْيَطْمَعِ الْمُهْلِكُونَ بِأَمْرِهِمْ يَوْمَ يُقَلِّبُ اللَّهُ أَمْرَهُمْ وَيُلْهِهِمْ مَا يَصْتَحْسِرُونَ
وَقَالُوا يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَوْ كُنْتُمْ قِتَالًا لَنَخْرَجْنَا مَعَكُمْ قَالُوا لَا شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِمْ دُونَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَمَنْ يَتَعَدَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ
لَا يَسْتَوِي مِنْكُمْ مَنْ أَنْفَقَ مِنْ قَبْلِ الْفَتْحِ وَقَاتَلَ وَمَنْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ بَعْدُ وَكُلٌّ مِمَّنْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ فَسَيُجْزَاهُ اللَّهُ بِالْأَفْضَلِ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ آذَنَ لِلنَّبِيِّ وَقَالَ إِنِّي مُسْلِمٌ وَإِذَا خَرَجُوا مِنْ عِنْدِهِ سَخِرُوا مِنْهُ وَيَلْعَبُونَ بِالْكُفْرِ وَهَؤُلَاءِ فِي الْآخِرَةِ فِي الْعَذَابِ الْعَظِيمِ
وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ عَاهَدَ اللَّهَ لَئِنْ آتَانَا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ لَنَصَّدَّقَنَّ وَلَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
فَلَمَّا آتَاهُم مِّنْ فَضْلِهِ بَمَا رَضُوا وَعَاهَدُوهُ عَلَى الْقُرْآنِ لَمَّا يَكُونُوا عَلَيْهِ مُلْحِدِينَ
لَوْلَا إِذْ سَمِعُوا مَا نُهِيَ عَنْهُ أَنْفَقُوا وَلَوْ كَانُوا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ صَدَقُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ لَمَا اتَّخَذُوا هَذَا السُّبُلَ الْعَجَبَ
وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ عَاهَدَ اللَّهَ لَئِنْ آتَانَا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ لَنَكُونَنَّ صَادِقِينَ
فَلَمَّا آتَاهُم مِّنْ فَضْلِهِ بَمَا رَضُوا عَاهَدُوهُ عَلَى الْقُرْآنِ وَمَعَاذَ اللَّهِ لَيَكُونُوا مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ
لَوْلَا أَنَّهُمْ عَاهَدُوا اللَّهَ لَمَّا كَانُوا مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ
وَلَكِنْ كَانُوا يَعْهَدُونَ وَمَا يُحَرِّمُ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ لَا يَأْكُلُهُ أَحَدٌ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ مُحْتَدِيًا أَوْ مُحْتَلِيًا لِلْعَذَابِ وَمَنْ يَتَعَدَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ
وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ عَاهَدَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتَبَدَّلُوا وَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْتَرُونَ
وَلَكِنْ كَانُوا يَعْهَدُونَ وَمَا يُحَرِّمُ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ لَا يَأْكُلُهُ أَحَدٌ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ مُحْتَدِيًا أَوْ مُحْتَلِيًا لِلْعَذَابِ

16. Say, “If you flee, you can never flee from death or from being killed. No matter what happens, you only live a short while longer.”

17. Say, “Who would protect you from GOD if He willed any adversity, or willed any blessing for you?” They can never find, besides GOD, any other Lord or Master.

18. GOD is fully aware of the hinderers among you, and those who say to their comrades, “Let us all stay behind.” Rarely do they mobilize for defense.

19. They are too stingy when dealing with you. If anything threatens the community, you see their eyes rolling with fear, as if death had already come to them. Once the crisis is over, they whip you with sharp tongues. They are too stingy with their wealth. These are not believers, and this is why GOD nullifies their works. This is easy for GOD to do.

20. They thought that the parties might come back. In that case, they would wish that they were lost in the desert, asking about your news from afar. Had the parties attacked you while they were with you, they would rarely support you.

*The Prophet’s Courage*

21. The messenger of GOD has set up a good example for those among you who seek GOD and the Last Day, and remember GOD frequently.

22. When the true believers saw the parties (ready to attack), they said, “This is what GOD and His messenger have promised us, and GOD and His messenger are truthful.” This (dangerous situation) only strengthened their faith and augmented their submission (to God).

---
*33:21 Satan took this verse out of context, and relied on the people’s idolization of the prophet Muhammad to innovate a whole set of unreasonable regulations called ‘Sunna of the Prophet.’ This created a totally different religion (42:21 and Appendix 18).

**The Parties (Al-Ahzaab) 33:23-30**

23. Among the believers there are people who fulfill their pledges with **GOD**. Thus, some of them died, while others stand ready, never wavering.

24. **GOD** will surely recompense the truthful for their truthfulness, and will punish the hypocrites, if He so wills, or redeem them. **GOD** is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

**God Supports the Believers**

25. **GOD** repulsed those who disbelieved with their rage, and they left empty handed. **GOD** thus spared the believers any fighting. **GOD** is Powerful, Almighty.

26. And He brought down their allies among the people of the scripture from their secure positions, and threw terror into their hearts. Some of them you killed, and some you took captive.

27. And He made you inherit their land, their homes, their money, and lands you had never stepped on. **GOD** is in full control of all things.

**Special Responsibility For Being Close**

28. O prophet, say to your wives, “If you are seeking this life and its vanities, then let me compensate you and allow you to go amicably.”

29. “But if you are seeking **GOD** and His messenger, and the abode of the Hereafter, then **GOD** has prepared for the pious among you a great recompense.”

30. O wives of the prophet, if any of you commits a gross sin, the retribution will be doubled for her. This is easy for **GOD** to do.

31. Any one among you who obeys **GOD** and His messenger,
and works righteousness, we will grant her double the recompense,
and we have prepared for her a generous provision.

32. O wives of the prophet,
you are not the same as any other women,
if you observe righteousness.
(You have a greater responsibility.)
Therefore, you shall not speak too softly,
lest those with disease in their hearts
may get the wrong impression;
you shall speak righteousness.

33. You shall settle down in your homes,
and do not mingle with the people
excessively, like you used to do in
the old days of ignorance. You shall
observe the contact prayers (Salat),
and give the obligatory charity
(Zakat), and obey **GOD** and His
messenger. **GOD** wishes to remove
all unholiness from you, O you who
live around the Sacred Shrine,
and to purify you completely.

34. And remember what is being recited
in your homes of **GOD**’s revelations
and the wisdom inherent therein.
**GOD** is Sublime, Cognizant.

**Equality of Men and Women**

35. The Muslim men, the Muslim women,
the believing men, the believing
women, the obedient men, the
obedient women, the truthful men,
the truthful women, the steadfast
men, the steadfast women,
the reverent men, the reverent women,
the charitable men, the charitable women,
the fasting men, the fasting women,
the chaste men, the chaste women,
and the men who commemorate **GOD** frequently,
and the commemorating women;
**GOD** has prepared for them forgiveness
and a great recompense.

**The Parties (Al-Ahzaab) 33:36-43**

**Major Error Committed by Muhammad**
**Muhammad the Man Disobeys Muhammad the Messenger**

36. No believing man or believing woman, if **GOD** and His messenger issue any command, has any choice regarding that command. Anyone who disobeys **GOD** and His messenger has gone far astray.

37. Recall that you said to the one who was blessed by **GOD**, and blessed by you, “Keep your wife and observe **GOD**,” and you hid inside yourself what **GOD** wished to proclaim. Thus, you feared the people, when you were supposed to fear only **GOD**. When Zeid was completely through with his wife, we had you marry her, in order to establish the precedent that a man can marry the divorced wife of his adopted son. **GOD**’s commands shall be carried out.

38. The prophet is not committing an error by doing anything that is made lawful by **GOD**. Such is **GOD**’s system since the early generations. **GOD**’s command is a sacred duty—

39. for those who deliver **GOD**’s messages, and who reverence Him alone. They never fear anyone but **GOD**. **GOD** is the best reckoner.

**Not The Final Messenger\***

40. Muhammad was not the father of any man among you. He was a messenger of **GOD** and the final prophet. **GOD** is fully aware of all things.

41. O you who believe, you shall remember **GOD** frequently.*

42. You shall glorify Him day and night.

43. He is the One who helps you, together with His angels, to lead you out of darkness into the light. He is Most Merciful towards the believers.

**The Parties (Al-Ahzaab) 33:44-50**

44. Their greeting the day they meet Him is, “Peace,” and He has prepared for them a generous recompense.

45. O prophet, we have sent you as a witness, a bearer of good news, and a warner.

46. Inviting to GOD, in accordance with His will, and a guiding beacon.

47. Deliver good news to the believers, that they have deserved from GOD a great blessing.

48. Do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites, disregard their persecution, and put your trust in GOD; GOD suffices as an advocate.

**Marriage Laws**

49. O you who believe, if you married believing women, then divorced them before having intercourse with them, they do not owe you any waiting interim (before marrying another man). You shall compensate them, and let them go amicably.

50. O prophet, we made lawful for you in marriage the wives to whom you have paid their due dowry, or what you already have, as granted to you by GOD. Also lawful for you in marriage are the daughters of your father’s brothers, the daughters of your father’s sisters, the daughters of your mother’s brothers, the daughters of your mother’s sisters, who have emigrated with you. Also, if a believing woman gave herself to the prophet, by forfeiting the dowry, the prophet may marry her, without a dowry, if he so wishes. However, her forfeiting of the dowry applies only to the prophet, and not to the other believers. We have already decreed their rights in regard to their spouses or what they already have. This is to spare you any embarrassment.

GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

51. You may gently shun any one of them, and you may bring closer any one of them. If you reconcile with any one you had estranged, you commit no error. In this way, they will be pleased, and will have no worries, and will be content with what you equitably offer to all of them. **GOD** knows what is in your hearts. **GOD** is Omniscient, Clement.

52. Beyond the categories described to you, you are enjoined from marrying any other women, nor can you substitute a new wife (from the prohibited categories), no matter how much you admire their beauty. You must be content with what you are already permitted. **GOD** is watchful over all things.

**Etiquette**

53. O you who believe, do not enter the prophet’s homes unless you are given permission to eat, nor shall you force such an invitation. Once you are invited, you may enter. When you finish eating, you shall leave; do not engage him in lengthy conversations. This used to hurt the prophet, and he was too shy to tell you. But **GOD** does not shy away from the truth. If you have to ask his wives for something, ask them from behind a barrier. This is purer for your hearts and their hearts. You do not wish to hurt the messenger of **GOD**. You shall not marry his wives after him, for this would be a gross offense in the sight of **GOD**.

54. Whether you declare anything, or hide it, **GOD** is fully aware of all things.

---
*33:53 We are enjoined in 4:22 from marrying women who were previously married to our fathers. This divine commandment preserves our respect for our fathers and their most private affairs. Similarly, the prophet was a father figure to the believers of his time. For the good of those believers, God enjoined them from marrying women who were previously married to the prophet. Marriage is a sacred and very private relationship, and the prophet’s private life was better kept private.

# Sura 34: Sheba (Saba’)

**In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful**

1. Praise be to **GOD**, to whom belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. All praise is due to Him in the Hereafter, and He is the Most Wise, the Cognizant.

2. He knows everything that goes into the earth, and everything that comes out of it, and everything that comes down from the sky, and everything that climbs into it. And He is the Most Merciful, the Forgiving.

3. Those who disbelieved said, “The Hour will never come to pass!” Say, “Absolutely, by my Lord, it will inevitably come to you. He is the Knower of the future. Not even the equivalent of an atom’s weight is hidden from Him, be it in the heavens or the earth. Not even smaller than that, or larger (is hidden). All are in a profound record.”

4. Most assuredly, He will recompense those who believe and lead a righteous life. They have deserved forgiveness and a generous provision.

5. As for those who constantly challenge our revelations, they have incurred a retribution of painful humiliation.

6. It is evident to those who are blessed with knowledge that this revelation from your Lord to you is indeed the truth, and that it guides to the path of the Almighty, the Most Praised.

7. Those who disbelieved said, “We can show you a man who tells you that after you are torn apart you will be created anew.

15. Sheba’s homeland used to be a marvel,
with two gardens on the right and the left.
Eat from your Lord’s provisions, and be appreciative of Him.
Good land, and a forgiving Lord.

16. They turned away and, consequently,
we poured upon them a disastrous flood,
and we substituted their two gardens
into two gardens of bad tasting fruits,
thorny plants, and a small yield.

17. We thus requited them for their disbelief. Do we not requite the disbeliever?

18. We placed between them and the communities that we blessed other oases, and we secured the journey between them: “Travel therein days and nights in complete security.”

19. But they (turned unappreciative and) challenged: “Our Lord, we do not care if You increase the distances of our journeys (without any stations).” They thus wronged their own souls. Consequently, we made them history, and scattered them into small communities throughout the land. This should provide lessons for those who are steadfast, appreciative.

20. Satan found them readily fulfilling his expectations. They followed him, except a few believers.

21. He never had any power over them. But we thus distinguish those who believe in the Hereafter from those who are doubtful about it. Your Lord is in full control of all things.

22. Say, “Implore the idols you set up besides GOD. They do not possess as much as a single atom in the heavens, nor the earth. They possess no partnership therein, nor does He use any of them as an assistant.”

لَقَدْ كَانَ لِسَبَإٍ فِي مَسْكَنِهِمْ آيَةٌ جَنَّتَانِ عَن يَمِينٍ وَشِمَالٍ كُلُوا مِن رِّزْقِ رَبِّكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لَهُ بَلْدَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ وَرَبٌّ غَفُورٌ

فَأَعْرَضُوا فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ الْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَا مَكَانَيْهِمَا جَنَّتَينِ ذَوَاتِ آكُولٍ وَأَشْجَارٍ وَحَبٍّ قَلِيلٍ

كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُجْرِمِينَ

وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ الْقُرَى الَّتِي بَارَكْنَا فِيهَا قُرًى ظَاهِرَةً وَقَدَرْنَا فِيهَا السَّيْرَ سِيرُوا فِيهَا لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا آمِنِينَ

قَالُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آَمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ

فَأَخْرَجْنَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنْهَا وَكَأَلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَجَاةً

وَلَقَدْ صَدَّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلَيْمَانُ وَقَالَ إِنَّ رَبِّي هَدَانِي مِنْ لَدُنْهُ وَهُوَ يَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَهُوَ الصَّرِيمُ الْبَصِيرُ

وَمِنَ الشَّيَاطِينِ مَنْ يَغُضُّ إِلَيْهِ وَيَقُولُ إِنِّي وَجَدْتُ بِقَوْمٍ غَيْرِ قَوْمِ مُوسَى هُمْ يُحَرِّرُونَ

وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَالَ إِنِّي وَجَدْتُ رَبًّا أَعَظَّ مِنْ مُوسَى وَأَخَذَ قَوْمَهُ مِنْ مَقَامِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَكُنَّا عَلَيْهِمْ شُهَدَاءَ

وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ آمَنُوا وَاتَّقَوْا لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ وَلَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ

يَا مُوسَى إِنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ يَسْتَخْفُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَقُولُونَ لَا يُصَدِّقُونَكَ وَإِنَّا لَحَاقُونَ

قُلْ حَرَّمَ رَبِّي الْقُرَى الْمُقَدَّسَةَ فَلَا تُقَاتِلُوا فِيهَا حَتَّى تُقَاتِلُوا فِيهَا وَإِنَّهُمْ مُقَاتِلُونَ لَكُمْ وَلَوْ كَانُوا يَفْقَهُونَ

(505 + 725 + 34 + 28 = 1292 = 19 x 68). More information is given in 5:19 and its footnote.

Initiator (Faater) 35:12-18

**Appreciating God’s Greatness\***

12. And the two seas are not the same; one is fresh and potable, while the other is salty and undrinkable. From each of them you eat tender meat, and extract jewelry to wear. And you see the ships sailing therein, seeking His bounties, that you may be appreciative.

13. He merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night. He has committed the sun and the moon to run for a predetermined period of time. Such is **GOD** your Lord; to Him belongs all kingship. Any idols you set up besides Him do not possess as much as a seed’s membrane.

**The Idols\***

14. If you call on them, they cannot hear you. Even if they hear you, they cannot respond to you. On the Day of Resurrection, they disown you. None informs you like the Most Cognizant.

15. O people, you are the ones who need **GOD**, while **GOD** is in no need, Most Praiseworthy.

16. If He wills, He can get rid of you and substitute a new creation.

17. This is not too difficult for **GOD**.

18. No soul can carry the sins of another soul. If a soul that is loaded with sins implores to have part of its load removed, no other soul can carry any part of it, even if they are related. The only people to heed your warnings are those who revere their Lord, even when alone in their privacy, and observe the contact prayers (Salat). Whoever purifies his soul, does so for his own good. To **GOD** is the final destiny.

---

**Initiator (Faater) 35:31-38**

**Quran: The Consummation of All the Scriptures**

31. What we revealed to you in this scripture is the truth, consummating all previous scriptures. **GOD** is fully Cognizant of His servants, Seer.

32. We passed the scripture from generation to generation, and we let whomever we chose from among our servants receive it. Subsequently, some of them wronged their souls, others upheld it only part of the time, while others were eager to work righteousness, in accordance with **GOD**’s will—this is the greatest triumph.

**The Believers**

33. They will enter the gardens of Eden, where they will be adorned with bracelets of gold, and pearls, and their garments will be made of silk.

34. They will say, “Praise **GOD** for removing all our worries. Our Lord is Forgiving, Appreciative.

35. “He has admitted us into the abode of eternal bliss, out of His grace. Never do we get bored herein, never do we get tired.”

**The Disbelievers**

36. As for those who disbelieved, they have incurred the fire of Hell, where they are never finished by death, nor is the retribution ever commuted for them. We thus requite those who are unappreciative.

37. They will scream therein, “Our Lord, if you get us out of here, we will work righteousness, instead of the works we used to do.” Did we not give you a life-long chance, with continuous reminders for those who would take heed? And the warner went to you. Therefore, suffer (the consequences). The transgressors will have no helpers.

38. **GOD** is the Knower of the future of the heavens and the earth. He is the Knower of all innermost thoughts.

**The Winners and the Losers**

39. He is the One who made you inheritors of the earth. Subsequently, whoever disbelieves does so to his own detriment. The disbelief of the disbelievers only increases their Lord’s abhorrence towards them. The disbelief of the disbelievers only plunges them deeper into loss.

40. Say, “Consider the idols you have set up besides GOD; show me what on earth have they created.” Do they own any partnership in the heavens? Have we given them a book wherein there is no doubt? Indeed, what the transgressors promise one another is no more than an illusion.

41. GOD is the One who holds the heavens and the earth, lest they vanish. If anyone else is to hold them, they will most certainly vanish. He is Clement, Forgiving.

**Putting Them to the Test**

42. They swore by GOD solemnly that if a warner went to them, they would be better than any other congregation! Now that the warner did come to them, this only plunged them deeper into aversion.

43. They resorted to arrogance on earth, and evil scheming. However, evil schemes backfire on those who scheme them. Should they expect anything but the fate of those who did the same things in the past? You will find that GOD’s system is never changeable; you will find that GOD’s system is immutable.

44. Have they not roamed the earth and noted the consequences for those who preceded them? They were even stronger. Nothing can be hidden from GOD in the heavens, nor on earth. He is Omniscient, Omnipotent.

---

6. To warn people whose parents were never warned, and therefore, are totally unaware.
7. It is already predetermined that most of them will not believe.
8. We place around their necks shackles, up to their chins. Consequently, they are locked in their disbelief.
9. And we place a barrier in front of them, and a barrier behind them, and thus, we veil them; they cannot see.
10. It is the same whether you warn them or not, they do not believe.*
11. You will be heeded only by those who uphold this message, and reverence the Most Gracious in their privacy. Give them good news of forgiveness and a generous recompense.
12. We will certainly revive the dead. We record everything they do during their life, as well as the consequences that continue after their death. Everything we have counted in a profound book.

**Rejecting The Messengers: A Tragic Human Trait\***

13. Cite for them the example of people in one community who received the messengers.

15. They said, “You are no more than human beings like us. The Most Gracious did not reveal anything. You are really liars.”

20. A man came running from the other end of the city, saying, “O my people, follow the messengers.

21. “Follow those who do not ask you for any wage, and are guided.

22. “Why should I not worship the One who initiated me, and to Him is your ultimate return?

24. “Then I would be totally astray.

25. “I have believed in your Lord; please listen to me.”

26. (At the time of his death) he was told, “Enter Paradise.”

**Y. S. (Yaa Seen) 36:41-54**

**Invention of the First Ship**

41. Another sign for them is that we carried their forefathers on the loaded ark.
42. Then created the same for them to ride in.
43. If we willed, we could have drowned them, so that their screaming would not be heard, nor could they be saved.
44. Instead, we shower them with mercy, and let them enjoy for awhile.
45. Yet, when they are told, “Learn from your past, to work righteousness for your future, that you may attain mercy,”
46. No matter what kind of sign is sent to them from their Lord, they consistently disregard it.
47. And when they are told, “Give from God’s provisions to you,” those who disbelieved say to those who believed, “Why should we give to those whom God could feed, if He so willed? You are really far astray.”
48. They also challenged, “When will that promise come to pass, if you are truthful?”
49. All they see will be one blow that overwhelms them, while they dispute.
50. They will not even have time to make a will, nor will they return to their people.
51. The horn will be blown, whereupon they will rise from the grave and go to their Lord.
52. They will say, “Woe to us. Who resurrected us from our death? This is what the Most Gracious has promised. The messengers were right.”
53. All it takes is one blow, whereupon they are summoned before us.
54. On that day, no soul will be wronged in the least. You will be paid precisely for whatever you did.

وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحُكْمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَاهُمْ مِنْ طَيِّبَاتِ مَا رُزِقُوا وَفَضْلًا عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ
وَآتَيْنَاهُمْ آيَاتٍ مُّبَيِّنَاتٍ فَإِنْ كَانُوا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا آتَاهُمْ رَحْمَةُنَا بِشَرِّ دَاعٍ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِيَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
إِنَّ هَذَا لَفِي الصُّهُفِ الْأُولَى صُحُفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَى
إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
مَا قَالُوا إِنَّنَا نُحْرِقُكُمْ بِنَارِ جَهَنَّمَ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِي غَيْرِ بَلَاءٍ يَقِينٍ
وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِي الزَّبُورِ مِنْ بَعْدِ الذِّكْرِ أَنَّ الْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِيَ الصَّالِحُونَ
إِنَّ فِي هَذَا لَبَلَاغًا لِّقَوْمٍ عَابِدِينَ
وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِمْ فَاسْأَلُوا أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
بَلْ رَمَيْتَ بِقَوْلِكَ لَمَّا لَمْ تَكُونَ لَهُ بِدْعَةً عِلْمًا وَمَا أَنْتَ بِذِكْرَى لَهُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا لَّعِبًا
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا لُقْمَانَ الْحِكْمَةَ قُلْ هَلْ مِنْ مُنْذِرٍ
إِذْ قَالَ لِلنَّاسِ قَدْ جَاءَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَارْجُوا لَهُ الْغُفْرَانَ وَارْجُوا رَبَّكُمْ بِرَحْمَتِهِ وَبِالْغُصُولِ الْحُسْنَى وَلاَ تَوَلَّوْا مُعْتَدِيًا مُّجْرِمًا
يَأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَآمِنُوا بِرَسُولِهِ يُؤْتِكُمْ كِفْلَيْنِ مِنْ رَحْمَتِهِ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ النُّرَ وَالْقُرْآنَ يَهْدِي بِهِ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
وَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ كِتَابٌ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٌ لِمَا مَعَهُمْ وَكَانُوا مِنْ قَبْلُ يَسْتَفْتِحُونَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ مَا عَرَفُوا كَفَرُوا بِهِ فَلَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ
قَطَعْنَا أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَرْجُلَهُمْ وَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ ذُوقُوا عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ
وَلَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتْتُمْ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَؤُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
وَقُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ هَادُوا إِنْ زَعَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ لِلَّهِ مِنْ دُونِ النَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُا الْمَوْتَ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
وَلَا يَزَالُونَ يُقَاتِلُونَكُمْ حَتَّى يَرُدُّوكُمْ عَنْ دِينِكُمْ إِنْ اسْتَطَاعُوا وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّهُمْ مِنْكُمْ فَإِنَّهُ هُوَ الْظَّالِمُ
وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَنْفَقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ لِيُعْجِبُوا النَّاسَ وَلاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّهُمُ اللَّهُ فَهُوَ رَبُّهُمْ وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّهُمْ فَأُولَئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
وَلَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ مُوسَى بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ ثُمَّ اتَّخَذْتُمُ الْعِجْلَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَأَنْتُمْ ظَالِمُونَ
فَلَمَّا صَبَرُوا قُلْنَا ذُوقُوا عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ هُدًى لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَلَّا تَتَّخِذُوا مِنْ دُونِي وَكِيلًا
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ رُشْدَهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِ عَالِمِينَ
إِذْ قَالَ لِلنَّاسِ إِنِّي مُرْسِلٌ إِلَى رَبِّي سَأُحْضِرُكُمْ مِنْهُ ثَمَرَةً وَإِنِّي قَدْ أَتَيْتُكُمْ بِبُشْرَى فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ اللَّهِ أَحْضَرْتُمْ وَعْدًا مِنْهُ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

Y. S. (Yaa Seen) 36:55-70

55. The dwellers of Paradise will be, on that day, happily busy.

56. They abide with their spouses in beautiful shade, enjoying comfortable furnishings.

57. They will have fruits therein; they will have anything they wish.

58. Greetings of peace from a Most Merciful Lord.

59. As for you, O guilty ones, you will be set aside.

The Other Alternative

60. Did I not covenant with you, O Children of Adam, that you shall not worship the devil? That he is your most ardent enemy?

61. That you shall worship Me alone? That this is the straight path?

62. He has misled multitudes of you. Did you not possess any understanding?

63. This is the Hell that was promised for you.

64. Today you will burn in it, as a consequence of your disbelief.

65. On that day we will seal their mouths, and their hands and feet will bear witness to everything they had done.

66. If we will, we can veil their eyes and thus, when they seek the path, they will not see.

67. If we will, we can freeze them in place; thus, they can neither move forward, nor go back.

68. Whomever we permit to live for a long time, we revert him to weakness. Do they not understand?

69. We did not teach him (the messenger) poetry, nor should he. This is but a reminder; a profound Quran.

70. To warn everyone alive, and to expose the disbelievers.

Y. S. (Yaa Seen) 36:71-83

71. Have they not seen that we created for them, with our own hands, livestock that they own?

72. And we subdued them for them; some of them they ride, and some they eat.

73. They derive other benefits from them, as well as drinks. Would they not be appreciative?

Powerless Idols

74. They set up besides GOD other gods, perhaps they help them!

75. On the contrary, they cannot help them; they end up serving them as devoted soldiers.

76. Therefore, do not be saddened by their utterances. We are fully aware of everything they conceal and everything they declare.

77. Does the human being not see that we created him from a tiny drop, then he turns into a profound enemy?

78. And he posed a question to us, while forgetting his own creation: "Who can resurrect the bones after they had rotted?"

79. Say, “The One who initiated them in the first place will resurrect them. He is fully aware of every creation.”

80. He is the One who creates for you, from the green trees, fuel which you burn for light.

81. Is not the One who created the heavens and the earth able to recreate the same? Yes indeed; He is the Creator, the Omniscient.

82. All He needs to do to carry out any command is to say to it, “Be,” and it is.

83. Therefore, glory be to the One in whose hand is the kingship over all things, and to Him you will be returned.

**The Arrangers (Al-Saaffat) 37:1-24**

**In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful**

1. By the arrangers in columns.
2. And the blamers of those to be blamed.
3. And the reciters of the messages.
4. Your god is only one.
5. The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, and Lord of the easts.
6. We have adorned the lowest heaven with beautiful stars.
7. And guarded it from every evil devil.
8. They cannot spy on the high society; they get shot from every side.
9. They are doomed; they have incurred an eternal retribution.
10. If any of them ventures to charge the outer limits, he gets struck with a fierce projectile.
11. Ask them, “Are they more difficult to create, or our other creations?” We created them from wet mud.
12. While you are awed, they mock.
13. When reminded, they take no heed.
14. When they see proof, they ridicule it.
15. They say, “This is obviously magic!”
16. ‘After we die and become dust and bones, do we get resurrected?
17. “Even our ancient ancestors?”
18. Say, “Yes, you will be forced.”
19. All it takes is one nudge, whereupon they (stand up) looking.
20. They will say, “Woe to us; this is the Day of Judgment.”
21. This is the day of decision that you used to disbelieve in.
22. Summon the transgressors, and their spouses, and the idols they worshiped—
23. besides GOD; guide them to the path of Hell.
24. Stop them, and ask them:

فَأَنشَأْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا مِنْهُمْ رَحْمَةً وَفَضَّلْنَاهُمْ فِى الْعَالَمِينَ

إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا هَـَذَهِ التَّمَاثِيلُ الَّتِى أَنْتُمْ لَهَا عَاكِفُونَ
قَالُوا وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا لَهَا عَابِدِينَ
قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ أَنْتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
قَالُوا أَجِئْتَنَا بِالْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنْتَ مِنَ اللَّاعِبِينَ
قَالَ بَلْ رَبُّكُمْ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ الَّذِى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا عَلَى ذَلِكَ مِنْ الشَّاهِدِينَ
وَأَتَى عَلَى الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَا قَوْمِ إِنِىَ رَسُولٌ إِلَيْكُمْ أَتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
يَعْفُوْ عَلَيْكُمْ وَيُغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
قَالُوا أَتَجْعَلُ اللَّهَ رَبًّا وَحِدًا وَتَكْفُرُ بِآلِهَتِنَا أَمَّا إِنَّكَ لَفِى ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
قَالَ سَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هَـَذَا رَبُّكُمْ الَّذِى هُوَ لَكُمْ رَبٌّ خَالِقٌ كُلّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ
سَتُهْوَى إِلَى آلِهَتِكُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِى فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِى رَبّى لَكُمْ بِحَقٍّ وَإِنَّهُ عَلَى كُلّ شَىْءٍ وَكِيلٌ
فَأَصْبَحُوا فِى مَسْكَنِهِمْ يَتَحَاجَّونَ
قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ لَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتَ لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنْ الْخَاسِرِينَ
فَأَخَذْنَاهُ نَبِيًّا مِنْ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
وَنَبْتَلِيهِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حِكْمَةً وَكَذَلِكَ نَجْزِى الْمُحْسِنِينَ

إِذْ قَالُوا لِيُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ لَا تَفْعَلُوا هَذَا بِيُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ إِلَّا أَنْ تَرَاهُ مُشْتاقًا إِلَيْهِمْ وَهُمْ يَمْكُرُونَ وَمَا كَانُوا مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَأَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهِمْ رُسُلًا كُلَّمَا جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ بِمَا تَعْدُوهُ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ قَالُوا لَن نُّؤْمِنَ بِهِ وَلَكِنَّا نُؤْمِنُ بِمَا أُوتِينَا وَهُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ عِنْدِ رَبِّنَا قُلْ إِنَّ الْحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَقَالَ مُوسَى يَا قَوْمِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ آمَنْتُمْ بِاللَّهِ فَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلُوا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُسْلِمِينَ
وَقَالُوا يَا مُوسَى إِنَّا لَا نَصْبِرُ عَلَى طَعَامٍ وَاحِدٍ فَاكْتُبْ لَنَا مَا غَنِمْنَا وَكَاتِبْنَا مُفَصَّلًا وَعَلِّمْنَا التَّقْوَى وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
وَقَالَ مُوسَى وَهَارُونَ أَيُّهَا الْقَوْمُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ آمَنْتُمْ بِاللَّهِ فَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلُوا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُسْلِمِينَ
وَقَالُوا لَا نَصْبِرُ عَلَى طَعَامٍ وَاحِدٍ فَاكْتُبْ لَنَا مَا غَنِمْنَا وَكَاتِبْنَا مُفَصَّلًا وَعَلِّمْنَا التَّقْوَى وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
وَقَالَ مُوسَى إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ تَذْهَبُونَ
وَقَالَ إِلْيَاسُ إِنِّي مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
وَقَالَ لِيَ قَوْمِهِ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
أَتَعْبُدُونَ إِلَهًا غَيْرَ اللَّهِ وَأَنْتُمْ تُعْلَمُونَ
فَمَا زَعَمَ آبَاؤُكُمْ وَمَا زَعَمُوا نَصْبِرُ عَلَى مَا تَقُولُونَ وَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ الْحَقُّ وَمَا أَنْتُمْ مُحْصِينَ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا مِنْ سَمَاءٍ فَعَلَّمْنَاهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
وَلَا تَسْأَلْ عَنْ ذُنُوبِهِمْ وَلا تَسْأَلْ عَنْ عَفْوِهِمْ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَاشْفَعْ لَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا
وَلَا تَسْأَلْ عَنْهُمْ مِنْ خَبَرِهِمْ
وَلَا تَسْأَلْ عَنْ أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ بِشَيْءٍ وَلا تَسْأَلْ عَنْ نَجْوَاهُمْ وَلا تَسْأَلْ عَنْ شَيْءٍ حَتَّى يُوَلِّيَكَ وَيَقُلْ إِنَّهُ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ الرَّجُلَ وَالْمَرْأَةَ وَالْوَلَدَ وَالْمَسِنَ وَاشْفَعْ لَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ آثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا وَاتَّقِ اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ
وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَأَنْتُمْ سُكَارَى حَتَّى تَعْلَمُوا مَا تَقُولُونَ وَلا جُنُبًا إِلَّا عَابِرِي سَبِيلٍ حَتَّى تَغْتَسِلُوا وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ مَرْضَى أَوْ عَلَى سَفَرٍ أَوْ جَاءَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ مِنَ الْغَائِطِ أَوْ لَمَسْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا مَاءً فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا فَامْسَحُوا بِوُجُوهِكُمْ وَأَيْدِيكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَفُورًا غَفُورًا

مَالِكُ الْمُلْكِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَنْزِعُهُ مِمَّنْ يَشَاءُ وَلاَ يَرْضَى لِلْمَجْرِمِينَ أَنْصَاراً
وَمَا أَنتُمْ بِمُكْرِهِينَ أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ وَلاَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ وَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ سُوءاً يُجْزَ بِهِ وَلاَ يَجِدُ لَهُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلِيّاً وَلاَ نَصِيراً
وَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ وَيُؤْمِنْ بِاللَّهِ فَلاَ يَخَافُ ظُلْماً وَلاَ هَضْماً
كَذَلِكَ كَتَبْنَا عَلَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَنْ مَنْ كَانَ فِي الدُّنْيَا مُؤْمِناً مُهَاجِراً فَلَهُ أَجْرُهُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ وَلاَ خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
وَمَنْ كَانَ كَافِراً فَلاَ تَقْتَرِبْ مِنْهُ حَتَّى يَحْمِلَ إِلَى مَدِينَةٍ جَوَازَهُ فَإِنِ اسْتَنْقَضَتْ مِنْهُ فَاقْتُلُوهُ حَيْثُ وَجَدْتُمُوهُ وَلاَ تَقْتَرِبُوا مِنْهُ وَإِنْ قَاتَلَكُمْ فَاقْتُلُوهُ كَذَلِكَ جَزَاءُ الْكَافِرِينَ
وَمَا كَانَ جَزَاءَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا إِلاَّ الْخَيْرُ
وَمَنْ أَحْسَنَ مِنْ مَنْ آمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحاً وَكَانَ الْحَقَّ تَوَفَّاهُ مُؤْمِناً فَأُولَئِكَ أَهْلُوا الْفُرْقَانِ وَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُتَّقُونَ
وَلَقَدْ أَخْرَجْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنَ الْمَسْكَنِ مَكَاناً نَجِيعُهُ وَرَزَقْنَاهُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَفَضَّلْنَاهُمْ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ
وَلَأَتْبَعَنَّهُمْ بِسَيِّئَةٍ مِمَّا عَمِلُوا إِلاَّ عَمَلاً مِثْلَ عَمَلِ أُولِي الْبَأْسِ وَلاَ يَتَأَتَوْنَ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ هُدًى لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا إِبْلِيسَ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ
وَلَقَدْ أَغْرَيْنَاكُمْ بِطَاغُوتٍ مِثْلَ جَزَاءِ الْخَيْرِ وَكَانَ رَبُّكُمْ أَوْلَى بِأَنْ يُصْلِحَكُمْ وَكَانَ رَبُّكُمْ غَفُوراً رَحِيماً
وَلَقَدْ تَقَطَّعْنَاهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ أَمْثَالَهُمْ وَأَنْبَتْنَا لَهُمْ مِنَ الْقَصَبِ وَأَكْوَابٍ وَمِنْ فُومٍ وَأَغْثَاهُمْ بِقِطَافٍ وَذَرَاعٍ وَظِلٍّ مَكِينٍ
فَكُفُّوا عَنْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ وَلاَ تَكُونُوا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
وَلَقَدْ جِئْتُمْ آَيَةً مِثْلَ جَزَاءِ السَّلْوَى وَأَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ مِنَ الْمُسْتَكْرِ وَالْقِصْرِ وَمِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَرَزَقْنَاهُمْ بِحَصَدٍ وَفَاكِهَةٍ وَذَرَاعٍ وَعِنَبٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ وَاسْتَمْتَعُوا بِهَا فَلَبِثُوا فِي مَسْكَنٍ حَسَنٍ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ غَفُوراً رَحِيماً

**S (Saad) 38:1-16**

In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful

1. S.* and the Quran that contains the message.

2. Those who disbelieved have plunged into arrogance and defiance.

3. Many a generation before them we annihilated. They called for help, but to no avail.

4. They wondered that a warner should come to them, from among them. The disbelievers said, “He is a magician; a liar.

5. ‘Did he make the gods into one god? This is really strange.’”

6. The leaders announced, “Go and steadfastly persevere in worshiping your gods. This is all you need.

7. ‘We never heard of this from the religion of our fathers. This is a lie.

8. ‘Why did the message come down to him, instead of us?’ Indeed, they are doubtful of My message. Indeed, they have not yet tasted My retribution.

9. Do they own the treasures of your Lord’s mercy? He is the Almighty, the Grantor.

10. Do they possess the kingship of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them? Let them promote themselves.

11. Instead, whatever forces they can muster, even if all their parties banded together, will be defeated.

12. Disbelieving before them were the people of Noah, ‘Aad, and the mighty Pharaoh.

13. Also, Thamoud, the people of Lot, the dwellers of the Woods (of Midyan); those were the parties.

14. Each of them disbelieved the messengers; thus, My retribution was inevitable.

15. These people can expect a single blow, from which they will never recover.

16. They challenged: “Our Lord, why do you not rush the retribution for us, before the Day of Reckoning.”

---

17. Be patient in the face of their utterances, and remember our servant David, the resourceful; he was obedient.

18. We committed the mountains in his service, glorifying with him night and day.

19. Also the birds were committed to serve him; all were obedient to him.

20. We strengthened his kingship, and endowed him with wisdom and good logic.

21. Have you received news of the feuding men who sneaked into his sanctuary?

22. When they entered his room, he was startled. They said, “Have no fear. We have been feuding with one another, and we are seeking your fair judgment. Do not wrong us, and guide us in the right path.

23. This brother of mine owns ninety-nine sheep, while I own one sheep. He wants to mix my sheep with his, and continues to pressure me.”

24. He said, “He is being unfair to you by asking to combine your sheep with his. Most people who combine their properties treat each other unfairly, except those who believe and work righteousness, and these are so few.” Afterwards, David wondered if he made the right judgment. He thought that we were testing him. He then implored his Lord for forgiveness, bowed down, and repented.*

25. We forgave him, and granted him a position of honor with us, and a beautiful abode.

26. O David, we have made you a ruler on earth. You shall rule among the people equitably, and do not follow your personal opinion, lest it diverts you from the way of GOD. Surely, those who stray off the way of GOD incur severe retribution for forgetting the Day of Reckoning.

**God Makes it up to the Believers**

43. We restored his family for him, and twice as many. Such is our mercy; a reminder for those who possess intelligence.

44. “Now, you shall travel the land and preach the message, to fulfill your pledge.” We found him steadfast. What a good servant! He was a submitter.

45. Remember also our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. They were resourceful, and possessed vision.

46. We blessed them with a great blessing: awareness of the Hereafter.

47. They were chosen, among the best.

48. And remember Ismail, Elisha, and Zal-Kifl; they were among the best.

49. This is a message: The righteous have deserved a good destiny.

50. The gardens of Eden will open up their gates for them.

51. Relaxing therein, they will be given many kinds of fruits and drinks.

52. They will have beautiful companions.

53. This is what you deserved on the Day of Reckoning.

54. Our provisions are inexhaustible.

55. As for the transgressors, they have incurred a miserable destiny.

56. Hell is where they burn; what a miserable abode!

57. What they taste therein will be hellish drinks and bitter food.

58. And much more of the same kind.

59. This is a group to join you in Hell. They will say, “You are not welcomed.”

60. They will respond, “Nor are you welcomed. You are the ones who misled us, so suffer this miserable end.”

61. They will also say, “Our Lord, whoever led us into this, double the retribution for him in Hell.”

---
وَهَٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُّبَارَكٌ نَّزَّلْنَاهُ ۖ وَهُمْ بِهِ مُؤْمِنُونَ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ رُشْدَهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِ عَالِمِينَ
إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا هَٰذَا التَّمَثُّلُ الَّذِي أَنْتُمْ فِيهِ عَلَىٰ عَجُولٍ
يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي لَكُم مُّنذِرٌ مُبِينٌ
أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
فَكَانَ مِنْ مُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَخَذْنَاهُ بِرَحْمَتِنَا ۖ إِنَّهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
وَجَعَلْنَاهُ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أَوْلِيَاءَ بَيْتٍ مُبَارَكًا ۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ بِالْخَيْرِ مُقْبِلِينَ
إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا لَنَا عَبِيدًا مُؤْمِنِينَ
وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّاهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَآتَيْنَاهُمْ مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُتَكَافِلًا
وَإِنْ يَتَكَلَّمُوهُ بِكَلِمَةٍ لِيُفْسِدُوا فِيهَا مُبِينًا
أَجْزِيَهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ بِمَا صَبَرُوا وَهُمْ مُحْسِنُونَ
أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ هَدَيْنَاهُم مُّهْتَدِينَ وَآتَيْنَاهُمْ مِن لَّدُنَّا رَحْمَةً ۖ وَكَانَ قَوْمُهُمْ كَانُوا فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ

62. They will say, “How come we do not see people whom we considered evil?”
63. “We kept on mocking them. We diverted our eyes from them.”
64. This is a predetermined fact: the people of Hell will feud with one another.

68. “That you are totally oblivious to.

70. “I am inspired that my sole mission is to deliver the warnings to you.”
71. Your Lord said to the angels, “I am creating a human being from clay.
72. “Once I perfect him, and blow into him from My spirit, you shall fall prostrate before him.”
73. The angels fell prostrate, all of them.
74. Only Satan refused. He was too arrogant, unappreciative.
75. He said, “O Satan, what prevented you from prostrating before the one I created with My hand? Were you too arrogant? Have you rebelled?”
76. He said, “I am better than he. You created me from fire, and created him from clay.”
77. He said, “Therefore, you must be exiled, you are rejected.
78. “You have incurred My condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”
79. He said, “My Lord, respite me till the Day of Resurrection.”
80. He said, “You are respited.
81. “Until the appointed day.”
82. He said, “By Your majesty, I will mislead them all.
83. “Except Your worshipers who are devoted absolutely to You alone.”

*38:69 The feud in the High Society was triggered by Satan’s challenge to God’s absolute authority. This is definitely the most important event in the history of the human race, since we failed to make a firm stand regarding God’s absolute authority. We are here to redeem ourselves (See Introduction and Appendix 7)*
