**Sura 39: The Throngs (Al-Zumer)**

In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful

1. This is a revelation of the scripture, from **GOD**, the Almighty, the Wise.

2. We sent down to you this scripture, truthfully, so worship **GOD** alone, devoting your religion to Him alone.

**The Idols as Mediators**
*A Common Myth*

3. Absolutely, the religion shall be devoted to **GOD** alone. Those who set up idols besides Him say, “We idolize them only to bring us closer to **GOD**; they are in a good position!” **GOD** will judge them regarding their disputes. **GOD** does not guide any liar, unappreciative.

4. If **GOD** wanted to have a son, He could have chosen whomever He willed from among His creation. Be He glorified; He is **GOD**, the One, the Supreme.

5. He created the heavens and the earth truthfully. He rolls the night over the day, and rolls the day over the night.* He committed the sun and the moon, each running for a finite period. Absolutely, He is the Almighty, the Forgiving.

---
*39:5 This verse clearly informs us that the earth is round. The Arabic for “He rolls” (Yukawwiru) is derived from the Arabic word for “ball” (Kurah). The Quran is replete with scientific information that became known to us many centuries after the revelation of the Quran. See Appendix 20.

6. He created you from one person, then created from him his mate. He sent down to you eight kinds of livestock. He creates you in your mothers’ bellies, creation after creation, in three layers of darkness. Such is **GOD** your Lord. To Him belongs all kingship. There is no other god besides Him. How could you deviate?

   *Believe For Your Own Good*

7. If you disbelieve, **GOD** does not need you. But He dislikes to see His servants make the wrong decision. If you decide to be appreciative, He approves it for you. No soul bears the sins of any other soul. Ultimately, to your Lord is your return, then He will inform you of everything you had done. He is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.

8. When the human being is afflicted, he implores his Lord, sincerely devoted to Him. But as soon as He blesses him, he forgets his previous imploring, sets up idols to rank with **GOD** and diverts others from His path. Say, “Enjoy your disbelief temporarily; you have incurred Hell.”

9. Is it not better to be one of those who meditate in the night, prostrating and staying up, being aware of the Hereafter, and seeking the mercy of their Lord? Say, “Are those who know equal to those who do not know?” Only those who possess intelligence will take heed.

10. Say, “O My servants who believed, you shall observe your Lord.” For those who worked righteousness in this world, a good reward. **GOD’s** earth is spacious, and those who steadfastly persevere will receive their recompense without limits.

**The Throngs (Al-Zumer) 39:11-21**

**God ALONE**

11. Say, “I have been commanded to worship **GOD**, devoting the religion absolutely to Him alone.

12. ‘And I was commanded to be the utmost submitter.”

13. Say, “I fear, if I disobeyed my Lord, the retribution of a great day.”

14. Say, “**GOD** is the only One I worship, devoting my religion absolutely to Him alone.

15. ‘Therefore, worship whatever you wish besides Him.’” Say, “The real losers are those who lose their souls, and their families, on the Day of Resurrection.” Most certainly, this is the worst loss.

16. They will have masses of fire on top of them, and under them. **GOD** thus alerts His servants. O My servants, you shall reverence Me.

17. As for those who discarded the worship of all idols, and devoted themselves totally to **GOD**, they have the good news. Give good news to My servants.

**Follow the Word of God**

18. They are the ones who examine all words, then follow the best. These are the ones whom **GOD** has guided; these are the ones who possess intelligence.

19. For those who have incurred the retribution, can you save those who are already in Hell?

20. As for those who reverence their Lord, they will have mansions upon mansions constructed for them, with flowing streams. This is **GOD**’s promise, and **GOD** never breaks His promise.

21. Do you not see that **GOD** sends down from the sky water, then places it into underground wells, then produces with it plants of various colors, then they grow until they turn yellow, and become hay? This should be a reminder for those who possess intelligence.

*The Best Hadith*

أَلَا تَتَّخِذُوا بِرَجُلَيْنِ مِنْكُمْ حِجَابًا أَنْ تَفْشَلُوا وَتَنْسَوَ ذِكْرَ اللَّهِ

كَيْفَ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَأَنْتُمْ تُؤْمَنُونَ
وَلَقَدْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ بِالْبُشْرَىٰ قَالُوا سَلَامًا قَالَ سَلَامٌ

نَفْسًا وَلَمْ يَبْخَسُوا شَيْئًا

قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ
أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ

رَسُولٌ مُقْتَدِرٌ

فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمَا بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالَ إِنِّي قَتَلْتُكُمْ أَوْ آذَنْتُكُمْ

فَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاتَّبِعْ سَبِيلِي وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ

فَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُجْرِمِينَ

**The Throngs (Al-Zumer) 39:32-40**

32. Who is more evil than one who attributes lies to **GOD**, while disbelieving in the truth that has come to him? Is Hell not a just requital for the disbelievers?

    *Quran: Absolute Truth*

33. On the other hand, those who promote the truth, and believe therein, are the righteous.

34. They get anything they wish, at their Lord. Such is the reward for the pious.

35. **GOD** remits their sinful works, and rewards them generously for their righteous works.

    *Profound Question*

36. Is **GOD** not sufficient for His servant? They frighten you with the idols they set up besides Him. Whomever **GOD** sends astray, nothing can guide him.

37. And whomever **GOD** guides, nothing can send him astray. Is **GOD** not Almighty, Avenger?

    *They Believe in God Yet, They Are Going to Hell*

38. If you ask them, “Who created the heavens and the earth?” they will say, "**GOD**.” Say, “What about the idols you set up besides **GOD**? If **GOD** willed any adversity for me, can they relieve such an adversity? And if He willed a blessing for me, can they prevent such a blessing?” Say, "**GOD** is sufficient for me.” In Him the trusters shall trust.

39. Say, “O my people, do your best, and I will do my best; you will surely find out.

40. (You will find out) who has incurred shameful punishment, and has deserved an eternal retribution.”

41. We have revealed the scripture through you for the people, truthfully.
   Then, whoever is guided is guided for his own good,
   and whoever goes astray goes astray to his own detriment.
   You are not their advocate.

42. **GOD** puts the souls to rest at the time of death, and at the time of sleep.
   Thus, while some are put to death during their sleep,
   others are allowed to continue living for a predetermined interim.
   This should provide lessons for people who reflect.

   **The Myth of Intercession**

43. Have they invented intercessors
   to mediate between them and **GOD**?
   Say, “What if they do not possess
   any power, nor understanding?”

44. Say, “All intercession belongs to **GOD**.” To Him belongs the
   kingship of the heavens and the earth, then to Him
   you will be returned.

   **The Greatest Criterion\***

45. When **GOD** ALONE is mentioned,
   the hearts of those who do not
   believe in the Hereafter
   shrink with aversion.
   But when others are mentioned
   besides Him, they rejoice.*

46. Say, “Our god, Initiator of the
   heavens and the earth, Knower of all
   secrets and declarations, You are
   the only One who judges among Your
   servants regarding their disputes.”

47. If those who transgressed owned
   everything on earth, even twice as much, they would readily give it up
   to avoid the terrible retribution on the Day of Resurrection.
   They will be shown by **GOD** what they never expected.

---

**39:45** Despite the clear commandment in 3:18 that the First Pillar of Islam is proclaiming: “Ash-hadu An Laa Elaaha Ellaah Allah (there is no other god besides God),” the majority of ‘Muslims’ insist upon adding the name of Muhammad. This Greatest Criterion alerts us that rejoicing in adding the name of Muhammad, or any other name, exposes disbelief in the Hereafter. See also Footnote 17:46.

48. The sinful works they had earned will be shown to them, and the very things they used to mock will come back to haunt them.

**Human Fickleness**

49. If the human is touched by adversity, he implores us, but as soon as we bestow a blessing upon him, he says, "I attained this because of my cleverness!" Indeed, this is only a test, but most of them do not know.

50. Those before them have uttered the same thing, but their earnings did not help them in the least.

51. They suffered the consequences of their evil works. Similarly, the transgressors among the present generation will suffer the consequences of their evil works; they cannot escape.

52. Do they not realize that **GOD** is the One who increases the provision for whomever He chooses, and withholds it? These are lessons for people who believe.

**God’s Infinite Mercy**

53. Proclaim: “O My servants who exceeded the limits, never despair of **GOD**’s mercy. **GOD** forgives all sins. He is the Forgiver, Most Merciful.”

54. You shall obey your Lord, and submit to Him totally, before the retribution overtakes you, then you cannot be helped.

55. And follow the best path that is pointed out for you by your Lord, before the retribution overtakes you suddenly when you least expect it.

56. Lest a soul may say, “How sorry I am for disregarding **GOD**’s commandments; I was certainly one of the mockers.”

   “If I get another chance, I will work righteousness.”

60. On the Day of Resurrection you will see the faces of those
   who lied about **GOD** covered with misery. Is Hell not the right retribution
   for the arrogant ones?

61. And **GOD** will save those who observed righteousness and will

62. **GOD** is the Creator of all things, and He is in full control of all things.

**The Throngs (Al-Zumer) 39:68-74**

**The Day of Judgment**

68. The horn is blown, whereupon everyone in the heavens and the earth is struck dead, except those whom **GOD** wills. Then it is blown again, whereupon they rise up, looking.

69. Then the earth shines with the light of its Lord. The record is presented, and the prophets and the witnesses are brought forth. Then everyone is judged equitably, without the least injustice.

70. Every soul is paid for whatever it did. He is fully aware of everything they have done.

**The Disbelievers**

71. Those who disbelieved are led to Hell in throngs. When they get to it, and its gates are opened, its guards will say, “Did you not receive messengers from among you, who recited to you the revelations of your Lord, and warned you about meeting this day?” They will answer, “Yes. But the word ‘retribution’ was already stamped upon the disbelievers.”

72. It will be said, “Enter the gates of Hell, wherein you abide forever.” What a miserable destiny for the arrogant.

**The Believers**

73. Those who reverenced their Lord will be led to Paradise in throngs. When they get to it, and its gates are opened, its guards will say, “Peace be upon you; you have won. Therefore, you abide herein forever.”

74. They will say, “Praise be to **GOD**, who fulfilled His promise to us, and made us inherit the earth, enjoying Paradise as we please.” What a beautiful recompense for the workers!

وَنُزِّلَ الْكِتَابُ وَأُقِيمَتِ الْقِسْطَاسُ وَأُوتِيَ مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَقِيلَ إِنْ تَعْمَلُوا خَيْرًا لَّأَنْفُسِكُمْ تُقْضَى وَإِنْ تَرْجُفُوا فَلَهُ مُرَاجِعُ الْعِقَابِ
وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ
وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِي الزَّبُورِ مِنْ بَعْدِ الذِّكْرِ أَنَّ الْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِيَ الصَّالِحُونَ
إِنَّ فِي هَذَا لَبَلَاغًا لِّقَوْمٍ عَابِدِينَ
وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مِنْهُمْ مِيثَاقًا فَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
وَلَقَدْ رَأَيْنَا مُوسَى وَهَارُونَ وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِمَا وَأَجْزَيْنَاهُمَا فَاذْكُرُوا آلَاءَ اللَّهِ أَنْ تُذْكَرُوا
وَلَقَدْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ بِالْبُشْرَى قَالُوا سَلَامًا قَالُوا سَلَامًا فَأَسْرَعُوا إِلَى يَعْجُجَ فَقَالُوا إِنَّا إِلَيْكُمْ رُسُلٌ
قَالُوا مَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُرْسَلِينَ
قَالُوا بَلْ كُنَّا قَوْمًا كَفَرُوا وَكُذِّبُوا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ مُوسَى بِبَيِّنَاتِنَا قَالُوا مَا هَذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُفْتَرًى
وَقَالَ مُوسَى أَتَعْجَبُونَ مِنْ سِحْرِي هَذَا وَقَدْ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُهُ لِيُبَيِّنَ بِهِ وَيُضِلَّ بِهِ وَيَأْخُذَ بِهِ الظَّالِمِينَ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ مِنْ لَدُنَّا فَضْلًا يَا جِبَالُ أَوِّبِي مَعَهُ وَالطَّيْرَ وَأَلِنَّا لَهُ الْحَدِيدَ
أَنِْ اعْمَلْ سابِغَاتٍ وَقَدِّهِنَّ قَالُوا عَمِلْنَا صَبْغًا سَرِيعًا أَوْ أَلْقِيهِ فِي الْحُطَامِ
وَلَقَدْ عَلَّمَهُ دَاوُودَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ وَقَالَا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَانُ دَاوُودَ وَقَالَ يَا أَيَّتُهَا الْمَلَأُ إِنَّهُ إِنَّهُ إِنَّهُ لَا يُعْجِزُ اللَّهُ بِأَمْرٍ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَهُ قَالُوا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
وَلَقَدْ هَدَيْنَا دَاوُودَ زُبُرًا فَقَالُوا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَنْعَمَ عَلَيْنَا وَمَا بَدَا لَنَا مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِلَّا بِمَا أَعْطَانَا وَإِنَّهُ لَذُو فَضْلٍ كَبِيرٍ
وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا إِبْلِيسَ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ
وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مِنْهُمْ مِيثَاقًا فَلَا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا اللَّهَ وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا وَلا تَقْتُلُوا أَوْلَادَكُمْ مِنْ إِمْلَاقٍ نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُكُمْ وَلا تَقْرَبُوا الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَلا تَقْتُلُوا النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ ذَلِكُمْ وَصَّاكُمْ بِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا مَالَ الْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَأَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ وَالْمِيزَانَ بِالْقِسْطِ لاَ نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا وَإِذَا قَالَتْ أُمُّ قَوْمٍ إِنْ وَضَعْتُمْ أَوْلَادِي وَأَنَا أَحْضَرُ فَلَا تَضْرِبُوا وَجُوهَهُمْ وَلا تَعْثَوْا عَلَيْهِمْ وَإِذَا خِفْتُمْ فِيهِمْ فُجُورًا فَبِمَا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ فِيهِ فَكُلُوا وَلا تَقْتُلُوهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ لَكُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا زِنَاءَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ فِيهِ إِثْمٌ وَسَاءَ سَبِيلًا
وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَمَنْ يَقْتُلْ مُؤْمِنًا مُتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَاؤُهُ جَهَنَّمُ خَالِدًا فِيهَا وَغَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَلَعَنَهُ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُ مِنْ الْعَذَابِ الْعَظِيمَ
ذَلِكُمْ وَصَّاكُمْ بِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

وَالْأَرْضُ زَيَّتْ بِرَبِّهَا وَاسْتَجَبْنَا لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ
وَنُزِّلَ الْكِتَابُ وَأُقِيمَتِ الْقِسْطَاسُ
وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوًّا مِنْ الْمُجْرِمِينَ
فَأُولَئِكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يُوَفَّوْنَ أَجْرَهُمْ وَيَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْفَزَعِ يَوْمَئِذٍ هُمُ الْمُفْتَرُونَ
وَنَحْشُرُهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عُمِيًّا
ثُمَّ لَا نَذَرُ أَحَدًا مِنْهُمْ وَلَا نَسْتَطِيعُ
وَتَكُونُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةً
وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي الْجَهَنَّمَ كَثِيرًا مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ وَهُمْ فِيهَا مُقْتَرِنُونَ
وَمَا ذَرَأْنَا قَرْيَةً إِلَّا لَهُمْ مُهْلِكٌ
ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ مِنْ دُونِنَا نَصِيرًا
وَلَقَدْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا فَقَالُوا إِنَّا رَسُولُكَ إِلَى قَوْمِكَ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا فَاسِقِينَ
قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَىكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
قَالُوا أَتَأْتِينَا بِآيَةٍ وَكَانَ أَخَاهُمْ لُوطًا قَدْ كَذَّبَ وَإِنَّا بِكَ لَكَافِرُونَ
قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِي عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْمُفْسِدِينَ
فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَفْئِدَةً قَلِيلًا وَحَشَرْنَاهُمْ جَمِيعًا
فَأَقْبَلُوا إِلَيْهِ وَقَالُوا إِنَّا لَكَ مُؤْمِنُونَ وَكَانُوا قَبْلُ يُؤْفِكُونَ
فَلَمَّا سَكَنَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَعْقَبْنَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ وَكَانَ آخِرُهُمْ يُسْقَى وَقَالَ قَوْمُهُ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الْمُفْتَرِينَ
وَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ

أُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْتَرُونَ
فَأَذْهَبْنَا بِهِمْ وَبِمَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُمْ جَمِيعًا
ثُمَّ أَلْقَيْنَا عَلَى الَّذِينَ كَانُوا يَخْتَلِفُونَ فِي الْكِتَابِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَتْهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ وَكَانُوا عَنْهُ مُخْتَلِفِينَ إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ رَبُّكَ وَكَانَتْ عَذَابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَكْبَرَ لَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**Sura 40: Forgiver (Ghaafer)**

*In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful*

1. H. M.*

2. This revelation of the scripture is from **GOD**, the Almighty, the Omniscient.

3. Forgiver of sins, acceptor of repentance, strict in enforcing retribution, and possessor of all power. There is no other god besides Him. To Him is the ultimate destiny.

4. None argues against **GOD**’s revelations except those who disbelieve. Do not be impressed by their apparent success.

5. Disbelieving before them were the people of Noah, and many parties after them. Every community attacked their messenger to neutralize him. And they argued with falsehood, to defeat the truth. Consequently, I punished them; how terrible was My retribution!

6. Thus, the word of your Lord is already stamped upon those who disbelieve, that they are the dwellers of Hell.

*Angels Pray for the Believers*

7. Those who serve the throne and all those around it glorify and praise their Lord, and believe in Him. And they ask forgiveness for those who believed: “Our Lord, Your mercy and Your knowledge encompass all things. Forgive those who repent and follow Your path, and spare them the retribution of Hell.

8. “Our Lord, and admit them into the gardens of Eden that You promised for them and for the righteous among their parents, spouses, and children. You are the Almighty, Most Wise.

**God ALONE**

**The Reason**

13. He is the One who continuously shows you His signs, and sends down to you from the sky provisions. Only those who totally submit will be able to take heed.

14. Therefore, you shall devote your worship absolutely to GOD alone, even if the disbelievers dislike it.

15. Possessor of the highest ranks, and Ruler of the whole dominion. He sends inspiration, bearing His commands, to whomever He chooses from among His servants, to warn about the Day of Gathering.

16. That is the day when they will be completely exposed; none of them will hide anything from GOD. To whom belongs all kingship on that day? To GOD, the One, the Supreme.

**Forgiver (Ghaafer) 40:17-25**

**Prepare for the Big Day**

17. On that day, every soul will be paid for whatever it earned. There will be no injustice on that day. **GOD** is most efficient in reckoning.

18. Warn them about the imminent day, when the hearts will be terrified, and the transgressors will be remorseful. They will have no friend nor an intercessor to be obeyed.

19. He is fully aware of what the eyes cannot see, and everything that the minds conceal.

20. And **GOD** judges equitably, while the idols they worship besides Him cannot judge anything. **GOD** is the One who is the Hearer, the Seer.

21. Did they not roam the earth and note the consequences for those before them? They used to be stronger than they, and more productive on earth. But **GOD** punished them for their sins, and nothing could protect them from **GOD**.

22. That is because their messengers went to them with clear signs, but they disbelieved. Consequently, **GOD** punished them. He is Mighty, strict in enforcing retribution.

**Moses**

23. We sent Moses with our signs and profound authority.

24. To Pharaoh, Haamaan, and Qaaroon. But they said, “A magician; a liar.”

25. And when he showed them the truth from us, they said, “Kill the sons of those who believed with him, and spare their daughters.” Thus, the scheming of the disbelievers is always evil.

أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ

وَقَامَ أَهْلُ ثَمُودَ بِالْجَوَارِ

فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِي يَوْمِ نَحِيرٍ مُسْتَمِرٍّ
فَأَخَذَهُمْ غَادِبَةً فَكَانُوا فِي الصَّحْرَاءِ كَأَشْعَارِ نَخْلٍ مُنْقَعِرٍ

أَخَذَهُ الْمَوْتُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ حَقًّا عَلَى الْعَبِيدِ
وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِالسِّنِينَ وَقَلْبٍ مَغْلُولٍ
ذَلِكَ وَاسِطَتُنَا نُؤْتِيهَا الْمُتَّقِينَ
وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَا هَامَانُ ابْنِ لِي صَرْحًا أَعْلَاهُ وَلْأَبْنِ لِي طَرِيًّا
أَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَأَنَا أَظُنُّكَ مِنَ الْمُهْلَكِينَ
وَلَقَدْ عَطَا فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهُ فَهَمُّوا فِيهِ وَكَانُوا جَاهِرِينَ
فَقَالَ هَامَانُ رَبِّ شَيْءٍ لِي وَلِفِرْعَوْنَ لَا نُخْلِفْ مِيعَادَ
فَأَغْرَى الشَّيْطَانُ بَيْنَهُمَا فَعَلَا فِيهَا وَكَانَا مِنَ الْمُهْلَكِينَ
وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَا هَامَانُ اعْمَلْ لِي عَمَلًا فِى الطِّينِ فَاجْعَلْ لِي صَرْحًا لَعَلِّي أَطَّلِعُ إِلَى إِلَهِ مُوسَى وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّهُ كَاذِبًا
وَلَقَدْ أَذَكَّرَهُ رَبُّهُ فَلَهُوَ مُبْطِلٌ لِلْحُكْمِ وَهُوَ مُرْتَدٌّ بِالْبَاطِلِ
وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَاهُمْ بِكِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ
فَجَعَلْنَاهُ نَاقُصًا مِثْلَ مَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ مِنْ لَدُنَّا فَضْلًا فَالْأَرْضُ تَحِينُ بِهِ يَتَوَفَّى وَيُمِيتُ
وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَا فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَقَارُونَ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَقَالُوا كَاهِنَانِ سَاحِرَانِ
وَلَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ وَعَصَوْا عَنْهُ
فَأَخَذَهُمْ الْعَذَابُ بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ
وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَا مُوسَى بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَقُوَّةٍ مُبِينَةٍ
إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ فَعَصَوْا عَنْهَا فَقَالُوا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الطَّاغُوتَ فَعَصَوْا عَنْهَا فَهَذَا جَزَاءُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ
وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَا فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمَهُ بِالْهُدَى فَعَصَوْا عَنْهُ فَقَالُوا قَتِلُوا أَبْنَاءَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَاسْتَحْيُوا نِسَاءَهُمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ فِى ذَلِكَ لَمُجْرِمُونَ
وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَا قَارُونَ وَقَوْمَهُ نِعْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِنَا وَكَانُوا بِهَا مُبْطِلِينَ
فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ وَإِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ

**Forgiver (Ghaafer) 40:26-33**

**Moses vs Pharaoh**

26. Pharaoh said, “Let me kill Moses, and let him implore his Lord. I worry lest he corrupts your religion, or spreads evil throughout the land.”

27. Moses said, “I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord, from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.”

28. A believing man among Pharaoh’s people, who was concealing his belief, said, “How can you kill a man just for saying, ‘My Lord is God,’ and he showed you clear signs from your Lord? If he is a liar, that is his problem, and if he is truthful, you benefit from his prophecies. Surely, God does not guide any transgressor, liar.”

29. “O my people, today you have kingship and the upper hand. But who will help us against God’s judgment, should it come to us?” Pharaoh said, “You are to follow whatever I see fit; I will guide you in the right path.”

30. The one who believed said, “O my people, I fear for you the same fate as the previous parties.

31. “The parties of Noah, ‘Aad, Thamoud, and others who came after them. God does not wish any injustice for the people.

32. “O my people, I fear for you the Day of Summoning.

33. “That is the day when you turn around and flee. But nothing will protect you from God. Whomever God sends astray, nothing can guide him.”

**Forgiver (Ghaafer) 40:34-40**

**Who is the Last Messenger?**
*A Tragic Human Trait*

34. Joseph had come to you in the past with clear signs,
but you continued to doubt his message. And when he died you said,
**"GOD** will not send any messenger after him. *(He was the last messenger!)"**
**GOD** thus sends astray those who are transgressors, doubtful.*

35. They argue against **GOD**’s revelations, without any basis.
This is a trait that is most abhorred
by **GOD** and by those who believe.
**GOD** thus seals the hearts of
every arrogant oppressor.

36. Pharaoh said, “O Haamaan,
build for me a high tower,
that I may reach out and discover.

37. “I want to reach the heaven,
and take a look at the god
of Moses. I believe he is a liar.”
Thus were the evil works of Pharaoh adorned in his eyes, and thus was he diverted from the path.
Pharaoh’s scheming was truly evil.

38. The one who believed said,
“O my people, follow me,
and I will guide you in the right way.

39. “O my people, this first life is a temporary existence, while the Hereafter is the eternal abode.”

**The Best Deal**

40. Whoever commits a sin is requited for just that. But whoever works righteousness, be it male or female, while believing, these will enter Paradise wherein they receive provisions without any limits.

فَسَوْفَ يُبَصِّرُهُمُ اللَّهُ مَا كَانُوا بِهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ وَمَا كَانُوا بِهِ يَكْفُرُونَ

وَلَقَدْ جَاءَتْهُ آيَاتُنَا فَقَلْتُمْ لَهَا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ

وَلَقَدْ أَغْرَيْتُهُمْ فَمَا زَالُوا فِي طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَتَنَاوَلُونَ
فَالْيَوْمَ نَخْلُفُهُمْ فِيمَا اسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا نُغَادِرُ مُجْرِمِينَ

*40:34 The Jews refused to believe in the Messiah when he came to them, the Christians refused to believe in Muhammad when he came, and a majority of today’s Muslims believe that Muhammad was the last messenger. On that erroneous basis, they refused to accept God’s Messenger of the Covenant. We learn from 3:81-90 and 33:7 that those who fail to accept the Quranic injunction to “believe in and support God’s messenger of the covenant” are no longer believers. See Appendices 2 & 26.*

**Forgiver (Ghaafer) 40:41-49**

**The Believing Egyptian Debates With His People**

41. "O my people, while I invite you to be saved,
you invite me to Hell.

42. "You invite me to be unappreciative of **GOD**,
by setting up besides Him
idols that I do not recognize,
while I invite you to the Almighty, the Forgiver.

43. "There is no doubt that what you
invite me to do has no basis
in this world, nor in the Hereafter,
that our ultimate return is to **GOD**,
and that the transgressors
will end up in Hell.

44. "Some day you will remember
what I am telling you now.
I leave the judgment of this matter
to **GOD**; **GOD** is the Seer
of all the people."

45. **GOD** then protected him
from their evil schemes.
The people of Pharaoh
have incurred the worst retribution.

**A Continuous Nightmare**

46. The Hell will be shown to them
day and night, and on the Day of
Resurrection: "Admit Pharaoh's
people into the worst retribution."

47. As they argue in Hell,
the followers will say to their leaders,
"We used to be your followers,
can you spare us any part
of this Hell?"

48. The leaders will say,
"We are all in this together.
**GOD** has judged among the people."

**Too Late**

49. Those in the fire will say to the guardians of Hell,
"Call upon your Lord to reduce
the retribution for us by one day."

وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ لَقُومِهِۦٓ إِنَّكُمْ سَأْتُمُونِ
بِٱلْخَيْرِ وَقَدْ جَآءَكُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بِٱلْأَدِيلَةِ
فَٱسْتَجِيبُواْ لِي وَلَا تَتَّبِعُواْ سَبِيلَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
أَتُجَٰدِلُونَنِى فِىٓ أَسْمَآءِ سَمَّيْنَٰهَآ أَنَّهَا
وَلَكِنْ أَرَٰدَ بِهِ ٱلرَّشَدَ وَيَتَّقِ ٱلْمَعْرُوفَ
وَقُلْتُ إِنَّمَآ أَعْتَصِمُ بِهِۦ شُعْبَةً مِّنَ ٱلْجَبَلِ
أَوْ شِيبَةً فَاِسْتَمْسَكَ بِهَا
فَأَزْهَقَنِى ٱلْمَعْرُوفَ
وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَا تَأْتِنَا بِٱلْعَذَابِ
أِنْ كُنَّا مُجْرِمِينَ
فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
فَلَمْ يَسْتَطِيعُواْ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مُجَانَبَةً وَلَا هُمْ يُنْجَوْنَ
وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ مُوسَىٰ بِٱلْحُجَّةِ
فَٱسْتَجَابُواْ بِأَنَّهُمْ يُلْجِمُونَ
ثُمَّ ٱتَّخَذُواْ عِجْلَ ٱلْعِشْتِ وَقَالُواْ هَٰذَا إِلَٰهُكُمْ وَإِلَٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِىَ
فَلَمَّا رَأَىٰ أَن لَّمْ يُحْذَرُواْ
جَعَلَ لَهُمْ عِجْلَ ٱلْعِشْتِ
فَقَالُواْ هَٰذَا إِلَٰهُكُمْ وَإِلَٰهُ مُوسَىٰ
وَلَكِنَّهُمْ ظَلَمُواْ
ثُمَّ أَرَادُواْ أَن يَحْثُوهُ
فَلَمَّا رَأَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَن قَوْمَهُۥ شَرُّواْ
قَالَ رَبِّ ٱحْقِطْ مِلْكَهُمْ وَٱغْرِقْ أَحْشَاءَهُمْ
وَقَالَ لَهُمْ نَبِيُّهُمْ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَذَّابٌ كَذَّابٌ
فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ
فَأَصْبَحُواْ فِى دِيَارِهِمْ جَٰثِمِينَ
كَأَنَّمَا لَمْ يَغْنَوْاْ فِيهَا
أَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ
أَمْ كَانَ قَوْمُ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ
فَكُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ
إِلَّا أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ
فِى جَنَّٰتٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
فِيهَا كَآئِنَةً مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ
وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا حَمِيمٌ
كَأَنَّهُۥ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
فِيهَا كَآئِنَةٌ مِّنْ فِضَّةٍ
وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا فِضَّةٌ
كَأَنَّهَا عَيْنٌ لُجَّاجَةٌ
لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَقْفٌ مِّن نَّارٍ
لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ
فِيهَا رِجْزٌ شَدِيدٌ
ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْمُهِينُ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْاْ
يَكُونُونَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

فَأَزْهَقَتْهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ حَقًّا
ثُمَّ غَفَرَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ
وَأَنَجَىٰهُمْ مِّنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْقَبْرِ
كَذَٰلِكَ يَتَجَرَّبُ ٱللَّهُ
مَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ
خُذُوهُ وَٱرْجِعُوهُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ
إِنَّا مُحْصِنُونَ

## Page 492

Surely, here is the transcription:

---

50. They will say, “Did you not receive your messengers who delivered to you clear messages?”
They will reply, “Yes we did.” They will say, “Then implore (as much as you wish); the imploring of the disbelievers is always in vain.”

**Guaranteed Victory**

51. We will surely give victory to our messengers and to those who believe, both in this world and on the day the witnesses are summoned.

52. On that day, the apologies of the disbelievers will not benefit them. They have incurred condemnation; they have incurred the worst destiny.

**Learn From History**

53. We have given Moses the guidance, and made the Children of Israel inherit the scripture.

54. (Their history) is a lesson and a reminder for those who possess intelligence.

55. Therefore, be patient, for GOD’s promise is true, and ask forgiveness for your sins. You shall glorify and praise your Lord night and day.

56. Surely, those who argue against GOD’s revelations without proof are exposing the arrogance that is hidden inside them, and they are not even aware of it. Therefore, seek refuge in GOD; He is the Hearer, the Seer.

57. The creation of the heavens and the earth is even more awesome than the creation of the human being, but most people do not know.

58. Not equal are the blind and the seer. Nor are those who believe and work righteousness equal to the sinners. Rarely do you take heed.

---
فَأَلَا عَلَیْهِمْ نَصَرْنَا نَبِیًّّا مُّصْتَبَشِرًا وَقَالُواْ قَاتِلُواْ أَوْ أَعْضِلُواْ وَقَالُواْ لَنْ نَكُفَّ أَوْمَاءَ عَنِ الْأَنْبِیَاءِ حَتَّى یَأْتِیَهُمُ اللّهُ وَأَصَابَهُمُ اللّهُ بِمَا کَانُواْ یَکْفُرُونَ
وَقُلْنَا یَا مُوسَى إِنَّنِیْ قَتَلْتُ قَوْمِكَ فَأَصْبِرْ وَلاَ تَأْسَرْ بِمَا صَنَعُواْ إِنَّهُمْ جَاهِلُونَ
فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَظَالِمُونَ
وَتَفَقَّدْنَا مُوسَى ثَلَاثَیْ عَشْرَةَ سِنِینَ وَتَمَّ مِیْقَاتُ إِبْرَاهِیمَ بِذَلِکَ أَلَا إِنَّ رَبَّکَ فَتَّانٌ عَلِیمٌ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْکِتَابَ مِن بَعْدِ مَا أَهْلَکْنَا الْقُرُونَ الْأُولَى بَلِیْسَ هَادِيًا وَرَحْمَةً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَمَا کُنْتَ بِجَانِبِ الْغَرْبِیِّ إِذْ قَضَیْنَا إِلَى مُوسَى الْأَمْرَ وَمَا کُنْتَ مِنَ الشَّاهِدِیْنَ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ مِن لَّدُنَّا فَضْلًا یَا جِبَالُ أَوِّبِیْ مَعَهُ وَالطَّیْرَ وَأَلَنَّا لَهُ الْحَدِیْدَ
أَنْ عَبِدُواْ نِیْعًا وَاذْکُرُواْ اسْمَ رَبِّکُمُّ یُوسُفَ وَأَخَاهُ وَجَعَلْنَا لِيْسُرَةً عَلَى الْقُرُونِ لِيَذَّکَّرُواْ
وَقِفُوْاْ لِلَّیْلِ وَانْقَرِضُواْ فِیْهِ وَیُخْرِجْ لَکُمُ اللّهُ نُرُوْسَهُ وَیُخْبِرْکُمْ بِمَا کُنْتُمْ تَفْعَلُونَ
وَلِلَّیْلِ وَاضْطَرَّبَ فِیهِ النَّجْمُ
وَلِلَّیْلِ إِذَا عَسْقَرَ
أَلَمْ یَرَوْاْ کَیْفَ خَلَقَ اللّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا
وَجَعَلَ الْقَمَرَ فِیْهِنَّ نُوْرًا وَجَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
وَاللّهُ أَنْبَتَکُمْ مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
ثُمَّ یُعِیْدُکُمْ فِیْهَا وَیُخْرِجُکُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
وَاللّهُ جَعَلَ لَکُمُ الْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَالسَّمَاءَ بِنَاءً وَصَوَّرَکُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوْرَکُمْ وَرَزَقَکُمُ مِنَ الطَّیْبَاتِ ذَلِکَ وَانْتَ لِلْحِسَابِ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْکِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُ أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ وَزِیْنَا لَهُمَا بِرُشْدِنَا وَذَلِکُمُ الْفَضْلُ الْمُبِیْنُ

59. Most certainly, the Hour is coming, no doubt about it,
but most people do not believe.

**Supplication: A Form of Worship\***

60. Your Lord says, “Implore Me, and I will respond to you.”
Surely, those who are too arrogant to worship Me will enter Hell, forcibly.

61. **GOD** is the One who designed the night so you can rest therein,
and the day lighted. **GOD** bestows many blessings upon the people,
but most people are not appreciative.

62. Such is **GOD** your Lord, the Creator of all things. There is no other god
besides Him. How could you deviate?

63. Thus are those who disregard **GOD**’s revelations caused to deviate.

64. **GOD** is the One who rendered the earth habitable for you, and the sky
a structure. He is the One who designed you, and designed you well.
He is the One who provides you with good provisions.* Such is **GOD**
your Lord; Most Exalted is **GOD**, Lord of the universe.

65. He is the Living; there is no other god besides Him. You shall worship
Him, devoting your religion absolutely to Him alone. Praise be to **GOD**, Lord of the universe.

Before God’s Blessings Upon Him, Muhammad Used to Worship Idols

66. Say, “I have been enjoined from worshiping the idols you worship
besides **GOD**, when the clear revelations came to me from my Lord.
I was commanded to submit to the Lord of the universe.”

---

إِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا لِي وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا بِي لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ
وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِي سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ
اللَّهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا فِيهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ

أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَلِقَائِهِ أُولَئِكَ حِزْبُهُمْ فِي النَّارِ خَالِدُونَ
اللَّهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَالسَّمَاءَ بِنَاءً وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوْرَكُمْ وَرَزَقَكُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ ذَلِكَ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ فَطَبَعَ اللَّهُ كَلِمَةَ طَاعَتِهِ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ
هُوَ الْحَيُّ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَادْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
قُلْ إِنِّي هَدَانِي رَبِّي إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ دِينًا قِيَمًا مِّلَّةَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ

\*40:60 Supplication, imploring God for anything, even material luxuries, is a form of worship. Hence the commandment to implore God whenever we have any needs. An atheist will never implore God for anything.

\*40:64 See Footnotes 15:20, 20:54, 25:2, and 35:12-13.

\*40:66 The Arabic word ‘Nahaa’ used in this verse indicates the stopping of something that was going on. See for example the same word in 4:171. See also 93:7.

67. He is the One who created you from dust, and subsequently from a tiny drop, then from a hanging embryo, then He brings you out as a child, then He lets you reach maturity, then you become old. Some of you die earlier. You attain a predetermined age, that you may understand.

68. He is the One who grants life and death. To have anything done, He simply says to it, “Be,” and it is.

69. Have you noted those who argue against GOD’s revelations, and how they are diverted?

70. They are the ones who disbelieved in the scripture, and in the messages delivered by our messengers. Therefore, they will surely find out.

71. The shackles will be around their necks, and the chains will be used to drag them.

72. In the Inferno,* then in the Fire, they will burn.

73. Then they will be asked, “Where are the idols you used to worship—

74. “besides GOD?” They will say, “They have abandoned us. In fact, when we worshiped them, we were worshiping nothing.” Thus does GOD send the disbelievers astray.

75. This is because you used to rejoice in false doctrines, on earth, and you used to promote them.

76. Enter the gates of Gehenna, wherein you abide forever. What a miserable destiny for the arrogant ones.

77. Therefore, you shall be patient; GOD’s promise is truth. Whether we show you some of (the retribution) we have promised for them, or terminate your life before that, they will be returned to us.

---

*40:72 Those who did not prepare themselves will suffer tremendously in the presence of God, on the Day of Judgment. They cannot stand the closeness to God due to lack of sufficient growth and development of their souls. I am using “Inferno” to describe this particular situation. See 55:44.

**Forgiver (Ghaafer) 40:78-85**

**God’s Authorization for the Quran’s Mathematical Miracle\***

78. We have sent messengers before you. Some of them we mentioned to you, and some we did not mention to you. No messenger can produce any miracle without GOD’s authorization.\* Once GOD’s judgment is issued, the truth prevails, and the falsifiers are condemned.

79. GOD is the One who created the livestock for you; some to ride, and some to eat.

80. They also provide you with additional benefits that satisfy many of your needs. On them, and on the ships, you are carried.

81. He thus shows you His signs. Which of GOD’s signs will you deny?

82. Have they not roamed the earth and noted the consequences for those who preceded them? They used to be greater in number, greater in power, and possessed a greater legacy on earth. All their achievements did not help them in the least.

83. When their messengers went to them with clear proofs, they rejoiced in the knowledge they already possessed, and the very things they mocked were the cause of their fall.

**God ALONE**

84. Subsequently, when they saw our retribution they said, “Now we believe in GOD ALONE, and we disbelieve in the idolatry we practiced.”

Too Late

85. Their belief then could not help them in the least, once they saw our retribution. Such is GOD’s system that has been established to deal with His creatures; the disbelievers are always doomed.

\*40:78 We learn from 17:45-46, 18:57, and 56:79 that the unbelievers have no access to the Quran; only the believers and the sincere seekers are permitted by God to understand it. The Quran’s mathematical code, “One of the great miracles” (74:30-35), was authorized by God, and revealed through His Messenger of the Covenant (Appendix 2).

---

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَى بِآيَاتِنَا أَنْ أَخْرِجْ قَوْمَكَ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَذَكِّرْهُمْ بِأَيَّامِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ

# Sura 41: Elucidated (Fussilat)

**In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful**

1. H. M.*

2. A revelation from the Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

3. A scripture whose verses have been precisely designed, in an Arabic Quran, for people who know.

4. A bearer of good news, as well as a warner. However, most of them turn away; they do not hear.

5. They said, “Our minds are made up, our ears are deaf to your message, and a barrier separates us from you. Do what you want, and so will we.”

6. Say, “I am no more than a human being like you, who has been inspired that your god is one god. You shall be devoted to Him, and ask His forgiveness. Woe to the idol worshipers.”

7. “They do not give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and with regard to the Hereafter, they are disbelievers.”

8. As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they receive a well-deserved recompense.

9. Say, “You are disbelieving in the One who created the earth in two days,* and you set up idols to rival Him, the Lord of the universe.”

10. He placed on it stabilizers (mountains), and blessed it. And He measured precisely all its provisions, in four days, to satisfy the needs of all its inhabitants.

11. Then He turned to the sky, when it was still gas, and said to it, and to the earth, “Come into existence, willingly or unwillingly.” They said, “We come willingly.”

*41:1 For the significance of these Quranic Initials, see Footnote 40:1.

*41:9-10 The “days” of creation represent a yardstick. Thus, the physical universe was created in two days, while the calculation of provisions for all the creatures on earth required four. This also teaches us that there is life only on this planet Earth.

12. Thus, He* completed the seven universes in two days, and set up the laws for every universe. And we* adorned the lowest universe with lamps, and placed guards therein. Such is the design of the Almighty, the Omniscient.

**Warning**

13. If they turn away, then say, “I am warning you of a disaster like the disaster that annihilated ‘Aad and Thamoud.”

14. Their messengers went to them, in front of them and behind them, saying, “You shall not worship except GOD.” They said, “Had our Lord willed, He could have sent angels. We are disbelievers in what you say.”

15. As for ‘Aad, they turned arrogant on earth, without the truth, and said, “Who is more powerful than we?” Did they not realize that GOD, who created them, is more powerful than they? They were unappreciative of our revelations.

16. Consequently, we sent upon them violent wind, for a few miserable days, to afflict them with a humiliating retribution in this life, and the retribution of the Hereafter is far more humiliating; they can never win.

17. As for Thamoud, we provided them with guidance, but they preferred blindness over guidance. Consequently, the disastrous and shameful retribution annihilated them, because of what they earned.

18. And we saved those who believed and led a righteous life.

19. The day will come when the enemies of GOD will be summoned to the hellfire, forcibly.

20. Once they get there, their own hearing, eyes, and skins will bear witness to everything they had done.

---
*41:12 God alone created the universe (18:51), but the angels participated in handling certain jobs in the lowest universe. Our universe cannot stand the physical presence of God (7:143). The plural tense acknowledges the angels’ role in our universe (App. 10).

**Elucidated (Fussilat) 41:21-29**

*A Video Record*

21. They will say to their skins, "Why did you bear witness against us?"
   They will reply, "GOD made us speak up; He is the One who causes everything to speak."
   He is the One who created you the first time, and to Him you will be returned.

22. There is no way you can hide from your own hearing, your eyes, nor your skins. In fact, you thought that GOD was unaware of much of what you do.

23. Such thinking about your Lord is what caused your fall, and thus you became losers.

24. If they continue the way they are, Hell will be their destiny, and if they make up excuses, they will not be excused.

25. We assign to them companions who adorn everything they do in their eyes. Thus, they end up incurring the same fate as the communities who preceded them of jinns and humans, who were also losers.

26. Those who disbelieved said, "Do not listen to this Quran and distort it, that you may win."

27. Consequently, we will afflict these disbelievers with a severe retribution. We simply requite them for their evil works.

28. Such is the requital for GOD’s enemies. Hell will be their eternal abode; a requital for discarding our revelations.

*On the Day of Judgment*

29. Those who disbelieved will say, “Our Lord, show us those among the two kinds—jinns and humans—who misled us, so we can trample them under our feet, and render them the lowliest.”

وَقَالُوا لِجُلُودِهِمْ لِمَ شَهِدْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ قَالُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِي أَتَانَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنْتُمْ شُهَدَاءُ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ عَنِ الشَّهَادَةِ بِجُنُودِهِ غَافِلًا

وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَنْ يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَا أَبْصَارُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمْ وَلَكِنْ ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَثِيرًا مِمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
وَتِلْكَ ظَنُّكُمْ الَّذِي ظَنَنْتُمْ بِرَبِّكُمْ أَلْبَطَ شَأْنُهُ وَأَضْلَلَكُمْ ذِكْرُهُ
وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى الْأَرْضِ زِينَةً لَهَا لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا
وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ قَبْلَكُمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ فَهَلْ نَسِينا خَلْقَهُمْ أَوْ كُنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْبَادِئِينَ
وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَمَرْنَاهُمْ بِعَمَلِ الْصَّالِحِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتَيْنَاهُمْ مِنْ عَمَلِ الْصَّالِحِ مَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ
وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَمَرْنَاهُمْ بِعَمَلِ الْصَّالِحِ وَإِقَامِ الصَّلَاةِ وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ وَكَانُوا لَنَا عَابِدِينَ
وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسَى وَأَخِيهِ أَنْ تَبَوَّآ لِقَوْمِكُمْ بِمِصْرَ بُيُوتًا وَاجْعَلُوا بُيُوتَكُمْ قِبْلَةً وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**Perfect Happiness: Now and Forever**

30. Those who say, “Our Lord is **GOD**,” then lead a righteous life, the angels descend upon them: “Have no fear, nor shall you grieve, and know the good news that Paradise has been reserved for you.

31. “We are your allies in this life, and in the Hereafter. You will have in it anything you wish for; you will have anything you want.

32. “(Such is your) ultimate abode, from the Forgiver, Most Merciful.”

33. Who can utter better statements than one who invites to **GOD**, works righteousness, and says, “I am one of the submitters (Muslims)?”

34. Not equal is the good response and the bad response. You shall resort to the nicest possible response. Thus, the one who used to be your enemy, may become your best friend.

35. None can attain this except one who steadfastly perseveres. None can attain this except one who is extremely fortunate.

**When the Devil Entices You**

36. When the devil whispers an idea to you, you shall seek refuge in **GOD**. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.

**Signs of God**

37. Among His signs are the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. Do not fall prostrate before the sun, nor the moon, and fall prostrate before **GOD**, who created them, if you truly worship Him alone.

38. If they are too arrogant to do this, then those at your Lord glorify Him night and day, without ever tiring.

وَقَالُوا وَيْلَكُمْ آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ كَيْفَ كَذَّبْتُمْ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ وَكُنْتُمْ عَنْهَا تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ

فَأَغْرَيْنَاكُمُ بِالْأَرْضِ فَأَرَيْنَاكُمْ فِيهَا مَسَاكِنَ كَمَا لَا نُرِيهَا إِلَّا لِلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَا وَلَكِنْ كَذَّبُوا فَأَغْرَيْنَاهُمْ فَاتَّبَعُوا هَوَاهُمْ فَقَدْ كَانُوا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ

وَمَا نُرِيهِمْ مِنْ آيَةٍ إِلَّا كَانَتْ لِلذُّنُوبِ أَكْبَرَ وَقَالُوا يَا مُوسَى إِنَّا لَن نُؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّى يَبْصُرَنَا اللَّهُ جَهْرَةً فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّاعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ

ثُمَّ أَنجَيْنَاكُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ ذَلِكَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ الْكِتَابَ فَكَانُوا بِهِ جَابِرِينَ

وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَاهُمْ بِبَيِّنَةٍ فَكَانُوا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ

وَلَقَدْ تَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ ذِكْرَانِ فِيهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

39. Among His signs is that you see the land still, then, as soon as we shower it with water it vibrates with life. Surely, the One who revived it can revive the dead. He is Omnipotent.

40. Surely, those who distort our revelations are not hidden from us. Is one who gets thrown into Hell better, or one who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you will; He is Seer of everything you do.

No Falsehood Can Enter The Quran*

41. Those who have rejected the message when it came to them, have rejected an Honorable book.

42. No falsehood can ever enter it, from its front, nor its back;* a revelation from a Most Wise, Praiseworthy.

43. What is said to you is precisely what was said to the previous messengers. Your Lord possesses forgiveness, and He also possesses painful retribution.

Language is Irrelevant

وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ وَلَا نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا إِذَا تَمَنَّوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَعَادُوا بِالْبَاطِلِ فَأَتَيْنَاهُم بِعَذَابٍ بِيمِقْدَارِ مَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَى بِآيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ

إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَقَارُونَ فَقَالُوا سَاحِرٌ كَذُوبٌ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَىٰ عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًا فَقَالَ إِنَّكُمْ لَظَالِمُونَ

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ

أَنْ لَا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا اللَّهَ إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ

وَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِن قَوْمِهِ مَا نَرَاكَ إِلَّا بَشَرًا مِثْلَنَا وَمَا أَنزَلَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ مِن مَلَكٍ إِنْ إِنَّا بِكُفْرِكُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مُبِينٍ

وَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِي لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا

فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَاءِي إِلَّا فِرَارًا

وإِنِّي قَدْ أَوَحَيْتُ إِلَىٰهُمْ أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَاجْتَنِبُوا الطَّاغُوتَ

فَقَالُوا إِنَّا بِمَا تُرْسِلُ بِهِ مُرْتَابُونَ

وَقَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِأَخِي وَأَوْزِعْنِي فِي الْأَمْرِ وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّشِدِينَ

وَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ بِآيَاتِنَا إِذَا هُمْ مِنْهَا يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ

وَمَا نُرْسِلُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنْذِرِينَ فَمَنْ آمَنَ وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

### Elucidated (Fussilat) 41:47-54

**Idols Disown Their Followers**

47. Knowledge about the Hour is with Him.* No fruits emerge from their sheaths, nor does any female conceive or give birth, without His knowledge. The day will come when He asks them: “Where are those idols that you set up besides Me?” They will say, “We proclaim to You that none of us bears witness to that.”

48. The idols they had idolized will disown them, and they will realize that there is no escape.

**Bad Weather Friends**

49. The human being never tires of imploring for good things. And when adversity befalls him, he turns despondent, desperate.

50. Then, when we bless him after suffering some adversity, he says, “This belongs to me. I do not believe that the Hour will ever come to pass. Even if I am returned to my Lord, I will find at Him better things.” Most certainly, we will inform the disbelievers of all their works, and will afflict them with severe retribution.

51. When we bless the human being, he turns and drifts farther and farther away. But as soon as he suffers an affliction, he implores loudly.

52. Say, “What if this is from God, and you reject it? Who is farther astray than one who opposes this?”

**The Great Prophecy***

53. We will show them our signs in the horizons, and within themselves, until they realize that this is the truth. Is your Lord not sufficient? He witnesses all things.*

54. They harbor doubts about meeting their Lord, and He is fully aware of all things.

---

*41:47 See Appendix 25.

*41:53 As detailed in Appendix 1, God has provided physical, verifiable, perpetual, and utterly irrefutable proof that this Quran is divine truth. This great prophecy, together with 9:33, 48:28, 61:9 & 110:2 inform us that the whole world is destined to accept the Quran as God’s unaltered message to the world. God witnesses the future (App. 38).

# Cosultation (Al-Shooraa) 42:1-10

---

## Sura 42: Consultation (Al-Shooraa)

**In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful**

1. H.M.*
2. ‘A. S. Q.*
3. Inspiring you, and those before you, is **GOD**, the Almighty, Most Wise.
4. To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth, and He is the Most High, the Great.
5. The heavens above them almost shatter out of reverence for Him, and the angels praise and glorify their Lord, and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Absolutely, **GOD** is the Forgiver, Most Merciful.
6. Those who set up other lords besides Him, **GOD** is the One in charge of them; you are not their advocate.
7. We thus revealed to you an Arabic Quran to warn the central community and all around it, and to warn about the Day of Summoning that is inevitable. Some will be in Heaven, and some will be in Hell.
8. Had **GOD** willed, He could have made them one community. But He redeems into His mercy whomever He wills. As for the transgressors, they have no master, nor a helper.
9. Did they find other lords besides Him? **GOD** is the only Lord, and He is the One who resurrects the dead, and He is the Omnipotent One.
10. If you dispute any part of this message, the judgment for doing this rests with **GOD**. Such is **GOD** my Lord. In Him I trust, and to Him I submit.

---

*42:1 These initials constitute a significant part of the Quran’s miracle (Footnote 40:1).
*42:2 This is the only sura where we see the initials ‘A.S.Q.’ (‘Ayn Seen Qaf), and the total occurrence of these three letters in this sura is 209, 19x11. Also, the letter “Q” occurs in this sura 57 times, 19x3. The only other sura where we see the initial “Q” is Sura 50, and this letter occurs in that sura also 57 times (See Appendix 1).

11. He is the Initiator of the heavens and the earth.
    He created for you, from among you, spouses,
    and created for the livestock mates, in order to multiply.
    There is nothing that equals Him.
    He is the Hearer, the Seer.

12. To Him belongs absolute control of the heavens and the earth.
    He increases the provision for whoever He wills, and reduces it.
    He is fully aware of all things.

Only One Religion

13. He decreed for you the same religion He decreed for Noah, and what we inspired to you, and what we decreed for Abraham, Moses, and Jesus:
    “You shall uphold this one religion, and do not divide it.”

Monotheists vs Idol Worshipers
The idol worshipers will resent what you invite them to do. GOD redeems to Himself whoever He wills; He guides to Himself everyone who submits.

14. Ironically, they broke up into sects—only after the knowledge had come to them—due to jealousy and resentment among themselves. If it were not for a predetermined decision from your Lord to respite them for a definite interim, they would have been judged immediately. Indeed, these later generations who inherited the scripture are full of doubts.

Message to the Christians and the Jews

15. This is what you shall preach, and steadfastly maintain what you are commanded to do, and do not follow their wishes. And say, “I believe in all the scriptures sent down by GOD. I was commanded to judge among you equitably. GOD is our Lord and your Lord. We have our deeds and you have your deeds. There is no dispute between us and you. GOD will gather us all together; to Him is the ultimate destiny.”

وَالَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي آيَاتِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَانٍ أَتَاهُمْ إِنْ فِي صُدُورِهِمْ إِلَّا كِبْرٌ بِمَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلُ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ
لَّقَدْ كَفَرَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْمَسِيحُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَقَالَ الْمَسِيحُ يَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ مَنْ يُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ فَقَدْ حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَأْوَاهُ النَّارُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنْصَارٍ
لَّقَدْ كَفَرَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ ثَالِثُ ثَلَاثَةٍ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ وَإِنْ لَّمْ يَنْتَهُوا عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ لَيَمَسَّنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
فَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمْ إِذَا جَاءَتْهُم مَّوْعِظَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَبَصَّقْنَا فِي الْبَحْرِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُلُوا مِنْ طَيِّبَاتِهِ وَقَاتِلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَلَى الْمُتَّقِينَ رَحِيمًا
وَلَقَدْ أَخْرَجْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنَ الْمَقَامِ الْمَشْهُورِ وَبَعَثْنَا مِنْهُمْ رُسُلًا فِيهِمْ مَّنْ يُهَدِّيهِ وَيَلْبِسُ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَكَفَىٰ بِهِ إِثْمًا إِنْ تَصْبِرُوا وَتَتَّقُوا فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ الْأُمُورِ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ هُدًى وَنُورًا لِلنَّاسِ وَبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ اسْتَخْلَفَهُمْ عَلَى الْكِتَابِ وَكَانُوا عَلَيْهِ شُهَدَاءَ وَمَا كَانُوا بِهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
حَتَّىٰ جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ اللَّهِ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ وَقَدْ كَانُوا مِنْ قَبْلُ يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
فَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا سَوْفَ نُصْلِيهِمْ نَارًا كُلَّمَا أَرَادُوا أَنْ يَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا أُعِيدُوا فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ ذُوقُوا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّتِي كُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَاهُمْ بِكِتَابٍ فُصِّلَ فِيهِ الْهُدَىٰ وَمَوْعِظَةٌ مِّنْ مُؤْمِنٍ وَرَحْمَةٌ مِّنَّا وَلِلْمُجْرِمِينَ هُمْ فِي عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ
وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَا فِيكُمْ بِرَسُولٍ مِّنْكُمْ يَتْلُو عَلَيْكُمْ آيَاتِنَا وَيُزَكِّيكُمْ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَيُعَلِّمُكُم مَّا لَمْ تَكُونُوا تَعْلَمُونَ
وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَا فِيكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِظَالِمِينَ
أَفَمَنْ هُوَ قَائِمٌ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَجَعَلُوا لِلَّهِ شُرَكَاءَ قُلْ سَتَعْلَمُونَ أَمَنْ هُوَ قَائِمٌ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُوَ لَهُ وَصِيٌّ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُحِيطٌ
وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَا فِيكُمْ بِبَيِّنَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ كَذَّبَ بِهَا وَمَنْ أَصْدَقُ مِمَّنْ آمَنَ بِهَا وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ
وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَا فِيكُمْ بِبَيِّنَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ كَذَّبَ بِهَا وَمَنْ أَصْدَقُ مِمَّنْ آمَنَ بِهَا وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ
وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَا فِيكُمْ بِبَيِّنَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ كَذَّبَ بِهَا وَمَنْ أَصْدَقُ مِمَّنْ آمَنَ بِهَا وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ

23. This is the good news from **GOD** to His servants who believe and lead a righteous life. Say, “I do not ask you for any money. All I ask is that each of you shall take care of his own relatives.” Anyone who performs a righteous work, we multiply his reward for it. **GOD** is Forgiver, Appreciative.

*God Controls the Writing of the Scripture
He Erases the Falsehood and Fixes the Truth*

24. Are they saying, “He fabricated lies about **GOD**!” If **GOD** willed, He could have sealed your mind. **GOD** erases what is wrong,* and fixes the truth of His words. He is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.

25. And He is the One who accepts the repentance from His servants, and remits the sins. He is fully aware of everything you do.

26. Those who believe and lead a righteous life respond to Him, and He showers them with His blessings. As for the disbelievers, they have incurred a severe retribution.

27. If **GOD** increased the provision for His servants, they would transgress on earth. This is why He sends it precisely measured to whomever He wills. Surely, He is fully Cognizant and Seer of His servants.

28. And He is the One who sends down the rain after they had despaired, and spreads His mercy. He is the only Master, the Praiseworthy.

29. Among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and all the creatures He spread in them. He is certainly able to summon them all, if He so wills.

*Only A Consequence*

30. Any disaster that afflicts you is a consequence of something you have done. And He overlooks many (of your sins).

31. You can never escape, and you have none besides **GOD** as Master and Helper.

32. Among His signs are the ships that sail the ocean like flags.

33. If He willed, He could have stilled the winds, leaving them motionless on top of the water. These are signs for those who are steadfast, appreciative.

34. Or He could have annihilated them as a consequence of their own works. Instead, He overlooks many (of their sins).

35. Those who argue against our signs should know that they have no basis.

36. Whatever you are given is no more than temporary material of this world. What **GOD** reserves is far better and everlasting, for those who believe and trust in their Lord.

Traits of the Believers

37. They avoid gross sins and vice, and when angered they forgive.

38. And they respond to their Lord by observing the contact prayers (Salat), and by deciding their affairs on the basis of consultation among themselves, and from our provisions to them they give (to charity).

39. When injustice befalls them, they stand up for their rights.

40. Although the requital for an evil work is an equivalent retribution, those who pardon and maintain righteousness are rewarded by **GOD**. He does not love the unjust.

41. Certainly, those who stand up for their rights, when injustice befalls them, are not committing any error.

42. Committing errors are those who treat the people unjustly, and resort to aggression without provocation. These have incurred a painful retribution.

43. However, maintaining patience and forgiveness reflects a strength of character.

44. Whomever **GOD** sends astray will never find another protector, and you will see such transgressors, when they see the retribution, saying, "Can we get another chance?"

وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوْمِهِ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمْ فَضَلَّ الَّذِينَ فَسَقُوا وَقَالَ الرَّبُّ رَحِمَةً مِنْهُ وَبُشْرَى لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا لِيُطَاعَ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَلَئِنْ فَسَقُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ

وَقَالَ اللَّهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا إِلَهَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَهُ وَاحِدٌ فَإِيَّايَ فَارْهَبُونِ

وَلَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ الدِّينُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

وَمَا أَصَابَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُو عَن كَثِيرٍ

وَمَا أَنتُمْ بِمُصْرِخِينَ فِي أَرْضِهِ وَلَا فِي مَا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِ عِلْمٌ

أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ الْقُرْآنَ أَمْ عَلَى قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَا

وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ وَالشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ لَا تَسْجُدُوا لِلشَّمْسِ وَلَا لِلْقَمَرِ وَاسْجُدُوا لِلَّهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَهُنَّ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ

فَإِنِ اسْتَكْبَرُوا فَقُلْ مُسِيرٌ رَّبِّي عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ

وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَا تَأْتِنَا بِهَذَا الْقُرْآنِ بِمَلَكٍ وَإِنَّا لَكُمْ بِشَرِّ مُقَامٍ

وَقَالَ الرَّسُولُ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي هَذَا كَفَرُوا بِالْقُرْآنِ وَقَالُوا سَحَرَهُ فَانْفَرَقُوا

قُلْ رَّبِّي أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ جَاءَ بِالْهُدَى وَمَنْ هُوَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ

وَلَا تَقُولَنَّ لِكُلِّ نَافِعٍ أَنْتَهُ وَلَكِنْ قُلْ رَّبِّي أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَصِفُونَ

كَذَلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ نَبَأَ مَا قَدْ سَلَفَ وَقَدْ آتَيْنَاكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكْرًا

مَنْ يَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ أَسَاءَ فَعَلَيْهَا وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ

وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ مِن لَّدُنَّا فَضْلًا يَا جِبَالُ أَوِّبِي مَعَهُ وَالطَّيْرَ وَأَلَنَّا لَهُ الْحَدِيدَ

أَنِ اعْمَلْ صَالِحًا إِنِّي بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا سُلَيْمَانَ عِلْمًا وَقَالَ لَهْوَ أَسْبِغْ عَلَيَّ وَأَلْقِ إِلَيَّ

وَلَقَدْ صَرَفْنَا إِلَيْهِ رِيَاحًا عَاتِيَةً جَارِيَةً بِأَمْرِنَا شَرَدَتْ أَيْنَمَا أَرَدْنَا وَكَانَ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الصَّابِرِينَ

وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ سُلَيْمَانَ نِعْمَ عَبْدًا إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ

وَلَمَّا وَفَتَا إِلَى مَغَارٍ مِنْ الْجِبَالِ قَالَ يَا حَسْرَةَ عَلَى مَا فَرَطْتُ فِي عِبَادَةِ الرَّحْمَنِ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُقْتَحِرِينَ

فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا آتَيْنَاهُ رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَاهُ مِنْ لَدُنَّا عِلْمًا

قَالَ لَهُمَا إِنِّي خَانْتُ نَفْسِي وَتَبَعْتُ أَمْرَ قَوْمِي وَكَانُوا بِالْحَقِّ مُعَانِدِينَ

وَلَمْ أَخْشَ أَنْ أَعْصِي رَبِّي وَكَانَ رَبِّي بِفَضْلِهِ غَفُورًا

فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الْعَذَابَةُ نَحْوَ الصُّبْحِ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دَارِهِمْ يَتَلَقَّوْنَ

وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ يَتْلُكُكُمْ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَمَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ مِنَ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ وَمَا تَرَوْنَ مِنْ آيَاتِهِ ذَلِكُمْ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ فَبِأَيِّ آيَاتِهِمْ بَعْدُ يُكَذِّبُونَ

أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ الْقُرْآنَ أَمْ عَلَى قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَا

وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ مَا يُرِيكُمْ مِنَ الْفُلْكِ وَمَا تَسِيرُ بِهِ فِي الْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

وَيُضْرِبُ لَكُم مَثَلًا مِنَ أَنْفُسِكُمْ هَلْ مِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُبْجِشُ بِجَنَّةٍ خُضْرٍ وَأَعْنَابٍ وَيَجْعَلْ لَهَا أَنْهَارًا جَرِيًا وَفَاكِهَةً كَثِيرَةً فَتَقْطَعَ شَيْبًا وَيَكُونَ ذُرِّيَّةً لَّا يَخَافُونَ فِتْoranَ وَيَأْخُذُهُمُ اللَّهُ بِعِقَابٍ وَيَكُونُ الظَّالِمُونَ خَاسِرِينَ

وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ يَتْلُكُكُمْ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَمَا أَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَأَنْبَتْنَا بِهِ جَنَّاتٍ وَحَصَدْتُمْ مِنْهَا حَصِيدًا

وَالزَّيْتُونَ وَالرُّمَّانَ ذُو الْقُرْبَةِ وَالْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَاهُ مَنْازِلَ حَتَّى عَادَ كَالْعُرْجُونِ

لَا الشَّمْسُ يَنْبَغِي لَهَا أَنْ تُدْرِكَ الْقَمَرَ وَلَا اللَّيْلُ سَابِقٌ لِلنَّهَارِ وَكُلٌّ فِي فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ

وَمَا أَصَابَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُو عَن كَثِيرٍ

وَمَا أَنتُمْ بِمُصْرِخِينَ فِي أَرْضِهِ وَلَا فِي مَا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِ عِلْمٌ

أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ الْقُرْآنَ أَمْ عَلَى قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَا

وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِمْ فَسْأَلْ أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

بِآيَاتٍ وَقَدْ مَكَّنَّاهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَأَعْطَيْنَاهُمْ مِنْ سُنَحِ الْحَيَاةِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَاتِ وَإِقَامَ الصَّلَاةِ وَإِيتَاءَ الزَّكَاةِ وَكَانُوا لَنَا عَابِدِينَ

فَإِنْ كَفَرُوا فَقُلْ مُسِيرٌ رَّبِّي عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ

وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَا تَأْتِنَا بِهَذَا الْقُرْآنِ بِمَلَكٍ وَإِنَّا لَكُمْ بِشَرِّ مُقَامٍ

وَقَالَ الرَّسُولُ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي هَذَا كَفَرُوا بِالْقُرْآنِ وَقَالُوا سَحَرَهُ فَانْفَرَقُوا

قُلْ رَّبِّي أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ جَاءَ بِالْهُدَى وَمَنْ هُوَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ

وَلَا تَقُولَنَّ لِكُلِّ نَافِعٍ أَنْتَهُ وَلَكِنْ قُلْ رَّبِّي أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَصِفُونَ

كَذَلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ نَبَأَ مَا قَدْ سَلَفَ وَقَدْ آتَيْنَاكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكْرًا

مَنْ يَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ أَسَاءَ فَعَلَيْهَا وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ

52. We inspired to you a revelation proclaiming our commandments—you had no idea about the scripture, or faith—and we made it a beacon to guide whomever we choose from among our servants. Surely, you guide to a straight path.

53. The path of **GOD**, to whom belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. Absolutely, all matters are controlled by **GOD**.

**Sura 43: Vanity (Al-Zukhruf)**

In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful

1. H. M.*

2. And the profound scripture.

3. We have rendered it an Arabic Quran, that you may understand.*

4. It is preserved with us in the original master, honorable and full of wisdom.

5. Should we just ignore the fact that you have transgressed?

6. Many a prophet we have sent to the previous generations.

7. Every time a prophet went to them, they ridiculed him.

8. Consequently, we annihilated people who were even more powerful than these. We thus set the examples from the previous communities.

9. If you asked them, “Who created the heavens and the earth,” they would say, “The Almighty, the Omniscient has created them.”

10. He is the One who made the earth habitable for you, and created for you roads therein, that you may be guided.

---
*43:1 See Footnote 40:1. The frequency of occurrence of the letter ‘H’ (Haa) in the seven Haa-initiated suras is 292, while the letter ‘M’ (Meem) occurs 1855 times in the seven suras. This adds up to a total of 2147, or 19x113. See Appendix 1 for the details.

*43:3 Arabic is the most efficient language, especially in expressing commandments, statutes and exacting laws. Hence the revelation of the Quran in Arabic for the clear understanding of all peoples, regardless of their tongues. See Appendix 4 for the details.

Vanity (Al-Zukhruf) 43:11-22

11. And He is the One who sends down from the sky water, in exact measure, to revive dead lands therewith. Similarly, you will be resurrected.

12. And He is the One who created all kinds, in pairs (male and female). And He created for you ships and livestock to ride.

13. As you rest on top of them, you shall appreciate this blessing from your Lord, and say, “Glory be to the One who subdued this for us. We could not have controlled them by ourselves.”

14. “We ultimately return to our Lord.”

Angels As Daughters: A Blasphemy

15. They even assigned for Him a share from His own creation! Surely, the human being is profoundly unappreciative.

16. Has He chosen from among His creations daughters for Himself, while blessing you with sons?

17. When one of them is given news (of a daughter) as they claimed for the Most Gracious, his face is darkened with misery; he becomes despondent.

18. (They say,) “What is good about an offspring which is brought up to be beautiful, and cannot help in war?”

19. They claimed that the angels, who are creations of the Most Gracious, are females! Have they witnessed their creation? Their claims will be recorded, and they will be questioned.

20. They also said, “If the Most Gracious willed, we would not have worshiped them.” They certainly have no basis for such a claim. They only conjecture.*

21. Have we given them a book before this, that they are upholding?

22. Instead, they said, “We found our parents carrying on certain practices, and we are following in their footsteps.”

---

*43:20 The idol worshipers cannot blame God for their idolatry, since we have absolute freedom of choice to worship God alone, or not.

34. And gates for their mansions, and luxurious furnishings.

35. And many vanities. All these are the temporary materials of this lowly life. The Hereafter, at your Lord, is far better for the righteous.

Awareness of Our Invisible Companions*

36. Anyone who disregards the message of the Most Gracious, we appoint a devil to be his constant companion.*

37. Such companions will divert them from the path. Yet, they make them believe that they are guided.

38. Then, when he comes to us he will say, “Oh I wish you were as far from me as the distance between the two easts. What a miserable companion!”

39. It will not console you on that day, since you have transgressed, that both of you will share in the retribution.

Addressing the Messenger

40. Can you make the deaf hear, or guide the blind and the wicked strays?

41. Whether we let you die before it or not, we will surely punish them.

42. And we may show you (the retribution) we promised for them. We are in full control over them.

43. Therefore, you shall steadfastly uphold what we have given you; you are in the right path.

44. This is a message for you and your people, and you will be questioned.

45. Ask all those messengers that we sent before you: “Have we set up besides the Most Gracious other gods to be worshiped?”

46. For example, we sent Moses with our miracles to Pharaoh and his elders, saying, “I am a messenger from the Lord of the universe.”

47. When he showed them our miracles, they laughed at them.

**Vanity (Al-Zukhruf) 43:48-60**

48. Every sign we showed them was even bigger than the previous one, and we afflicted them with the plagues, perhaps they repent.

49. They said, “O magician, implore your Lord on our behalf, since you are closer to Him (to relieve this plague); we will then be guided.”

50. But as soon as we relieved their affliction, they reverted.

51. Pharaoh announced to his people, “O my people, do I not possess the kingship of Egypt, and these rivers are flowing under me? Do you not see?

52. Which one is better; me or that one who is lowly and can hardly speak?

53. Why does he not possess a treasure of gold, or bring the angels to work with him?”

54. He thus fooled his people, and they obeyed him; for they were wicked people.

55. When they persisted in fighting us, we punished them and drowned them all.

56. We rendered them an example and a lesson for the others.

**Another Example From History**

57. And when the son of Mary was cited as an example, your people immediately rejected it.

58. They said, “Is it better to worship our gods, or to worship him?” They said this only to argue with you. Indeed, they are people in opposition.

59. He was no more than a human servant whom we blessed, and we rendered him a lesson for the Children of Israel.

60. If we willed, we could have made you angels colonizing the earth.

وَقَالُوا لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّى يَفْجُرَ لَنَا الْأَرْضُ مَجَارِيَهَا

وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَجَعَلْنَا لَهُم مِّنْ عِنْدِنَا سَاكِنِينَ

وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُ أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ وَزِيرًا
فَقُولَا إِلَى قَوْمِكُم بِأَن لَّهُمَا آيَاتٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمَا فَأَخَذَهُمَا فَقَوْمُهُمَا كَانُوا مُحْصِرِينَ
فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسَى أَنِ اسْقُطْ حِزَامَكَ فَأَلْقِهِ فَإِنَّهُ سَيَأْتِي حَفِظًا لَّا يَلْتَمِسُهُ عَيْنٌ وَإِنَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَفِيزٌ
فَأَمَّا قَوْمُ فِرْعَوْنَ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا ظَالِمِينَ
وَوَصَّيْنَا بِمُوسَى وَهَارُونَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا مِن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَإِنَّهُمَا كَانَا عِنْدَنَا حَمِيدَيْنِ
وَتَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَإِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا ظَالِمِينَ
فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ فَإِنَّا لَهُ جَامِعُونَ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَى مَدْيَنَ رَسُولًا فَإِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا لِلرَّسُولِ كَذَّابِينَ
فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ وَالْبَأْسَى فَبَأْسَى مَأْوَاهُمْ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ رُشْدَهُ وَكُنَّا بِهِ مُقْتَبِلِينَ
إِذْ قَالَ لِلنَّاسِ أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ ذَلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَاهُ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ عَلَى مِثْقَالِ الْبَيْتِ الْحَرَامِ
أَنِ اقْصِدَا لِلنَّاسِ فَإِنَّهُمَا كَانَا لَنَا خَالِدَيْنِ
وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لَهُمَا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ مَنْصِيبًا مَنْ لَمِنْ دُونِهِمَا لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا مُتَّقٍ وَاتَّخَذُوا مِنْ مَكَانِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى وَعَاهَدْنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ أَن طَهِّرَا بَيْتِيَ لِلطَّائِفِينَ وَالْعَاكِفِينَ وَالْرُّكَّعِ السُّجُودِ
وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمَا مَوَاضِعَ لِلصَّلَاةِ فَإِنِ اسْتَحْسَنَ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا لِرَبِّهِ إِنَّهُ لَذُو فَضْلٍ كَبِيرٍ
وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمَا مَوَاضِعَ لِلْقِيَامِ وَقَدْ أَحْسَنَ مُوسَى مَكَانًا لِلْعَصْرِ وَقَدْ أَسْقَيْنَا بِهِ عِبَادَنَا وَمَا زَلْتُمْ أَنْتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُمْ بِالْجَاهِلِينَ
ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خُلَفَاءَ فَسَارُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَبَأْسًا لِلظَّالِمِينَ
ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَى وَكُلَّمَا جَاءَ رَسُولٌ إِلَى قَوْمٍ زَالَمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَقَالُوا كَذَّابٌ وَكَذَّبُوا وَأَخَذْنَا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مَا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا النُّبُوَّةَ وَالْكِتَابَ فَأَيُّهَا هَاتَانِ نِعْمَةٌ أَكْبَرُ أَفَأَنتُمْ بِالْبَاطِلِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُ أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ وَزِيرًا
وَقُلْنَا اذْهَبَا إِلَى قَوْمِكُم بِآيَاتِنَا إِنَّا مَعَكُمَا مُسْتَمِعُونَ
فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمَا رَسُولٌ مِّنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا مَعَهُمَا إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمَا إِنِّي بِكُمْ رَسُولٌ فَأَرْسِلُوا مَعِيَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
قَالَ إِنِّي رَجَاءٌ أَن يَسْأَلُونِ وَأَخَافُ أَن يُقَضَّعَنِي فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي مَسْؤُولًا
وَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
فَأَخَذَهُ اللَّهُ بِهِ وَأَلْقَاهُ إِلَى رَحْمَتِهِ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
وَقَالَ مُوسَى إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَى رَبِّي لَعَلِّي آتِيكُم بِبَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَبِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنْهُ فَإِنِ اتَّبَعْتُمُونِ

فَلَمَّا نَسُوا مَا ذُكِّرُوا بِهِ أَخْرَجْنَا لَهُمْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَأَسْكَنَاهُمْ فِي مَكَانٍ بِحَرْثٍ وَزَرْعٍ وَقُلْنَا لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ اسْكُنُوا الْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ الْآخِرَةِ جِئْنَا بِكُمْ لَفِيفًا
وَتَاللَّهِ لَنَا هُدَاهُ وَإِنَّهُ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَإِنَّهُ هُوَ أَحْقَى
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُ أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ وَزِيرًا

فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمَا رَسُولٌ مِّنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا مَعَهُمَا إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمَا إِنِّي بِكُمْ رَسُولٌ فَأَرْسِلُوا مَعِيَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
قَالَ إِنِّي رَجَاءٌ أَن يَسْأَلُونِ وَأَخَافُ أَن يُقَضَّعَنِي فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي مَسْؤُولًا

فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ نَصَرْنَاهُمْ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ

Vanity (Al-Zukhruf) 43:61-73

**Jesus as a Sign For Unveiling the End of the World***

61. He is to serve as a sign for knowing the end of the world.*
    You shall harbor no doubts about it, and follow me. This is the right path.

62. Let not the devil repel you; he is your most ardent enemy.

63. When Jesus came with the miracles, he said, “I bring to you wisdom, and clarification of some matters in which you dispute. You shall revere **GOD** and obey me.

64. **GOD** is my Lord and your Lord, you shall worship Him alone. This is the right path.”

65. The parties disputed among themselves. Woe to those who transgressed from the retribution of a painful day.

66. Are they waiting for the Hour to come to them suddenly when they least expect it?

67. The close friends on that day will become enemies of one another, except for the righteous.

**The Righteous**

68. O My servants, you will suffer no fear on that day, nor will you grieve.

69. They believed in our revelations, and totally submitted.

70. Enter Paradise, together with your spouses, and rejoice.

71. Offered to them will be golden trays and cups of everything the hearts desire and the eyes wish for. You live therein forever.

72. Such is the Paradise that you inherit, in return for your works.

73. You will have in it all kinds of fruits, from which you eat.

---

*43:61 As detailed in Appendix 25, the End of the World is given in the Quran, and the birthdate of Jesus provided one of the significant signs that the calculations are correct. We learn that the world will end in the year 2280 (19x120) after the birth of Jesus. See 47:18. Additionally, both the lunar year (1710) & the solar year (2280) are divisible by 570 (19x30), the number of years from the birth of Jesus to the birth of Muhammad.

---

وَلَقَدْ لَمَسْنَا السَّمَاءَ فَوَجَدْنَاهَا مُلِئَتْ حَدِيثًا وَشُهُوبًا
وَلَأَتُونَنَّهُمْ فِيهَا قِنَاطِيرًا
وَلَأَتُونَنَّهُمْ فِيهَا مُتَّكْئِينَ
وَلَأَتُونَنَّهُمْ فِيهَا جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونًا
لَأَتُونَنَّهُمْ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ زَوْجَيْنِ مُتَشَابِهَيْنِ
وَلَأَتُونَنَّهُمْ فِيهَا مَآئِكَ مُحْصِيَّةً
وَلَأَتُونَنَّهُمْ فِيهَا وَآنِيَةً مِّنْ فِضَّةٍ وَآنِيَةً مِّنْ حَدِيدٍ
وَلَأَتُونَنَّهُمْ فِيهَا خِلْدًا لَا يَسْأَمُونَ وَلا يَسْقُطُونَ
وَلَأَتُونَنَّهُمْ فِيهَا مُتَّكْئِينَ
وَلَأَتُونَنَّهُمْ فِيهَا أَزْوَاجًا مُطَهَّرَةً وَأَبْدًا مَّحْفُوظِينَ
هَذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ
إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ

## Page 514

Surely, the guilty will abide in the retribution of Gehenna forever.

74. Surely, the guilty will abide in the retribution of Gehenna forever.
75. Never will it be commuted for them; they will be confined therein.
76. It is not us who wronged them; it is they who wronged their own souls.
77. They will implore: “O Maalek, let your Lord finish us off.”
   He will say, “You are staying.”

They Hate The Truth

78. “We have given you the truth, but most of you hate the truth.”
79. Have they schemed a scheme?
   We too are scheming.
80. Do they think that we do not hear their secrets and conspiracies?
   Yes indeed; our messengers are with them, recording.
81. Proclaim: “If the Most Gracious did have a son, I would be the first to worship Him (anyway).”
82. Be He glorified; He is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord with the great dominion, far above their claims.
83. Let them blunder and play until they meet their day that is awaiting them.
84. He is the only God in the heaven and the only God on earth, and He is the Most Wise, the Omniscient.
85. Most Exalted is the One who possesses the kingship of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them. With Him is the knowledge about the Hour, and to Him you will be returned.
86. None of those whom they idolize besides Him possess any power to intercede, unless their intercession coincides with the truth, and they are aware thereof.
87. If you asked them who created them, they would say, “GOD.”
   Why then did they deviate?
88. It is proclaimed: “O my Lord, these people do not believe.”
89. Disregard them and say, “Peace;” they will surely find out.
